units.text: Close-up of Juliana, her anger flaring as she gestures sharply.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You have already taken enough from me. Leave!
Medium close-up of Gerald pointing an accusatory finger, his composure snapping into hostile anger.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!
Close-up of Juliana recoiling in utter disbelief.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: What? When?
Close-up of Gerald narrowing his eyes vindictively.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: The last time I came here.
Medium shot of Juliana scoffing, stepping forward as Alexander stands motionless behind her.
Medium shot looking out the doorway as Juliana steps aside and the Constable barges past into the dimly lit cottage.
Heavy thud of boots entering wooden floorboards, followed by forceful banging of furniture.
The Constable begins violently overturning crates and dumping contents across the floor.
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana dropping to her knees, frantically trying to salvage bundles of dried herbs scattering across the boards.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!
The Constable aggressively pulls folded bed linens from a shelf and hurls them onto the damp floor.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling on the floor, looking up with tears streaming down her cheeks.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Please! There is nothing here!
Close-up of the Constable's hands flipping open a small wooden keepsake box on a work table.

units.speaker: CONSTABLE
units.text: Then you have nothing to fear.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana clutching the fallen linens to her chest, her voice breaking.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Those are all I have left!
Medium shot of Gerald leaning casually against the cottage doorframe, looking around with contemptuous disgust.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Stand aside. Look at this place. A perfect hiding hole for a thief.
Medium shot of Juliana rising to her feet, clutching the folded cloth, her face contorting with rage.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You planted this accusation because you cannot bear that I am happy without you!
Tight close-up of Gerald's face chilling into a cold sneer.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Happy?
Medium shot of Alexander standing in the cottage shadows, eyes locked onto Gerald.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand slowly tightening into a white-knuckled fist.
Low-angle close-up of Gerald tilting his chin up, daringly baiting Alexander.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: What is it, soldier? Going to strike a gentleman in front of his wife?

units.text: Close-up on Alexander, his expression freezing in complete shock.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Arrested?
Medium close-up as his mother clutches Alexander's forearms with desperate, pleading hands.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!
Close-up on Alexander, absolute fury erupting across his scarred face.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: But she saved you!
Close-up on his mother, clutching her chest in grief.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: I told them!
Medium shot of Alexander clenching his fists at his sides, trembling with rage.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You told them the truth!
Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They called her a witch!
Frontal medium shot of Alexander standing frozen, the weight of the realization crashing down on him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana... is in a cell?
Close-up of his mother clutching her temple, reeling in remembered trauma.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: She was taken before a magistrate.
Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes wild with terror for his wife.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And?!
Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They condemned her.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: No.
Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: She is to be executed.
Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: When?
Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: After the wedding.
Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: What wedding?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: After the wedding.
Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: What wedding?
Profile close-up of his mother looking at him across the lantern light.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Rupert... and Catherine's.
A sudden dramatic metallic swell underscores the impending deadline.
Frontal close-up on his mother, solemn and resolute in her warning.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Two days from now.
Profile shot of Alexander as dark realization settles over his face, turning to a grim, predatory glare.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They are marrying in two days...
Tight, terrifying close-up on Alexander's eyes flashing with murderous wrath.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: ...and killing my wife afterward.
Medium shot as his mother urgently grabs Alexander's coat, pleading with him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!
Close-up on Alexander, towering over her, immovable and consumed by purpose.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They already took my name.
Close-up on Alexander stepping forward, his voice rising with lethal thunder.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They stole my home!
Tight close-up on his furious, bared teeth and wild eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And now they have taken Juliana!
Close-up of Alexander's gloved hand clenching into a tight, leather-creaking fist.
The sharp, taut creak of leather straining under monstrous grip strength.
Tracking shot following Alexander as he turns his back on the warmth of the cabin and walks boldly toward the open double barn doors.
Alexander stands framed in the doorway, staring out into the vast, snow-covered pine forest under the cold moonlight.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Two days.
Medium shot from inside the cabin, showing his mother clutching her chest, looking after Alexander's imposing silhouette standing at the threshold of the blizzard.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then they have two days to celebrate.
Side profile close-up on Alexander as his breath fogs into the icy winter night air, his jaw clenched tight.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Because before that wedding begins...

units.text: Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: A disgraced woman?
Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me.
Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You are lying!
Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me.
Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's expressive blue eyes and tear-stained cheek.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him.
Low-angle shot of Juliana leaning slightly forward against her chains.
Close-up of Catherine staring down, her eyes widening as Juliana's words pierce her facade.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Let him have Clarissa.
Close-up of Juliana smiling with genuine liberation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He lost me.
Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You were rejected!
Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth.
Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.
Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Your soldier?

units.text: Medium low-angle shot on Gerald at the altar steps, looking down dismissively, while Clarissa in her shimmering gold gown stands behind him gloating.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: I cannot marry you, Juliana.
Medium close-up on Juliana trembling in disbelief, her hands clasped tightly to her chest.
Juliana gasps softly in heartbreak, her eyes wide and brimming with tears.
Medium shot returning to Gerald, sneering down at Juliana.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: You are far too plain...
Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face, crushed under his biting words.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: ...far too silent...
Medium shot on Gerald turning slightly toward Clarissa as she smiles admiringly at him.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: You look like a kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding.
Close-up on Juliana, whose tearful expression begins to tighten with quiet indignation.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: And that quiet little face.
Wide over-the-shoulder shot from behind Clarissa and Gerald, framing Juliana standing solitary down the center aisle.
Medium shot returning to Clarissa laughing at Juliana's expense.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: Gerald needs a real lady...
Close-up on Juliana staring straight ahead as Clarissa insults her mother's memory.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: ...not a dull creature who hides in her mother's apothecary herbs.
High-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral aisle as a matriarch dressed in an ornate black velvet gown glides toward Juliana.
The matriarch steps into the center aisle, glaring down at Juliana with cold superiority.

units.speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
units.text: Oh, don't look so wounded, Juliana.
Medium profile two-shot of the matriarch confronting Juliana face-to-face.

units.speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
units.text: You should be grateful you're at least allowed to attend the wedding.
Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward on the altar steps, impatiently gesturing Juliana toward the church exit.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: Go home quietly, Juliana. At least leave this chapel with some dignity.
Profile close-up of Juliana turning her face back toward the altar, tears still shimmering on her cheeks.
Direct close-up on Juliana's face as a steely, defiant smile emerges through her pain.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Dignity?
Full shot of Juliana standing tall, her posture completely transforming into regal composure before the seated guests.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You abandoned a woman who trusted you...

units.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her lips trembling in agonizing sorrow.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Say goodbye to your mother.
Low-angle shot of Catherine swinging the flaming orange iron upward from the book.
Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.
Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Burn it.
Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.
Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: What?
Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Burn the ledger. Burn every page.
Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You may destroy the book...
Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: ...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me.
Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You think a few herbs make you better than me?
Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No. Your cruelty does that for me.
High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.
Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You still think you are better?!
Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I know what I am.
Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: A disgraced woman?

units.text: Low-angle shot looking down along the polished stone floor as the guard's sword tip grounds firmly between Rupert and the guards.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: I am Lord Rupert Ashburn!
Medium close-up on Rupert thumping his chest in indignant disbelief.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Your Duke!
Medium shot framing the Guard Captain and Alexander in profile.
The Guard Captain snaps a crisp salute toward Alexander.

units.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
units.text: No. He is your Duke.
Medium shot on Catherine in her bridal gown and Lord Henry Sterling seated in the front pew, both frozen in stunned shock.
Lord Sterling clutches his gold-headed walking cane tightly, his jaw clenching as tension spreads through the church.
Medium shot on Rupert spinning toward the gathered congregation, his hands flailing.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: You have all been deceived!
Medium close-up on Alexander, commanding and icy.
Extreme close-up on the Crown Official's gloved thumb cracking the red wax seal open.
Brittle snap of breaking sealing wax.
Full shot of the Crown Official standing amidst church debris reading the death register.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Official death confirmation was filed three months after the ambush.
Two-shot of the Crown Official in the background and Alexander's dark silhouette in the foreground.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Duke Alexander Ashburn was declared dead.
Wide majestic shot capturing the entire nave, the rows of horrified guests, and the ruined cathedral windows.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: His estate and title were subsequently transferred under false authority.
Medium close-up on Rupert clutching his chest as if choking on his own lies.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: I was told he was dead!
Low shot following Alexander's heavy boots stepping steadily up the stone steps toward the altar.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You were told exactly what you needed to hear.
Medium shot on Rupert whirling around in a frenzy, pointing his finger toward Lord Sterling.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Sterling handled the report!
Alexander turns his head sharply toward the side pews.
Medium shot of Lord Henry Sterling silently slipping out of his seat and making a break toward the side exit.
Close-up on Catherine peering out from under her bridal veil in shock.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: My Lord?

units.text: Medium close-up of Alexander's mother leaning over the map, her voice cracking.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: And when you disappeared...?
Close-up on Alexander, his voice low and cutting.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They declared me dead.
Medium shot from the side of the wooden table as his mother brings both hands up to cover her mouth in overwhelmed grief.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They falsified what remained of the reports.
Alexander's mother presses her trembling hands against her lips, tears brimming in her eyes.
Tight close-up on his mother weeping openly, her ring catching the warm lamplight as she lowers her hand to her heart.
Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They called her a witch!

Close-up of his mother clutching her temple, reeling in remembered trauma.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: She was taken before a magistrate.
Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes wild with terror for his wife.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And?!
Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They condemned her.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: No.
Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: She is to be executed.
Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: When?
Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: After the wedding.
Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: What wedding?

units.text: Close-up on Juliana, stunned by the callous depth of the conspiracy.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: How long?
Medium two-shot of the Lady in Gold Gown and Gerald looking together down at Juliana.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: Long enough to know he was never going to marry you.
Juliana turns abruptly toward the first row of pews, where her elderly father sits gripping an ornate brass cane.
Close-up on the father's hand tightly gripping the gold curved handle of his walking cane.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Father...
Wide shot showing Juliana dropping to her knees beside her seated father, pleading with him.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Tell them this is a mistake.
Close-up on the father's weathered face, looking fixedly at the floor, refusing to meet her gaze.
Close-up on Juliana looking up at him, tears streaming uncontrollably down her cheeks.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Father... please look at me.
The father tightens his jaw and stony expression, refusing to offer a single word or look.
Profile close-up of the father staring blankly forward.
Low-angle shot looking up at the Matriarch commanding the space with regal severity.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: Enough!

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: You have embarrassed this family long enough.
Close-up on Juliana as she rises, stung by the utter betrayal.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Embarrassed you?
Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing toward Clarissa, who stands elegantly in gold.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: Clarissa knows how to carry herself.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: She has beauty, connections, and a future worth protecting.
Medium profile two-shot of the Matriarch confronting Juliana face to face.
Close-up on Juliana, demanding answers in spite of her humiliation.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: And I am what?
Medium tracking shot showing the Lady in Gold Gown stepping past Juliana toward the center.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to.
Close-up on Juliana absorbing the venomous words, her breathing shallow.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: I am the daughter they choose.
Medium shot of the Lady in Gold Gown smiling warmly at Gerald beside the altar candles.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: Clarissa is the jewel of this family.
Close two-shot of the Matriarch and Juliana standing side by side in profile.
Medium shot framing Juliana looking directly at Gerald, who towers over her coldly.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: So that is what I was worth to you?
Close-up on Gerald's sharp jawline as he looks down at her without an ounce of remorse.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: ...a secret medicine in her hand.
Tight close-up of Catherine's smiling face, her eyes gleaming with vindictive pleasure.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: She looks exactly like a poisoner.
Close-up of Juliana glaring back in fierce indignation, breathing heavily as she resists the guard's arm across her shoulder.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I did not poison her! Look at her eyes, the fever has broken!
Medium full shot of Rupert standing beside the four-poster bed, calmly pulling on his black leather gloves.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: A clever story, girl.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: But the guards know how to extract the truth.
Medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess stirring against her pillows, lifting her trembling head with visible effort.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Rupert...
Medium shot of Rupert pausing mid-stride as he hears his mother's voice, slowly turning his head toward the bed.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Stop this!
Wide shot of the bedchamber framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess props herself up on one elbow and points an accusing finger.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: She is innocent.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: She saved me!
Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Your Grace...
Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: I know what happened to me!
Medium low-angle shot past the Duchess pointing directly at Rupert, who stands rigid and expressionless.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: I was poisoned!

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: And you... you knew!
Medium shot of the Duchess lunging forward from the pillows, gasping for breath as she points toward Catherine.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Catherine knew!

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: They have been—
The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.

Medium low-angle shot of Juliana dropping to her knees, frantically trying to salvage bundles of dried herbs scattering across the boards.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!
The Constable aggressively pulls folded bed linens from a shelf and hurls them onto the damp floor.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling on the floor, looking up with tears streaming down her cheeks.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Please! There is nothing here!
Close-up of the Constable's hands flipping open a small wooden keepsake box on a work table.

units.speaker: CONSTABLE
units.text: Then you have nothing to fear.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana clutching the fallen linens to her chest, her voice breaking.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Those are all I have left!
Medium shot of Gerald leaning casually against the cottage doorframe, looking around with contemptuous disgust.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Stand aside. Look at this place. A perfect hiding hole for a thief.
Medium shot of Juliana rising to her feet, clutching the folded cloth, her face contorting with rage.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You planted this accusation because you cannot bear that I am happy without you!
Tight close-up of Gerald's face chilling into a cold sneer.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Happy?
Medium shot of Alexander standing in the cottage shadows, eyes locked onto Gerald.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand slowly tightening into a white-knuckled fist.
Low-angle close-up of Gerald tilting his chin up, daringly baiting Alexander.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: What is it, soldier? Going to strike a gentleman in front of his wife?

units.text: Close-up on Rupert, veins bulging in his neck as his composure shatters.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: I said arrest him!

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Why?!
Close-up on the Royal Guard holding his upright blade with unwavering conviction.

units.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
units.text: Because we know who he is.
Medium shot of Catherine clutching her father's arm, her bridal bouquet drooping as panic seizes her face.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Rupert...
Medium close-up of Rupert gripping the edge of a pew for balance, his eyes wild with terror.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: You cannot be him. Alexander died!
Wide tracking shot behind Alexander as he advances down the center aisle, silhouetted against the ruins of the cathedral nave.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon.
Medium shot of an elderly silver-haired woman in simple ivory robes stepping into the aisle, her hands outstretched in trembling awe.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Alexander...
Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Mother.
His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Look at you... my beautiful boy.
Medium two-shot framed down the ruined nave between Alexander and his mother.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I have come home, Mother.
Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!
Medium shot of Rupert cowering on the altar steps beside Catherine and her father, utterly defeated.
Tight close-up on Alexander, his hand resting on the hilt of his sabre as his eyes burn with fierce, cold retribution.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text:
And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole."

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Yes, Your Honor.

units.text: Tell the truth.
Close-up of Prudence breaking down in tears, squeezing her eyes shut as guilt overwhelms her.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Yes.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking at her former maid, a momentary flicker of hurt passing through her eyes before settling into stoic composure.
Medium profile shot of the Judge recording notes in the open court ledger with a feather quill.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: What did you see?
Medium close-up of Prudence clutching both hands to her chest in anguish.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: She used herbs... and her mother's book.

Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No!
Medium close-up of Catherine holding up the oval silver and amethyst pendant, inspecting it with disdain.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?
Close-up of Juliana crying out in agony, writhing in the guard's iron grip.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Give it back!

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It belonged to my mother!
Low-angle shot tracking the silver locket as Catherine casually flings it across the stone corridor floor.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: A witch has no need for family heirlooms in the gallows.
Metallic clatter as the silver pendant bounces against the wooden baseboard.
Medium shot of Juliana being dragged further into the doorway, staring helplessly toward her discarded locket.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: My mother's locket!
Medium shot of Catherine walking toward the fallen leather-bound book and kneeling gracefully to pick it up.
Catherine lifts the heavy herbarium, dusting off the cover before opening its aged parchment pages.
Tight close-up of Catherine reading the elegant cursive script inside the front cover.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Juliana...
Extreme close-up on the handwritten inscription: 'Juliana Ashcroft'.
Medium shot of Juliana freezing in the doorway as she sees Catherine opening her mother's book.
Juliana gasps in horror, realizing her secret identity has been laid bare.
Close-up of Catherine raising her gaze slowly from the book, a wicked, triumphant grin spreading across her face.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft.
Medium two-shot as Catherine steps deliberately up to Juliana, circling her like a predator savoring its prey.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I knew I had seen those eyes before.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: The disgraced daughter...

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: ...the girl thrown out of her own family home.
Close-up two-shot of Catherine leaning inches from Juliana's face, whispering her humiliating past.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: The bride who married a penniless war veteran...

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You're certain?
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes with resolute conviction.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I have to be.
Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander, I need hot water.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I'm on it.
Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: Please save him.
Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.
Medium close-up of Juliana clasping the mother's trembling hand across the wooden table.
Close-up of Juliana exhaling a deep breath of relief, smiling gently.
Close-up of the mother looking up at Juliana with overwhelming gratitude.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: You saved him.
Medium close-up of Juliana grasping the mother's hand with warm modesty.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: The herbs did their work. Let him rest.
Juliana places a comforting hand over the mother's hands.
The mother gathers her sleeping son in her arms and steps back toward the rainy doorway.
Medium shot from inside the cottage framing the mother standing at the open door looking back.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you.
The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You cannot let the whole village start talking about you.
Medium close-up of Juliana placing the mortar back onto the table, unflinching.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A child's life matters more than gossip.
Close-up of Alexander, his jaw clenched with protective anxiety.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous.
Medium two-shot profile of Juliana stepping directly in front of Alexander, looking steadfastly up into his eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Then we will face it together.

The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: What is it?
Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: There is a rumor going around, my Lord.
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: What rumor?

units.text: What were their illnesses?

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Irrelevant.
Close-up of Lady Juliana gritting her teeth in fierce defiance.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: It is not irrelevant!
Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana standing tall against the courtroom window light, her chained hands resting on the balustrade as she addresses the entire hall.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Herbs are not magic! They are medicine!

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: You admit you administered them?
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking straight forward.

units.text: Close-up of Juliana recoiling slightly in shock at the blatant cruelty.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I cannot do that.
The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.

Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: You are a maid.
Low-angle shot looking past the bedpost toward the Duchess, whose trembling hand reaches out limply.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Not a physician. Not a lady.
Dramatic low-angle wide shot of the noblewoman standing imperiously over the doubled-over Juliana.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters.
Close-up of Juliana looking down, enduring the humiliation while stifling her breath.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Yes, my lady.
Medium shot of the noblewoman turning the crop in her white-gloved hands with smug satisfaction.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place.
The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.
Low tracking shot down the corridor as the hem of the lilac dress sweeps past, followed by Juliana's swift steps.
Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.
Wide shot of the vast soot-stained stone fireplace. The noblewoman turns back toward Juliana, crop held at her side.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Clean it.
Medium shot of the noblewoman extending her gloved hand toward the cavernous, filth-laden hearth.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at the towering, soot-blackened chimney.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: All of it, my lady?
Extreme close-up two-shot as the noblewoman steps unnervingly close to Juliana's face, whispering with sadistic relish.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are.
Juliana slowly drops to her knees on the cold flagstones before the soot-filled fireplace.
Medium shot of Juliana sinking to her knees, her face grim and composed.
Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.
Close-up of Prudence's anxious, trembling face.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: My lady—

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Do you want the same punishment?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: A traitor?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Yes.
Medium shot framing both of them across the wooden table bathed in amber lantern glow.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: We were close to finding him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then came the ambush.
Close-up on Alexander's scarred hand clenching into a fist, furiously crumbling the parchment map beneath his knuckles.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: My men were slaughtered.
Close-up of his mother clutching at her throat, tears glistening in her eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: And you?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I was shot. Left for dead.
Medium shot of his mother placing both hands on the table, leaning forward in disbelief.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: How did you escape?
Close-up on Alexander, his eyes dark with the harrowing memory.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead.
Close-up on his mother as her expression shifts to profound bewilderment and outrage.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Then why did they never tell us?

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I have nowhere to go, Your Grace.
Low-angle shot tracking Catherine clutching her chest in agony.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: London closed its doors! My family disowned me!
Medium close-up of Lady Ashbourne, her gloved hand resting on her cane as she delivers her cold judgment.

units.speaker: LADY ASHBOURNE
units.text: She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road.
Medium shot of Vaughn drawing his baton, ready to seize Catherine from behind.

units.speaker: VAUGHN
units.text: One command, Your Grace, and I drag her past the gates.
Wide shot as Alexander strides purposefully into the courtyard alongside Juliana, his coat billowing behind him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!
Close-up of Catherine collapsed on the wet stones, looking up with tear-streaked panic.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Please, Alexander! Have mercy!
Medium shot of Juliana raising her right hand firmly to halt the guard.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Stop.
Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana in sheer disbelief.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana, she tried to destroy you!
Close-up of Juliana maintaining serene poise.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: She did.
Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps gracefully past Alexander toward Catherine.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud.
Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it.
Close-up of Catherine's face turning from despair to offended shock.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You want me? As a guest?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: As a scullery maid.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?

units.text: Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in stunned revelation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant.
Side-angle medium shot of the bed, the Duchess holding onto Juliana's forearm with fierce insistence.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: My lost son wore that ring!
Close-up of Juliana looking down with compassionate concern.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Did your husband serve beside him?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No one.
Close-up of Lady Catherine turning fiercely triumphant.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: Then you administered it without permission.
Close-up of Juliana, her voice rising passionately.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Because she was dying!
Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman pacing forward with calculating malice.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?
Close-up of Juliana retorting without hesitation.

units.text: Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: I know what happened to me!
Medium low-angle shot past the Duchess pointing directly at Rupert, who stands rigid and expressionless.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: I was poisoned!

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: And you... you knew!
Medium shot of the Duchess lunging forward from the pillows, gasping for breath as she points toward Catherine.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Catherine knew!

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: They have been—
The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.
Wide shot as Juliana lunges across the room toward the bed, but the armed guard seizes her from behind and drags her back.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Let me help her!

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!
Medium close-up of Rupert smoothing down his black leather gloves, a chilling smile forming on his lips.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: You see?

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: The poison has clearly damaged her mind.
Over-the-shoulder shot of Rupert leaning menacingly over the gasping Duchess in bed.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: I am not delusional!

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Of course you are not.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: You are merely confused.
Medium profile tracking shot of Catherine walking deliberately toward Juliana, speaking with airy cynicism.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists...

units.text: You are merely confused.
Medium profile tracking shot of Catherine walking deliberately toward Juliana, speaking with airy cynicism.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists...

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: ...is the maid who claims to have discovered it.
Low-angle medium shot of Rupert turning sharply toward the guard, his eyes icy and authoritative.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house.
Tight close-up of Catherine's gloved hands grabbing the delicate chain around Juliana's neck.
Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No!
Medium close-up of Catherine holding up the oval silver and amethyst pendant, inspecting it with disdain.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?

units.text: Close-up on Juliana, her manacled hands clutching at her smock as tears well in her eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander...
Close-up on Alexander, his gaze softening momentarily toward her.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana.
Medium shot of Rupert descending the altar steps, furiously pointing toward Alexander.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Guards! Arrest this imposter!
Medium shot of the royal guardsman standing rigidly in red uniform and bearskin cap, resting his white-gloved hand on his sabre.

units.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
units.text: We will not.
Close-up on Rupert, veins bulging in his neck as his composure shatters.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Mother.
His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Look at you... my beautiful boy.
Medium two-shot framed down the ruined nave between Alexander and his mother.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I have come home, Mother.
Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!
Medium shot of Rupert cowering on the altar steps beside Catherine and her father, utterly defeated.
Tight close-up on Alexander, his hand resting on the hilt of his sabre as his eyes burn with fierce, cold retribution.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text:
And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole."

units.text: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in her disheveled burgundy gown, clutching her skirts and weeping profusely.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I have nowhere to go, Your Grace.
Low-angle shot tracking Catherine clutching her chest in agony.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: London closed its doors! My family disowned me!
Medium close-up of Lady Ashbourne, her gloved hand resting on her cane as she delivers her cold judgment.
Wide shot as Alexander strides purposefully into the courtyard alongside Juliana, his coat billowing behind him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!
Close-up of Catherine collapsed on the wet stones, looking up with tear-streaked panic.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Please, Alexander! Have mercy!
Medium shot of Juliana raising her right hand firmly to halt the guard.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Stop.
Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana in sheer disbelief.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana, she tried to destroy you!
Close-up of Juliana maintaining serene poise.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: She did.
Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps gracefully past Alexander toward Catherine.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud.
Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it.
Close-up of Catherine's face turning from despair to offended shock.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You want me? As a guest?
Close-up of Juliana staring straight into Catherine's eyes without blinking.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: As a scullery maid.
Medium shot of Catherine recoiling in disgust, looking around at the gathered estate retainers.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?

units.text: Medium low-angle shot on Gerald at the altar steps, looking down dismissively, while Clarissa in her shimmering gold gown stands behind him gloating.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: I cannot marry you, Juliana.
Medium close-up on Juliana trembling in disbelief, her hands clasped tightly to her chest.
Juliana gasps softly in heartbreak, her eyes wide and brimming with tears.
Medium shot returning to Gerald, sneering down at Juliana.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: You are far too plain...
Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face, crushed under his biting words.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: ...far too silent...
Medium shot on Gerald turning slightly toward Clarissa as she smiles admiringly at him.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: ...and completely beneath the future I deserve.
Wide shot down the aisle as Juliana takes an agonizing step forward toward the altar, extending a trembling hand.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Gerald... Look at me.
Close-up on Gerald's cold, merciless face staring ahead unblinkingly.
Tight insert on Juliana's hand clutching the heirloom amethyst pendant resting against her gown.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You gave me your word before both our families.
Medium two-shot of Gerald and Clarissa standing side by side before the priest.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: Promises change when a better choice appears.
Medium close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her voice quivering with disbelief.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: A better choice? Is that what she is?
Wide shot from behind Juliana looking up the altar stairs at Gerald with Clarissa linked to his arm.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: She is what I should have chosen from the beginning.
Medium shot of Juliana's father seated prominently in the family pew, clutching his gold-topped cane.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Father...
Close-up of the father's stern, unyielding face.
Medium shot of Juliana turning toward her father in the pews, imploring him.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Surely you will not let him humiliate me like this?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You're certain?
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes with resolute conviction.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I have to be.
Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander, I need hot water.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I'm on it.
Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: Please save him.
Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.
Medium close-up of Juliana clasping the mother's trembling hand across the wooden table.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He is not beyond saving.
Close-up of Juliana carefully administering the herbal brew with a small wooden spoon into the sick boy's mouth.
The child swallows weakly and lets out a soft cough.
Close-up of the mother clutching her chest in anxious suspense.
Medium close-up of Juliana sitting quietly beside the boy, holding two fingers over his wrist to monitor his pulse.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the mother leaning across the table in panic.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: Why isn't it working?
Close-up of Juliana raising a calm finger, urging patience.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Wait.
Close-up of the sleeping boy as beads of sweat form on his forehead, his breathing deepening.
Close-up of the mother gently caressing her son's cheek, sobbing with relief.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: His fever... it's breaking.
Close-up of Juliana exhaling a deep breath of relief, smiling gently.
Close-up of the mother looking up at Juliana with overwhelming gratitude.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: You saved him.
Medium close-up of Juliana grasping the mother's hand with warm modesty.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: The herbs did their work. Let him rest.
Juliana places a comforting hand over the mother's hands.
The mother gathers her sleeping son in her arms and steps back toward the rainy doorway.
Medium shot from inside the cottage framing the mother standing at the open door looking back.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you.
The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You cannot let the whole village start talking about you.
Medium close-up of Juliana placing the mortar back onto the table, unflinching.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A child's life matters more than gossip.
Close-up of Alexander, his jaw clenched with protective anxiety.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous.
Medium two-shot profile of Juliana stepping directly in front of Alexander, looking steadfastly up into his eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Then we will face it together.
Wide shot of an opulent gothic manor study. The Blond Nobleman sits in a velvet armchair beside a roaring fireplace, reading an open leather-bound book.
The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.
Medium shot framing the Blond Nobleman in the foreground as The Former Groom halts respectfully behind his chair.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: What is it?
Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: There is a rumor going around, my Lord.
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: What rumor?

hook_text: Suspenseful opening question; Intense close-up camera hook; Kinetic dramatic action; High-arousal physical trigger
cliffhanger_text: Unanswered question ('What rumor?...'); Cliffhanger delivered with Coldly Curious; Dramatic close-up freeze-frame cut
why_it_works: Hooks scrolling viewers via suspenseful opening question and builds rapid relationship conflict, cutting off at peak curiosity with unanswered question ('what rumor?...') to drive immediate click-through to Episode 2.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Wrong answer.
Alexander tightens his grip on the thug's throat, lifting him higher against the stone wall.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Who?!
Extreme close-up of the terrified thug gasping for air, his eyes bulging.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: Harrington! Gerald Harrington paid us!
Close-up of Juliana on the ground, reeling in devastated disbelief as the betrayal hits her.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Gerald...
Medium wide shot as Alexander releases the thug, sending him tumbling into the ruined flowerbeds.
The Thug with Cap scrambles to his feet and sprints into the dark woods alongside his two limping accomplices.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: We were only paid to destroy the garden, that's all!
Close-up on Alexander's hand hanging by his coat. Fresh blood trickles from his split knuckles, and he slowly curls his fingers into a tight fist.
Alexander flexes his bleeding hand, showing no sign of pain.
Medium shot as Juliana gingerly rises to her feet, stepping toward Alexander with deep awe and wonder in her eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You knew exactly what to do.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, searching his scarred face.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You fought like you've done this a hundred times.
Medium close-up of Alexander turning his profile away, shadowed by haunted memories of his past.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: A soldier learns things he wishes he could forget.
Close-up of Juliana softening with deep empathy as her eyes drop to his bleeding knuckle.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Are you hurt?
Juliana reaches out toward his injured hand with delicate concern.

units.text: Close-up of Catherine throwing her hands up in explosive defensiveness.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And what is wrong with that?!
Close-up of Catherine's face twisting in absolute venom.
Close-up of Juliana looking serene.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it.
Medium shot of Catherine standing motionless, holding the iron rod, struck to the core by the insult.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow...
Low-angle shot of Juliana's chained hands folded peacefully in her lap.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up with quiet pity.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: ...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you.
Medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely, raising the branding poker like a weapon and screaming.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Silence! Silence!
Close-up of Catherine's crazed, gasping face.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Why?!
Close-up of Juliana crying out her defiance.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Because I am right!
Low-angle tracking shot of the red-hot branding tip trailing across the wet dungeon floor, steaming.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You want everyone to believe you are powerful.
Medium shot of Juliana sitting under the cold skylight bars, her posture majestic despite her imprisonment.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You want everyone to fear you.
Medium shot of Juliana looking directly at Catherine, gestures restrained by the heavy iron chains.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: But look at you.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes burning with fiery contempt.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!
Close-up of Catherine trembling with uncontrollable rage, teeth bared.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You insolent—!
Medium shot of Catherine gripping the glowing tongs as Juliana continues speaking over her.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You may have the title you have always wanted...

units.text: Close-up on Alexander's scarred hand clenching into a fist, furiously crumbling the parchment map beneath his knuckles.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: My men were slaughtered.
Close-up of his mother clutching at her throat, tears glistening in her eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: And you?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I was shot. Left for dead.
Medium shot of his mother placing both hands on the table, leaning forward in disbelief.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: How did you escape?
Close-up on Alexander, his eyes dark with the harrowing memory.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead.
Close-up on his mother as her expression shifts to profound bewilderment and outrage.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Then why did they never tell us?
Close-up on Alexander's intense, piercing gaze.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Who?
Alexander turns away toward the frosted window, staring out into the dark raging blizzard outside.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I spent three years trying to find out.
Alexander abruptly pushes away from the window, storming back toward the table with burning rage.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: The ambush was not an accident.
He leans heavily over the wooden table, looming close as his fury boils over.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Someone ordered my men to die.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Someone wanted me erased.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Who?

units.text: Low-angle shot looking down along the polished stone floor as the guard's sword tip grounds firmly between Rupert and the guards.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: I am Lord Rupert Ashburn!
Medium close-up on Rupert thumping his chest in indignant disbelief.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Your Duke!
Medium shot framing the Guard Captain and Alexander in profile.
The Guard Captain snaps a crisp salute toward Alexander.

units.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
units.text: No. He is your Duke.
Medium shot on Catherine in her bridal gown and Lord Henry Sterling seated in the front pew, both frozen in stunned shock.
Lord Sterling clutches his gold-headed walking cane tightly, his jaw clenching as tension spreads through the church.
Medium shot on Rupert spinning toward the gathered congregation, his hands flailing.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: You have all been deceived!
Medium close-up on Alexander, commanding and icy.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then let the Crown decide.
Close-up on Alexander's hands holding an official War Office document bundle sealed with red wax and ribbon.
Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.
Medium shot of Alexander holding up the sealed parcel before the room.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Read the first.
Close-up on Lord Sterling looking sideways, his face pale with rising dread.
Two-shot of Alexander handing the dossier to a Crown Military Magistrate wearing white gloves and a high-collared black uniform.
The Crown Official receives the dossier solemnly with both hands.
Medium close-up on the Crown Official opening the binder and reading aloud.
Crisp sound of parchment turning.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Military Intelligence Report, Iberian front, three years ago.
Close-up on Rupert staring wide-eyed, completely petrified.
Medium close-up on the Crown Official continuing the official reading.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised.
Frontal medium shot of the Crown Official turning a page as the congregation listens in breathless silence.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: The report identifies the leak as deliberate.
Wide shot across the rubble of the cathedral floor showing Rupert crumbling in fear against the choir railing.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Information regarding the Duke's position was transmitted through British channels.
Rupert staggers backward, his knees buckling as he leans his weight heavily on the stone balustrade.
Close-up on Rupert clinging to the stone pillar, his breath shallow and terrified.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: No...

units.text: Close-up on Lord Sterling's trembling, indignant face.

units.speaker: LORD STERLING
units.text: You have no authority!
Close-up on the Constable's black-gloved hands holding out a thick, red-ribboned dossier stamped with the Crown's royal wax seal.

units.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE
units.text: I have more than enough.

units.speaker: CATHERINE

Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.

units.speaker: CATHERINE

Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.

units.speaker: CATHERINE

Medium shot on the lead royal guard squaring his shoulders, barring the stranger's advance while Juliana stands behind him.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER

Juliana softly shakes her head 'no', her wide blue eyes locked onto him.
Close-up profile of The Bearded Stranger casting a sharp, menacing glance toward the other guard.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER

Close-up of Juliana's elderly father looking down, gripping his hands nervously with profound guilt.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: I can...
Medium shot of guests in the pews whispering and reacting in hushed shock.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: ...when your family is dragging a defenseless woman from a church.
Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger and Lady Juliana framed against the illuminated stained-glass rose window.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: You shouldn't have to beg anybody...

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander...

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: ...are you safe?
Intimate close-up of Juliana looking upward, her tear-stained face filled with raw anguish.

units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Medicine.
Close-up of Lady Catherine tapping her gloved finger to her lip, letting out a mocking scoff.

Close-up of Juliana holding her ground.

units.text: No one.

units.text: What?

Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did.
Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You know nothing about my world.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I know exactly what your world values.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Beauty. Money.
Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.
Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Family. A perfect name.
Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her.
Close-up of Catherine throwing her hands up in explosive defensiveness.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And what is wrong with that?!
Close-up of Catherine's face twisting in absolute venom.
Close-up of Juliana looking serene.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it.
Medium shot of Catherine standing motionless, holding the iron rod, struck to the core by the insult.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow...

units.text: ...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me.

units.speaker: JULIANA

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He lost me.

units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You call that marriage?
Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I call it love.
High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: [laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: To a place where I can still look you in the eyes.
Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You think love makes you better than me?
Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me.
Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?
Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Knowledge. Love. And people who need me.
Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: [scoffs] Peasants? People?

units.text: Medium close-up of Alexander's mother leaning over the map, her voice cracking.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: And when you disappeared...?
Close-up on Alexander, his voice low and cutting.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They declared me dead.
Medium shot from the side of the wooden table as his mother brings both hands up to cover her mouth in overwhelmed grief.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They falsified what remained of the reports.
Alexander's mother presses her trembling hands against her lips, tears brimming in her eyes.
Tight close-up on his mother weeping openly, her ring catching the warm lamplight as she lowers her hand to her heart.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: And Rupert took Ashbourne.
Tight close-up on Alexander's piercing blue-grey eyes, unwavering and hardened by years of exile.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: While the world mourned a dead heir.
Close-up on his mother's sorrowful gaze lifting toward him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: And I mourned you.
Medium shot of Alexander looking down, his harsh features softening momentarily with sorrow.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I know.
Medium close-up on his mother bowing her head toward the rustic tabletop, weeping in utter despair.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: I trusted them.
Wide shot as Alexander stands tall beside the weeping mother seated at the table.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You trusted family.
Profile close-up of Alexander stepping closer to the door, staring out into the falling snow.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They used that trust against you.
Alexander steps back toward the table, leaning in urgently toward his mother.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Mother... Juliana...
Medium close-up on Alexander leaning both hands on the table, desperate for answers.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: She went into Ashbourne Manor to save you. She never came back.
Tight close-up on Alexander's strained, furrowed brow.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I thought perhaps she stayed with you.
Close-up of his mother looking up at him, agony and hesitation washing over her face.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Alexander...

units.text: Close-up of Gerald lunging forward, aggressively pointing his finger into Juliana's face.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: And your husband?
Wide shot down a dark, fog-drenched forest path. A towering, shadowed figure walks steadily forward through the mist.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Where is that beggar husband?
The Scarred Bearded Man marches purposefully toward the cottage, carrying a heavy bundle of chopped firewood bound tightly with hemp cord.
Medium tracking shot pushing in on the Scarred Bearded Man's stern, rugged face as he approaches the gate.
Low shot of the Scarred Bearded Man bending down and dropping the bundle of logs by the stone wall.
A dull, heavy thud of timber striking the mud.
Medium full shot as the Scarred Bearded Man straightens to his full imposing height and steps directly toward Gerald.
Two-shot framing the Scarred Bearded Man towering menacingly over Gerald, staring down at him with unyielding intensity.
Gerald freezes, his arrogant bravado instantly vanishing as cold dread overtakes his face.
Low-angle close-up of Gerald looking up in sheer terror, his adam's apple bobbing nervously.

units.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
units.text: Gerald, don't let him frighten you.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: What are you staring at?
Gerald rapidly turns on his heel toward the carriage, unwilling to face another second of the silent glare.

units.text: Tight close-up of the Dowager Duchess's aged, trembling hands clutching Juliana's hand, examining the worn metal band on her finger.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: This ring...
Low-angle medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped against her pillows, gripping Juliana's wrist firmly as she gazes up in desperate demand.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Look at me, girl. Who gave this to you?
Medium shot of Juliana in her maid's apron, startled and anxious as she answers.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: My husband. He gave it to me when we wed.
Low angle on the Dowager Duchess, her eyes burning with intensity.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: He is no commoner. What does he do?
Close-up of Juliana, trying to keep her composure.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula.
Medium two-shot as the Duchess leans forward slightly, staring at the ring between their joined hands.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest.
Close-up on Juliana, shaking her head in disbelief and growing confusion.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word.
Low-angle shot on the Duchess, tears welling in her eyes as grief and shock overtake her.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war...
Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in stunned revelation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant.
Side-angle medium shot of the bed, the Duchess holding onto Juliana's forearm with fierce insistence.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: My lost son wore that ring!
Close-up of Juliana looking down with compassionate concern.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Did your husband serve beside him?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival.
Close-up of the Duchess gazing up at Juliana, her voice barely a whisper.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: What is your husband's name?

units.text: Close-up of the Lady in Gold Gown smirking derisively.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: I didn't steal what was never truly yours.
Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips, refusing to break down.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: This was my wedding.
Side medium shot of Gerald looking away impassively as the Lady in Gold Gown leans back against him.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: It was supposed to be.
Close-up of the Lady in Gold Gown beaming triumphantly.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: Now it is mine.
Low-angle wide shot of an imperious Noble Matriarch in a lavish black velvet gown and jeweled tiara stepping forward.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: Enough, Juliana.
Medium close-up of the Noble Matriarch glaring down with icy contempt.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: You have humiliated this family enough for one day.
Close-up on Juliana, tears shimmering in her eyes as betrayal strikes deep.
Medium shot on Juliana as she speaks out against her family's injustice.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I was humiliated by your family.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: And my father said nothing.
Medium close-up on the Noble Matriarch, completely unsympathetic.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: Your father has made his choice.
Close-up on Juliana's stricken, vulnerable face.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: And what happens to me?
Close-up of the Noble Matriarch delivering her verdict.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: You leave.
Close-up on Juliana blinking in disbelief.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Leave where?
Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch looking down her nose in disdain.

units.text: Medium shot of Juliana freezing in the doorway as she sees Catherine opening her mother's book.
Juliana gasps in horror, realizing her secret identity has been laid bare.
Close-up of Catherine raising her gaze slowly from the book, a wicked, triumphant grin spreading across her face.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft.
Medium two-shot as Catherine steps deliberately up to Juliana, circling her like a predator savoring its prey.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I knew I had seen those eyes before.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: The disgraced daughter...

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: ...the girl thrown out of her own family home.
Close-up two-shot of Catherine leaning inches from Juliana's face, whispering her humiliating past.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: The bride who married a penniless war veteran...

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: ...because no respectable man would have her.
Tight close-up of Juliana's eyes blazing with explosive fury and defensive loyalty.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Do not speak about my husband!
Medium two-shot as Catherine throws her head back in derisive laughter, brandishing the herbarium book.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And look at you now. Scrubbing fireplaces in my house.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: What a magnificent fall, Lady Juliana.
Medium shot of Rupert gesturing toward the exit with an outstretched arm.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Drag her to the wet cells beneath the south tower.
Close-up of Catherine fanning open the illustrated botanical pages of the herbarium with gloved fingers.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And this?

units.text: Tight close-up of the Thug with Cap stepping aggressively into Juliana's personal space, snarling with venom.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: Get out of the way!
Extreme close-up on Juliana's piercing blue eyes and set jaw, unflinching.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No.
The Thug with Cap violently shoves Juliana back with both hands; she cries out as she loses her balance and crashes hard onto the wet stone path.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Ah!
Close-up tracking down to Juliana's hand hitting the mud next to the crushed chamomile flowers.
Juliana crawls forward on her elbows; fresh crimson blood seeps profusely through her white gauze bandages as she reaches for the ruined blossoms.
Tight close-up on Juliana's mud-streaked, tear-stained face trembling in heartbreaking agony.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: My mother's plants...
Low-angle wide shot of the three thugs pointing and laughing hysterically at her kneeling form.

units.speaker: BALD THUG
units.text: Look at her! Crying over weeds!
The Tall Thug hoists his heavy wooden club above his head to crush the remaining herbs right before Juliana.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Stop!
Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap suddenly stiffening, his smug smile dropping as footsteps pound in the darkness.
Medium tracking shot as Alexander charges past the corner of the cottage into the misty moonlight, his dark coat billowing behind him.
Alexander storms forward with lethal intensity, dark hair flying, breath misting in the cold, radiating untamed rage.
Close-up of Juliana looking up through wet lashes, trembling as shock transforms into overwhelming relief.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander...
Wide shot of the three thugs wheeling around to face the dark figure approaching from the mist.
Low-angle tracking shot from behind Alexander's broad shoulders as he steadily steps past the fallen Juliana, towering over the intruders.
Alexander places himself directly between Juliana and the three thugs, staring them down with cold, deadly intent.
Medium shot of the three thugs regrouping, the Thug with Cap feigning swagger as he grips his club.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: What? You want to fight us, veteran?
Close-up of Juliana looking up with wide, anxious eyes, breath hitching in suspense as violence hangs on a knife's edge.

units.text: The maid gasps in sheer terror, her chest heaving as tears stream.
Close-up of the maid clutching her chest with trembling hands, crying desperately.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: Please, my Lord... he is only seven!
Close-up of the Lord staring down without an ounce of pity.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Then help him.
Close-up of the maid weeping profusely, cornered and helpless.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: What do you want me to say?!
Wide shot of the study as the Lord stands calmly before the trembling servant.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: The truth.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: She drew something around the bed, did she not?
Close-up of the maid stammering through her tears.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: She... placed dried herbs around him.
Medium close-up of the Lord standing right beside her shoulder, whispering in her ear like an insidious specter.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Around him.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Like a circle?

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: Yes.
Close-up from behind the maid as the Lord leans close to her ear.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: And she opened her mother's book...
Extreme close-up of the maid's tear-drenched eyes and quivering lips.
