units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Did she draw strange markings?
Close-up of Prudence's tear-streaked face as she hesitates, her breath hitching.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: She... placed herbs around my brother's bed.
Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched index finger with piercing intensity.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: And did she speak words you could not understand?
Extreme close-up of Prudence weeping uncontrollably, her face contorted in unbearable remorse.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Yes.
Medium tracking shot of the Lord stepping into the open aisle of the courtroom with arms spread wide, turning triumphantly toward the Judge.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Your Honor... the witness has confirmed the ritual.
Lady Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the wooden railing of the dock, her voice ringing out in indignant fury.
Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana gripping the railing, leaning forward.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: It was not a ritual!
The Judge repeatedly hammers his gavel down onto the desk, roaring over her.
Medium shot of the Judge striking the wooden block twice in rapid succession.
[Violent, resonant double bang of the wooden gavel]

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: You will speak when addressed!
Medium shot of the Lord extending his palm toward the gallery with theatrical composure.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: We have further witnesses.
Medium shot of an anxious townsman standing by the gallery pews, nervously wringing his woolen hat in his hands.

units.speaker: TOWNSMAN
units.text: My wife took one of Lady Juliana's mixtures...
Close-up of the Judge glaring down expectantly.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: And?

units.text: Close-up on Juliana, stunned by the callous depth of the conspiracy.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: How long?
Medium two-shot of the Lady in Gold Gown and Gerald looking together down at Juliana.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: Long enough to know he was never going to marry you.
Juliana turns abruptly toward the first row of pews, where her elderly father sits gripping an ornate brass cane.
Close-up on the father's hand tightly gripping the gold curved handle of his walking cane.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Father...
Wide shot showing Juliana dropping to her knees beside her seated father, pleading with him.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Tell them this is a mistake.
Close-up on the father's weathered face, looking fixedly at the floor, refusing to meet her gaze.
Close-up on Juliana looking up at him, tears streaming uncontrollably down her cheeks.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Father... please look at me.
The father tightens his jaw and stony expression, refusing to offer a single word or look.
Profile close-up of the father staring blankly forward.
Low-angle shot looking up at the Matriarch commanding the space with regal severity.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: Enough!

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: You have embarrassed this family long enough.
Close-up on Juliana as she rises, stung by the utter betrayal.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Embarrassed you?

units.text: Close-up of the Noble Matriarch delivering her verdict.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: You leave.
Close-up on Juliana blinking in disbelief.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Leave where?
Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch looking down her nose in disdain.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: Wherever a discarded daughter belongs.
Low-angle close-up focusing on Juliana's neck as her fingers desperately clutch the oval locket.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: This is my mother's church.
Close-up on Juliana's face, teeth clenched in desperate defiance.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I have every right to stand here.
Tight close-up of the Noble Matriarch leaning in with vicious delight.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: Not anymore.
Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch gesturing expansively to the filled cathedral nave behind her.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: Your father has chosen his family...
Close-up profile of the Noble Matriarch's piercing eyes glaring directly at Juliana.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: ...and it isn't you.
The Noble Matriarch turns sharply toward the back of the chapel and barks an order.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: Guards! Remove her!
Medium shot as two royal guards in red uniforms and bearskin caps step in behind Juliana and seize her arms.
The guards forcefully grab Juliana by both shoulders and drag her backwards.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Let me go!
Close-up of Juliana's hand frantically grabbing the wooden rim of a pew, knuckles white with strain.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Please! Someone!
The guards tear her grip away from the pew.
Muffled scuffle, rustle of heavy silk and frantic gasps echoing off cathedral stone.
High wide shot down the vaulted cathedral aisle showing the entire congregation watching in stunned silence as the guards drag Juliana.
Wide eye-level shot looking down the petal-strewn marble aisle. A tall, rugged man in a worn dark trench coat—The Bearded Stranger—emerges into the center of the nave.
The Bearded Stranger steps deliberately into the aisle, his heavy boots echoing.
Close-up on the Noble Matriarch freezing in utter shock and outrage.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: Take your hands off her.
Medium tracking shot front-on as The Bearded Stranger marches down the flower-strewn aisle with resolute purpose.
Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch stepping forward on the altar steps, furiously pointing a finger at him.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!
High wide shot of the magnificent vaulted hall as The Bearded Stranger walks steadily forward, dwarfing the aisle.
Medium shot on the lead royal guard squaring his shoulders, barring the stranger's advance while Juliana stands behind him.

units.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
units.text: Stand aside, stranger!
Medium close-up profile on The Bearded Stranger, eyes burning with quiet, lethal resolve.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: I said...
Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's intense, scarred face.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: ...let her go.
Medium action shot as the guard charges toward The Bearded Stranger.
The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed guard instantly to the floor.
A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.
Medium close-up of Gerald turning frantically to the remaining guards and congregation, panicking.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!
Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger standing unmoved over the fallen guard, turning his gaze toward Juliana.
Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger stepping up to Lady Juliana, who gazes up at him in stunned breathlessness.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: Are you hurt?

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: A disgraced woman?
Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.

units.text: Medium close-up of a bald thug leaning over a lush bed of white medicinal chamomile herbs.
The bald thug roughly rips a massive handful of flowering herbs up by their roots, scattering soil across the path.
Medium shot framing the open doorway of the stone cottage, bathed in warm interior light against the dark night.
Juliana bursts through the cottage doorway, her hands wrapped in clean white bandages, freezing in horror at the destruction.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Stop! What are you doing?!
Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap holding the uprooted chamomile bouquet, sneering with cruel amusement.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: We're clearing this rubbish.
Close-up on Juliana, her face tight with anguish and fury as she clutches her bandaged hands against her chest.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Those are medicinal plants!
Low-angle shot tracking down from the bald thug's grinning face to his worn leather boots on the muddy flagstones.

units.speaker: BALD THUG
units.text: They look like weeds to me.
The bald thug flings the bouquet into the mud and grinds his heavy boot directly onto the delicate flowers.
High-angle two-shot as Juliana rushes forward and drops directly onto her knees in the cold mud before the thug.
Juliana frantically tries to scoop the crushed soil and torn stems back into the bed with her bandaged hands.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Please! Those plants took months to grow!
Medium two-shot of the Tall Thug with the club and the Thug with Cap bursting into raucous laughter under the full moon.

units.speaker: TALL THUG
units.text: Months? You actually spend your days growing this filth?
Tight close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands trembling as she tenderly gathers the soiled white flowers from the puddles.
Low-angle medium shot tilting up as Juliana rises from the ground, standing tall despite her trembling frame.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Leave my garden alone.
Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap scoffing derisively.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: A noble lady playing in the dirt. What a joke.

units.text: Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in stunned revelation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant.
Side-angle medium shot of the bed, the Duchess holding onto Juliana's forearm with fierce insistence.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: My lost son wore that ring!
Close-up of Juliana looking down with compassionate concern.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Did your husband serve beside him?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival.
Close-up of the Duchess gazing up at Juliana, her voice barely a whisper.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: What is your husband's name?
Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.
Juliana gasps, snapping her head toward the entrance in alarm.
The heavy mahogany double doors burst open, revealing the Blond Nobleman flanked by Lady Catherine and a royal guard in uniform.
Wide shot framing the open doorway as the aristocrats step into the dimly lit hallway.
Medium shot of Lady Catherine in her lavish cream gown and tiara, scowling with arrogant disdain.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: What is that maid doing in Her Grace's private chamber?
Medium shot of Juliana standing stiffly beside the bed, concealing her hands.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: She needed help.
Close-up of Lady Catherine narrowing her eyes with venomous suspicion.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: What are you hiding?
Close-up of Juliana, her chin raised.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Nothing.
Medium close-up of Lady Catherine pointing a white-gloved finger directly at Juliana.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: Show me your hand.
Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman stepping forward beside Lady Catherine, clad in a dark tailored coat with black leather gloves.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Girl. Show me what you are holding.
Two-shot of Juliana facing the Blond Nobleman as she slowly extends her palm, revealing the small amber glass dropper bottle.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: What is this?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Medicine.
Close-up of Lady Catherine tapping her gloved finger to her lip, letting out a mocking scoff.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: Medicine? You are a new maid.
Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman staring down at the vial, as Catherine sneers from his side.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?

hook_text: Intense close-up camera hook; Suspenseful opening question; High-tension delivery (Shocked, Breathless); High urgency/exclamation; High-tension delivery (Desperate, Clinging)
cliffhanger_text: Unanswered question ('Who permitted you to give medicine ...'); Dramatic close-up freeze-frame cut

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: ...a secret medicine in her hand.
Tight close-up of Catherine's smiling face, her eyes gleaming with vindictive pleasure.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: She looks exactly like a poisoner.
Close-up of Juliana glaring back in fierce indignation, breathing heavily as she resists the guard's arm across her shoulder.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I did not poison her! Look at her eyes, the fever has broken!
Medium full shot of Rupert standing beside the four-poster bed, calmly pulling on his black leather gloves.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: A clever story, girl.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: But the guards know how to extract the truth.
Medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess stirring against her pillows, lifting her trembling head with visible effort.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Rupert...
Medium shot of Rupert pausing mid-stride as he hears his mother's voice, slowly turning his head toward the bed.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Stop this!
Wide shot of the bedchamber framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess props herself up on one elbow and points an accusing finger.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: She is innocent.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: She saved me!
Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Your Grace...
Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: I know what happened to me!

units.text: Medium close-up of Prudence looking up with tears streaming down her pale face.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Yes, Your Honor.
Medium close-up of the Judge leaning forward with folded hands.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Did you witness Lady Juliana perform these treatments?
Profile over-the-shoulder shot from behind Prudence toward Lady Juliana standing bound in iron cuffs at the prisoner's dock.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Tell the truth.
Close-up of Prudence breaking down in tears, squeezing her eyes shut as guilt overwhelms her.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Yes.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking at her former maid, a momentary flicker of hurt passing through her eyes before settling into stoic composure.
Medium profile shot of the Judge recording notes in the open court ledger with a feather quill.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: What did you see?
Medium close-up of Prudence clutching both hands to her chest in anguish.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: She used herbs... and her mother's book.
Medium shot of the Judge leaning back slightly, pointing his hand accusingly.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Did she draw strange markings?
Close-up of Prudence's tear-streaked face as she hesitates, her breath hitching.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: She... placed herbs around my brother's bed.
Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched index finger with piercing intensity.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: And did she speak words you could not understand?
Extreme close-up of Prudence weeping uncontrollably, her face contorted in unbearable remorse.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Yes.
Medium tracking shot of the Lord stepping into the open aisle of the courtroom with arms spread wide, turning triumphantly toward the Judge.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Your Honor... the witness has confirmed the ritual.
Lady Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the wooden railing of the dock, her voice ringing out in indignant fury.
Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana gripping the railing, leaning forward.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: It was not a ritual!
The Judge repeatedly hammers his gavel down onto the desk, roaring over her.
Medium shot of the Judge striking the wooden block twice in rapid succession.
[Violent, resonant double bang of the wooden gavel]

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: You will speak when addressed!
Medium shot of the Lord extending his palm toward the gallery with theatrical composure.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: We have further witnesses.
Medium shot of an anxious townsman standing by the gallery pews, nervously wringing his woolen hat in his hands.

units.speaker: TOWNSMAN
units.text: My wife took one of Lady Juliana's mixtures...
Close-up of the Judge glaring down expectantly.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: And?
Close-up of the townsman's face tightening with coached distress.

units.text: Medium shot as Juliana stops midway down the aisle, confronted by a haughty matriarch in black velvet stepping into the foreground.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: You should turn around, Juliana.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Why?
Over-the-shoulder medium close-up past the Matriarch to Juliana, looking past her toward the altar.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Gerald is waiting for me.
Close-up on the Matriarch wearing an ornate tiara and sapphire jewelry, gazing down with merciless disdain.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: Not anymore.
Close-up on Juliana's stricken face as the weight of the words sinks in.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: What do you mean?
Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing dismissively toward the altar.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: Look for yourself.
Juliana walks forward past the Matriarch, her breath hitching as she approaches the altar steps, looking up in shock.
Medium front tracking shot moving backward ahead of Juliana as she advances down the center aisle.
Panning shot across the seated wedding guests whispering and casting judging glances from the wooden pews.
Low-angle shot from behind Juliana looking up at Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing proudly before the altar.
Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips and shocked, tearful blue eyes.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Gerald?

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Why are you holding her hand?
Close-up insert of Gerald's fingers firmly interlocked with the white-gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown.
Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown beaming with cruel triumph.

cliffhanger_text: Unanswered question ('Why are you holding her hand?...'); Cliffhanger delivered with Heartbroken; Dramatic close-up freeze-frame cut

units.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up from the page, stunned by her mother's written words.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Mother.
Medium shot of Prudence leaning in, candle trembling.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: What is it?
Two-shot of Juliana holding the open journal, reciting the matching symptoms to Prudence while the Duchess lies motionless in the background.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Weakness. Dry mouth. The discoloration beneath the nails. The slow wasting.
Close-up of Prudence staring back in stunned disbelief.
Medium close-up of Juliana speaking with absolute certainty.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I have seen these symptoms before.
Close-up of Prudence's terrified face.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: What are you saying?
Close-up of Juliana's hands snapping the leather journal shut on the bedside table beside an oil lamp.
Medium close-up of Juliana resting her hands on the closed journal, looking squarely at Prudence.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Someone is poisoning her.
Medium shot of Prudence gasping sharply and clamping both hands over her mouth in sheer horror.
Sharp intake of breath from Prudence.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Poison?
Extreme close-up pushing in tight on Lady Juliana's eyes as her expression hardens into fury and righteous disgust.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Arsenic.
Sudden violent coughing and sputtering from the Duchess.
Medium shot as the Duchess chokes and spasms on the bed; Juliana whips around immediately.
Medium tracking shot of Juliana rushing to the side table by the window, opening her satchel and setting out glass vials, a bowl, and dried herbal bundles.
Close-up of Prudence pleading desperately, tears flowing down her cheeks.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Can you save her?

cliffhanger_text: Unanswered question ('Can you save her?...'); Cliffhanger delivered with Desperate, Begging; Dramatic close-up freeze-frame cut

units.text: Close-up of Juliana lunging against the guard's grip, her teeth bared in indignation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You know that is a lie!
Medium shot of Catherine lifting her chin arrogantly against the stone backdrop.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I know exactly what I need him to believe.
Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the two guards.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You cannot just destroy it!
Tight close-up of Catherine's eyes narrowing into an icy, venomous gaze.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I can burn it.
Close-up of Juliana's stricken expression, her eyes widening in horror.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope...
Side close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward, her voice low and merciless.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: ...no one will remember what was written inside.
Close-up of Juliana screaming back in raw outrage.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You are doing this because I saved the Duchess!
Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her silk gown, contempt etched across her features.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I am doing this because women like you forget their place.
Quick pan from Juliana's apron up to Catherine's face.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You were cast out once.
Extreme close-up on Catherine's smiling lips and cold blue eyes.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You should have stayed forgotten.
Close-up of Juliana raising her chin, unwavering pride breaking through her tears.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: My husband will find me.
Medium shot of Catherine letting out a scornful laugh, tilting her head.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Your scarred soldier?
Close-up of Catherine's face hardening into sharp mockery.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: What exactly do you think a penniless veteran can do against Ashbrook?
Medium shot as the guard clamps a heavy hand on Juliana's shoulder, shoving her forward.

units.speaker: GUARD
units.text: Move along, girl.
Wide shot tracking behind the guards as they march Juliana down the vaulted, puddle-strewn corridor toward the heavy iron cell door.
Wide shot inside the pitch-dark cell as the heavy iron door swings open.
The guards shove Juliana violently into the cell; she falls hard onto all fours across the cold, wet stone floor.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Please!
The heavy iron door slams shut with a deafening metallic thud, and the massive exterior bolt grates locked.
Static shot of the locked iron door, deadlocked in total isolation.
Medium close-up of Juliana kneeling on the floor, clutching her chest as hyperventilation overtakes her.
Juliana trembles uncontrollably, her fingers digging into the collar of her rustic dress as terror washes over her.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's tear-drenched face crumpling in overwhelming grief.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Mother...

units.text: Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar.
Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Do you remember?
Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse.
Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.
Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And everyone watched you walk away alone.
Close-up pushing in on Juliana's illuminated, dignified face.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Gerald chose money.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Clarissa chose a coward.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I chose myself.
Close-up of Catherine's face tightening in disgust.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You chose a beggar.
Low-angle shot of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering pride.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I chose a man.
Medium shot of Catherine sneering down at her.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: A scarred nobody.
Medium shot of Juliana sitting erect against the dungeon wall, her hands resting calmly in her lap.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon.
Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You call that marriage?

units.text: Close-up on the Lord leaning forward abruptly, his piercing gaze bearing down.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: What herbs?
Close-up of the frightened maid looking down, shrinking back.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: I don't know.
Low-angle shot looking up at the imposing Lord towering above her.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: You watched her.
Close-up of the maid, tears beginning to glisten on her cheeks as she defends Juliana.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: I watched her save him.
Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning away slowly past the lamp-lit desk toward the rain-streaked window.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: That is not what I asked.
Medium two-shot framing the maid from behind as the Lord steps back toward her with commanding stillness.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Did she use her mother's book?
Close-up of the maid trembling, tears spilling down her face.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: Yes.
Close-up of the Lord's sinister, unyielding face.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Did she prepare things no physician had prescribed?
Medium shot of the maid clutching her hands together tightly, overwhelmed with guilt.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: Yes.
Close-up of the Lord's mouth curling into a sinister, predatory smile.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: And did she perform anything unusual?
Close-up of the maid gasping, shaking her head vigorously in panic.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: No!
Profile medium two-shot as the Lord looms inches from the maid's face.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Think carefully.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Your brother is still a pauper.
Extreme close-up of the Lord's cold eyes and hawkish profile speaking with chilling finality.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise.
The maid gasps in sheer terror, her chest heaving as tears stream.
Close-up of the maid clutching her chest with trembling hands, crying desperately.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: Please, my Lord... he is only seven!
Close-up of the Lord staring down without an ounce of pity.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Then help him.
Close-up of the maid weeping profusely, cornered and helpless.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: What do you want me to say?!

units.text: Close-up on Alexander, his expression freezing in complete shock.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Arrested?
Medium close-up as his mother clutches Alexander's forearms with desperate, pleading hands.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!
Close-up on Alexander, absolute fury erupting across his scarred face.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: But she saved you!
Close-up on his mother, clutching her chest in grief.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: I told them!
Medium shot of Alexander clenching his fists at his sides, trembling with rage.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You told them the truth!
Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They called her a witch!
Frontal medium shot of Alexander standing frozen, the weight of the realization crashing down on him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana... is in a cell?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander!
Alexander lunges across the room, tackling her to the wooden floor and covering her body entirely with his own.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Down!
Massive wooden beam crashes directly where Juliana had been standing, showering them in sparks.
Ground-level shot of Alexander lying on top of Juliana, his chest shielding her, his face smeared with soot.
Alexander lifts his head slightly, checking her face and cradling her cheek tenderly.

units.text: I've got you.
Wide shot of the walls collapsing in curtains of flame, cutting off all interior hallways.
Alexander scoops Juliana up in his arms, carrying her bridal-style as she clutches the ledger.
Juliana looks toward the side wall and points frantically at the parlor window.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: The window!

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Hold on to me.
Medium close-up of Alexander gritting his teeth, holding Juliana securely as she buries her face into his neck.
Slow-motion shot as Alexander sprints through the burning room toward the framed glass window.
Alexander leaps forward, using his shoulder and back to shatter through the burning window frame, carrying Juliana safely in his arms out into the night.
Loud explosion of shattering window glass and splintering wood.
Wide interior shot as the entire parlor collapses into an uncontrollable inferno of roaring flames.
Night exterior shot in the dark grass outside. Juliana sits over Alexander, brushing ashes from his face as he coughs and catches his breath.
Wide shot of villagers running toward the cottage carrying wooden water buckets through the smoke-filled darkness.
Close-up of Juliana kneeling in the mud, her face blackened with soot and tears streaming down her cheeks as she clutches the charred ledger.
Wide shot of the cottage completely consumed by towering flames against the dark night sky.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Our home...

units.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up from the page, stunned by her mother's written words.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Mother.
Medium shot of Prudence leaning in, candle trembling.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: What is it?
Two-shot of Juliana holding the open journal, reciting the matching symptoms to Prudence while the Duchess lies motionless in the background.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Weakness. Dry mouth. The discoloration beneath the nails. The slow wasting.
Medium close-up of Juliana speaking with absolute certainty.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I have seen these symptoms before.
Close-up of Prudence's terrified face.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: What are you saying?
Close-up of Juliana's hands snapping the leather journal shut on the bedside table beside an oil lamp.
Medium close-up of Juliana resting her hands on the closed journal, looking squarely at Prudence.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Someone is poisoning her.
Medium shot of Prudence gasping sharply and clamping both hands over her mouth in sheer horror.
Sharp intake of breath from Prudence.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Poison?
Extreme close-up pushing in tight on Lady Juliana's eyes as her expression hardens into fury and righteous disgust.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Arsenic.
Sudden violent coughing and sputtering from the Duchess.
Medium shot as the Duchess chokes and spasms on the bed; Juliana whips around immediately.
Medium tracking shot of Juliana rushing to the side table by the window, opening her satchel and setting out glass vials, a bowl, and dried herbal bundles.
Close-up of Prudence pleading desperately, tears flowing down her cheeks.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Can you save her?

units.text: Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar.
Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.
High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: [laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: To a place where I can still look you in the eyes.
Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You think love makes you better than me?
Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me.
Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?
Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Knowledge. Love. And people who need me.
Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: [scoffs] Peasants? People?

units.text: Medium shot of Alexander clenching his fists at his sides, trembling with rage.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You told them the truth!
Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They called her a witch!
Frontal medium shot of Alexander standing frozen, the weight of the realization crashing down on him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana... is in a cell?
Close-up of his mother clutching her temple, reeling in remembered trauma.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: She was taken before a magistrate.
Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes wild with terror for his wife.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And?!
Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They condemned her.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: No.
Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: She is to be executed.
Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: When?
Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: After the wedding.
Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: What wedding?
Profile close-up of his mother looking at him across the lantern light.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Rupert... and Catherine's.
A sudden dramatic metallic swell underscores the impending deadline.
Frontal close-up on his mother, solemn and resolute in her warning.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Two days from now.
Profile shot of Alexander as dark realization settles over his face, turning to a grim, predatory glare.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They are marrying in two days...

units.text: Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.
Medium shot of Juliana hunched over in pain, clutching her abdomen.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: You are a maid.
Low-angle shot looking past the bedpost toward the Duchess, whose trembling hand reaches out limply.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Not a physician. Not a lady.
Dramatic low-angle wide shot of the noblewoman standing imperiously over the doubled-over Juliana.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters.
Close-up of Juliana looking down, enduring the humiliation while stifling her breath.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Yes, my lady.
Medium shot of the noblewoman turning the crop in her white-gloved hands with smug satisfaction.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place.
The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.
Low tracking shot down the corridor as the hem of the lilac dress sweeps past, followed by Juliana's swift steps.
Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.
Wide shot of the vast soot-stained stone fireplace. The noblewoman turns back toward Juliana, crop held at her side.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Clean it.
Medium shot of the noblewoman extending her gloved hand toward the cavernous, filth-laden hearth.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at the towering, soot-blackened chimney.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: All of it, my lady?

units.text: Close-up of Catherine collapsed on the wet stones, looking up with tear-streaked panic.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Please, Alexander! Have mercy!
Medium shot of Juliana raising her right hand firmly to halt the guard.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Stop.
Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana in sheer disbelief.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana, she tried to destroy you!
Close-up of Juliana maintaining serene poise.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: She did.
Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps gracefully past Alexander toward Catherine.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud.
Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it.
Close-up of Catherine's face turning from despair to offended shock.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You want me? As a guest?
Close-up of Juliana staring straight into Catherine's eyes without blinking.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: As a scullery maid.
Medium shot of Catherine recoiling in disgust, looking around at the gathered estate retainers.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?

units.text: Medium close-up of Juliana, defiant and unflinching despite her soiled dress and damp hair.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You came all this way just to insult my home?
Close-up of Aristocratic Woman erupting into high-pitched, malicious laughter beneath her parasol.

units.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
units.text: Home? Look at your hands, Juliana.
Close-up of Juliana's mud-stained palms held open against her apron.

units.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
units.text: You look like a servant.
Close-up of Gerald's smug expression watching Juliana.
Medium close-up of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering dignity.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I work with my hands. There is no shame in that.
Close-up on Gerald's tightening jaw.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: You were born a lady.
Close-up on Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with unbroken pride.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: And I remain one.
Wide shot framing Juliana facing off against Gerald and Aristocratic Woman in the bleak courtyard.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: You chose that scarred beggar over a life of comfort.
Two-shot profile of Juliana looking straight into Gerald's eyes without flinching.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I chose a man who stood beside me when you walked away.
Intense close-up of Juliana dismissing him with utter contempt.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You have no authority here. Leave.

units.text: Extreme close-up on Alexander's scarred left cheek and wide, disbelieving blue eyes.
Close-up on his mother's tear-streaked face as her chin trembles and tears spill down her cheeks.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Alexander!
Close-up on Alexander as his hard expression crumbles into utter astonishment.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Mother?
She drops her walking staff and rushes forward, throwing her arms around Alexander's neck. He pulls her tightly into his chest.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: You're alive.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Mother.
She leans back slightly, her frail hand reaching up to gently cup his bearded, scarred cheek, staring into his eyes in disbelief.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: I buried you.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I know.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They told me you died. They told me your entire regiment was destroyed.
Close-up on Alexander's hardened, shadowed profile, his jaw tight with grim memories.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Most of them were.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Then how did you survive?
Side profile of Alexander as his eyes look into the distance, haunted by the past.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I wasn't supposed to.
Alexander steps over to the wooden table, looking down at the parchment map spread out under the lantern.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Three years ago, I was sent to the Iberian front.
Close-up of Alexander's weathered face looking down pensively as he recounts the mission.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies.
Alexander's scarred finger points to a red-circled location on the parchment map marked near Madrid.
Close-up on his mother, gasping with wide, horrified eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: A traitor?

cliffhanger_text: Unanswered question ('A traitor?...'); High-stakes reveal ending on 'traitor'; Cliffhanger delivered with Shocked; Dramatic close-up freeze-frame cut

units.text: Close-up of his mother looking up at him, agony and hesitation washing over her face.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Alexander...
Quick push-in close-up on Alexander, his eyes snapping open in sudden panic.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: What?
Close-up on his mother, tears shining in the amber lamplight.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: She did come to me.
Medium two-shot as Alexander bends over the table, crowding his mother with fierce desperation.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Is she still at Ashbourne?
Close-up on Alexander's mother shutting her eyes and weeping, shaking her head in deep anguish.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: No...
Medium shot as Alexander towers over her, his breathing turning ragged.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then where is she?
Tight close-up on Alexander's mother crying out in wretched guilt and horror.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They arrested her!
Close-up on Alexander, his expression freezing in complete shock.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Arrested?
Medium close-up as his mother clutches Alexander's forearms with desperate, pleading hands.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!
Close-up on Alexander, absolute fury erupting across his scarred face.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: But she saved you!
Close-up on his mother, clutching her chest in grief.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: I told them!
Medium shot of Alexander clenching his fists at his sides, trembling with rage.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You told them the truth!
Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They called her a witch!
Frontal medium shot of Alexander standing frozen, the weight of the realization crashing down on him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana... is in a cell?

units.text: Medium shot on Rupert spinning toward the gathered congregation, his hands flailing.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: You have all been deceived!
Medium close-up on Alexander, commanding and icy.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then let the Crown decide.
Close-up on Alexander's hands holding an official War Office document bundle sealed with red wax and ribbon.
Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.
Medium shot of Alexander holding up the sealed parcel before the room.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Read the first.
Close-up on Lord Sterling looking sideways, his face pale with rising dread.
Two-shot of Alexander handing the dossier to a Crown Military Magistrate wearing white gloves and a high-collared black uniform.
The Crown Official receives the dossier solemnly with both hands.
Medium close-up on the Crown Official opening the binder and reading aloud.
Crisp sound of parchment turning.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Military Intelligence Report, Iberian front, three years ago.
Close-up on Rupert staring wide-eyed, completely petrified.
Medium close-up on the Crown Official continuing the official reading.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised.
Frontal medium shot of the Crown Official turning a page as the congregation listens in breathless silence.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: The report identifies the leak as deliberate.
Wide shot across the rubble of the cathedral floor showing Rupert crumbling in fear against the choir railing.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Information regarding the Duke's position was transmitted through British channels.
Rupert staggers backward, his knees buckling as he leans his weight heavily on the stone balustrade.
Close-up on Rupert clinging to the stone pillar, his breath shallow and terrified.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: No...
Medium shot on Alexander stepping forward, thrusting the secondary dossier forward.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Read the names.
Medium close-up on the Crown Official reading the concluding section.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Lord Henry Sterling.
Quick pan to Lord Sterling stiffening in his pew, then the Crown Official.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Rupert Ashburn.
Extreme close-up on Rupert's horrified eyes darting in sheer terror.
Close-up on the Dowager Duchess covering her mouth in agonizing disbelief.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: My God...
Low-angle shot on Alexander towering over the fallen Rupert.

units.text: The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You cannot let the whole village start talking about you.
Medium close-up of Juliana placing the mortar back onto the table, unflinching.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A child's life matters more than gossip.
Close-up of Alexander, his jaw clenched with protective anxiety.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous.
Medium two-shot profile of Juliana stepping directly in front of Alexander, looking steadfastly up into his eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Then we will face it together.
Wide shot of an opulent gothic manor study. The Blond Nobleman sits in a velvet armchair beside a roaring fireplace, reading an open leather-bound book.
The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.
Medium shot framing the Blond Nobleman in the foreground as The Former Groom halts respectfully behind his chair.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: What is it?
Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: There is a rumor going around, my Lord.
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: What rumor?
Close-up of The Former Groom speaking cautiously.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke.
Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman scoffing dismissively as he closes the book.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: People see ghosts whenever they want a story.
Extreme close-up of The Former Groom's eyes widening with urgent dread.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war.
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman snapping his head around, his smug expression freezing into sudden alarm.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Where?

cliffhanger_text: Unanswered question ('Where?...'); Cliffhanger delivered with Sharp, Demanding; Dramatic close-up freeze-frame cut

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: Miss Ashcroft.
Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man pause on the stone steps, turning slightly back toward Lord Ashcroft.
Close-up of Lord Ashcroft, his weathered face rigid with aristocratic pride and disgust.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: You will not leave this church carrying the Ashcroft name.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at her father. Her hand rises to touch the amethyst heirloom pendant resting at her throat.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: The vows are spoken, Father. I am his wife now.
Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft standing rigid outside the chapel archway, unforgiving and unyielding.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: Then leave as his wife.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: You leave as no daughter of mine.
Low-angle shot tracking Lord Ashcroft's polished black boots as he slowly descends the stone steps toward them.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: Your dowry is revoked.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: Your inheritance is revoked.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes wide with shock and heartbreak as she holds the ledger close against her chest.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: From this moment, you are dead to the Ashcroft family.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You truly mean it? You are my father!
Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, observing Lord Ashcroft with an unblinking, quietly threatening stare.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: And you have chosen to become a stranger.
Profile medium two-shot of Juliana and Lord Ashcroft standing face-to-face against the backdrop of the towering gothic facade.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No, Father. You chose that long before today.
Medium close-up of Lady Ashcroft, resplendent in navy velvet and jewels, stepping forward with a smirk of malicious authority.

units.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
units.text: Enough sentiment.

units.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
units.text: And the ledger...

units.text: Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: A disgraced woman?
Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me.
Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You are lying!
Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me.
Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's expressive blue eyes and tear-stained cheek.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him.
Low-angle shot of Juliana leaning slightly forward against her chains.
Close-up of Catherine staring down, her eyes widening as Juliana's words pierce her facade.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Let him have Clarissa.
Close-up of Juliana smiling with genuine liberation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He lost me.
Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You were rejected!
Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth.
Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.
Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Your soldier?
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glowing with genuine devotion.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: My husband.
Close-up of Catherine scowling with deep disgust.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: He is a nobody.
Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, totally untroubled.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Then I love a nobody.
Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did.
Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You know nothing about my world.
Medium shot of Juliana sitting in her tattered apron and chains, looking composed.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I know exactly what your world values.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's lips and eyes as she lists them with chilling precision.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Beauty. Money.
Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.
Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Family. A perfect name.
Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her.

units.text: Medium shot as Alexander stands up and drapes a heavy crimson ducal mantle lined with ermine over Juliana's shoulders.
Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You're the Duke?
Close-up on Alexander looking intensely into her eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton.
Close-up on Juliana, tears of awe spilling over her cheeks.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: All this time?
Close-up two-shot as Alexander tenderly cradles Juliana's cheek in his gloved hand.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You chose me when you believed I was nobody.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I chose you because you were kind.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You chose me when I had nothing.
Medium shot framed between them as Alexander holds her face with both hands, the crowd watching in stunned silence.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I chose you because you had honor.
Tight close-up on Alexander looking deep into Juliana's blue eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And I chose you because you saw the man before the title.
Extreme close-up as Alexander and Juliana rest their foreheads and noses together in an intimate embrace.
Alexander and Juliana close their eyes, breathing together with their foreheads pressed gently against one another.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I loved you before I ever knew who you were.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And I loved you before I ever dared to tell you.
Medium shot as Alexander turns back toward the altar, where Catherine stands in her disheveled wedding gown.
Catherine takes a desperate step forward, clutching her skirts and weeping.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Alexander...
Medium shot as Alexander steps right up to Catherine, towering over her with righteous fury.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife.
Extreme close-up split profile between Alexander's angry face and Catherine's gasping, terrified expression.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I didn't know!

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You knew exactly what you were doing!
Medium close-up of Alexander turning slightly toward the gathered congregation as his voice rings across the cathedral.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife.
Close-up on Catherine's devastated, terrified face as the word shatters her entire worldview.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Wife?!
Grand wide shot of the ruined cathedral nave as Alexander takes Juliana's hand and walks her proudly down the center aisle.
Alexander and Juliana advance side-by-side between the rows of shocked aristocratic guests.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Before the Crown and before God...

units.text: Low-angle shot from behind Juliana looking up at Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing proudly before the altar.
Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips and shocked, tearful blue eyes.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Gerald?

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Why are you holding her hand?
Close-up insert of Gerald's fingers firmly interlocked with the white-gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown.
Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown beaming with cruel triumph.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: Because he is marrying me.
Close-up on Juliana as tears spill over her eyelashes.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: No...
Wide profile shot showing Juliana standing below the altar platform, looking up at Gerald and her sister.
Close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her sorrow turning into burning outrage.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You knew this before I walked through those doors!
Medium shot of Gerald standing stoic and impassive next to the smug Lady in Gold Gown.
Close-up on Juliana's hands desperately clenching fistfuls of her white dress fabric.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You let me come here...

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: I came for something that belongs to me.
Close-up of Clarissa peering from the carriage window in her violet silk gown, a venomous, triumphant smile curling her lips.
Close-up of Juliana, her anger flaring as she gestures sharply.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You have already taken enough from me. Leave!
Medium close-up of Gerald pointing an accusatory finger, his composure snapping into hostile anger.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!
Close-up of Juliana recoiling in utter disbelief.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: What? When?
Close-up of Gerald narrowing his eyes vindictively.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: The last time I came here.
Medium shot of Juliana scoffing, stepping forward as Alexander stands motionless behind her.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You never even entered the cottage!
Close-up of Gerald smirking with condescending amusement.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Then you should have nothing to fear from a search.
Three-shot of Alexander, Juliana, and Gerald in the bleak drizzle.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander would never steal from you.
Low-angle shot of Gerald throwing his head back in arrogant, mocking laughter.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!
Medium close-up of Alexander stepping past Juliana, his gaze murderous and jaw rigid.

units.text: Close-up on Prudence, her eyes wide with dread.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: And if they discover who you are?
Close-up on Lady Juliana holding her gaze steadily.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Then I will face that when she is breathing again.
Medium two-shot outside the heavy wooden servant entrance door.
Medium shot of Lady Juliana standing outside a massive carved mahogany door, glancing around the empty hallway to ensure she is unobserved.
Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.
Close-up of Lady Juliana's hand twisting the latch handle.
Faint, muffled click of the heavy door lock turning.
Slow tracking shot into the cavernous, shadowy bedchamber. In the center stands an ornate four-poster canopy bed draped in pale silk where a frail, silver-haired figure lies motionless.
Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.
Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Your Grace?
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped on pillows, her face gaunt, ashen, and drenched in cold sweat, her eyes half-fluttering.
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana taking the Duchess's fragile, cold hands into her own.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Do not speak.
Close-up of Lady Juliana checking the Duchess's pulse and gently pressing her fingertips against the Duchess's chest and neck, her herbalist instincts taking over.
Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: This isn't ordinary fever.
The Dowager Duchess suddenly gasps violently for breath, convulsing weakly as her eyes snap open in agony.
Close-up of the Duchess gasping in sudden spasms.
Intense two-shot as Lady Juliana leans in close, gripping the Duchess's shoulder with urgent desperation.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Who has been treating you?

Extreme close-up on the Dowager Duchess's terrified, wide eyes staring up as she chokes for air, the haunting realization of poison lingering as dramatic music hits an abrupt, suspenseful cliffhanger.

units.text: Close-up of Juliana, her voice rising passionately.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Because she was dying!
Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman pacing forward with calculating malice.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?
Close-up of Juliana retorting without hesitation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: The physicians were not saving her!
Over-the-shoulder shot past the Blond Nobleman looking toward the frail Duchess watching helplessly from the bed.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: My aunt has been wasting away for months.
Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman turning slowly back toward Juliana, building his trap.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed...
Close-up shot of his gloved black leather finger reaching down to tap against the glass dropper bottle in Juliana's open palm.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: ...holding a substance no one authorized her to give.
Medium close-up of Juliana raising the small bottle high for them to see.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It is an antidote.
Close-up of Lady Catherine sneering sharply.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: An antidote to what?
Extreme close-up of Juliana's focused eyes.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Answer her.
Close-up on the Blond Nobleman's impatient scowl.
Close-up of Juliana speaking the truth clearly.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Poison.
Close-up on the Blond Nobleman, his expression freezing into a dark scowl.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Poison.
Close-up of Juliana stating the grim reality.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Someone has been poisoning Her Grace.
Medium shot of Lady Catherine turning abruptly to the guard stationed by the open door, pointing with feigned outrage.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: You hear that?!
Close-up of Lady Catherine twisting Juliana's words with malicious glee.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!
Close-up of Juliana recoiling in shock at the blatant lie.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: That is not what I said!

units.text: Medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely, raising the branding poker like a weapon and screaming.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Silence! Silence!
Close-up of Catherine's crazed, gasping face.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Why?!
Close-up of Juliana crying out her defiance.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Because I am right!
Low-angle tracking shot of the red-hot branding tip trailing across the wet dungeon floor, steaming.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You want everyone to believe you are powerful.
Medium shot of Juliana sitting under the cold skylight bars, her posture majestic despite her imprisonment.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You want everyone to fear you.
Medium shot of Juliana looking directly at Catherine, gestures restrained by the heavy iron chains.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: But look at you.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes burning with fiery contempt.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!
Close-up of Catherine trembling with uncontrollable rage, teeth bared.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You insolent—!
Medium shot of Catherine gripping the glowing tongs as Juliana continues speaking over her.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You may have the title you have always wanted...
Close-up of Juliana delivering the final emotional blow.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: ...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else.
Close-up of Catherine's face twitching with sheer murderous madness.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You think you can lecture me?!
Medium shot of Catherine raising the branding iron high above her head with both hands.
Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!
Medium shot of Catherine plunging the glowing orange poker straight toward Juliana's face.
Juliana gasps, freezing as the glowing tip of the iron thrusts forward, stopping mere millimeters from her right eye.

units.text: Close-up of his mother clutching her temple, reeling in remembered trauma.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: She was taken before a magistrate.
Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes wild with terror for his wife.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And?!
Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They condemned her.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: No.
Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: She is to be executed.
Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: When?
Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: After the wedding.
Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: What wedding?

units.text: Medium close-up of Juliana sitting quietly beside the boy, holding two fingers over his wrist to monitor his pulse.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the mother leaning across the table in panic.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: Why isn't it working?
Close-up of Juliana raising a calm finger, urging patience.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Wait.
Close-up of the sleeping boy as beads of sweat form on his forehead, his breathing deepening.
Close-up of the mother gently caressing her son's cheek, sobbing with relief.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: His fever... it's breaking.
Close-up of Juliana exhaling a deep breath of relief, smiling gently.
Close-up of the mother looking up at Juliana with overwhelming gratitude.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: You saved him.
Medium close-up of Juliana grasping the mother's hand with warm modesty.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: The herbs did their work. Let him rest.
Juliana places a comforting hand over the mother's hands.
The mother gathers her sleeping son in her arms and steps back toward the rainy doorway.
Medium shot from inside the cottage framing the mother standing at the open door looking back.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you.
The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You cannot let the whole village start talking about you.
Medium close-up of Juliana placing the mortar back onto the table, unflinching.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A child's life matters more than gossip.
Close-up of Alexander, his jaw clenched with protective anxiety.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous.
Medium two-shot profile of Juliana stepping directly in front of Alexander, looking steadfastly up into his eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Then we will face it together.
Wide shot of an opulent gothic manor study. The Blond Nobleman sits in a velvet armchair beside a roaring fireplace, reading an open leather-bound book.
The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.
Medium shot framing the Blond Nobleman in the foreground as The Former Groom halts respectfully behind his chair.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: What is it?
Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: There is a rumor going around, my Lord.
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: What rumor?
Close-up of The Former Groom speaking cautiously.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke.
Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman scoffing dismissively as he closes the book.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: People see ghosts whenever they want a story.
Extreme close-up of The Former Groom's eyes widening with urgent dread.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war.
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman snapping his head around, his smug expression freezing into sudden alarm.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Where?
Medium close-up of The Former Groom shifting uncomfortably.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Stop! What are you doing?!
Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap holding the uprooted chamomile bouquet, sneering with cruel amusement.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: We're clearing this rubbish.
Close-up on Juliana, her face tight with anguish and fury as she clutches her bandaged hands against her chest.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Those are medicinal plants!
Low-angle shot tracking down from the bald thug's grinning face to his worn leather boots on the muddy flagstones.

units.speaker: BALD THUG
units.text: They look like weeds to me.
The bald thug flings the bouquet into the mud and grinds his heavy boot directly onto the delicate flowers.
High-angle two-shot as Juliana rushes forward and drops directly onto her knees in the cold mud before the thug.
Juliana frantically tries to scoop the crushed soil and torn stems back into the bed with her bandaged hands.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Please! Those plants took months to grow!
Medium two-shot of the Tall Thug with the club and the Thug with Cap bursting into raucous laughter under the full moon.

units.speaker: TALL THUG
units.text: Months? You actually spend your days growing this filth?
Tight close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands trembling as she tenderly gathers the soiled white flowers from the puddles.
Low-angle medium shot tilting up as Juliana rises from the ground, standing tall despite her trembling frame.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Leave my garden alone.
Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap scoffing derisively.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: A noble lady playing in the dirt. What a joke.
Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes blazing with indignation and wounded pride.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It is my home. You have no right to destroy anything here.
Tight close-up of the Thug with Cap stepping aggressively into Juliana's personal space, snarling with venom.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: Get out of the way!
Extreme close-up on Juliana's piercing blue eyes and set jaw, unflinching.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No.
The Thug with Cap violently shoves Juliana back with both hands; she cries out as she loses her balance and crashes hard onto the wet stone path.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Ah!
Close-up tracking down to Juliana's hand hitting the mud next to the crushed chamomile flowers.
Juliana crawls forward on her elbows; fresh crimson blood seeps profusely through her white gauze bandages as she reaches for the ruined blossoms.
Tight close-up on Juliana's mud-streaked, tear-stained face trembling in heartbreaking agony.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: My mother's plants...
Low-angle wide shot of the three thugs pointing and laughing hysterically at her kneeling form.

units.speaker: BALD THUG
units.text: Look at her! Crying over weeds!
The Tall Thug hoists his heavy wooden club above his head to crush the remaining herbs right before Juliana.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Stop!
Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap suddenly stiffening, his smug smile dropping as footsteps pound in the darkness.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!
Medium close-up of Rupert smoothing down his black leather gloves, a chilling smile forming on his lips.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: You see?

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: The poison has clearly damaged her mind.
Over-the-shoulder shot of Rupert leaning menacingly over the gasping Duchess in bed.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: I am not delusional!

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Of course you are not.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: You are merely confused.
Medium profile tracking shot of Catherine walking deliberately toward Juliana, speaking with airy cynicism.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists...

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: ...is the maid who claims to have discovered it.
Low-angle medium shot of Rupert turning sharply toward the guard, his eyes icy and authoritative.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house.
Tight close-up of Catherine's gloved hands grabbing the delicate chain around Juliana's neck.
Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No!
Medium close-up of Catherine holding up the oval silver and amethyst pendant, inspecting it with disdain.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?
Close-up of Juliana crying out in agony, writhing in the guard's iron grip.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Give it back!

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It belonged to my mother!
Low-angle shot tracking the silver locket as Catherine casually flings it across the stone corridor floor.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: A witch has no need for family heirlooms in the gallows.
Metallic clatter as the silver pendant bounces against the wooden baseboard.
Medium shot of Juliana being dragged further into the doorway, staring helplessly toward her discarded locket.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: My mother's locket!
Medium shot of Catherine walking toward the fallen leather-bound book and kneeling gracefully to pick it up.
Catherine lifts the heavy herbarium, dusting off the cover before opening its aged parchment pages.
Tight close-up of Catherine reading the elegant cursive script inside the front cover.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Juliana...

units.text: Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.
Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Burn it.
Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.
Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: What?
Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Burn the ledger. Burn every page.
Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You may destroy the book...
Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: ...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me.
Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You think a few herbs make you better than me?
Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No. Your cruelty does that for me.
High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.
Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You still think you are better?!
Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I know what I am.
Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: A disgraced woman?
Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me.
Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You are lying!
Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me.
Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's expressive blue eyes and tear-stained cheek.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him.
