units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Then why did they never find you?
Close-up on Alexander, his dark combat scar prominent as his eyes burn with steady, cold intensity.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Because they made certain no one would look.
Medium close-up on Alexander's mother, her hood framing her pale, weathered face as shock deepens across her features.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Who?
Side profile shot of Alexander gazing toward the open doorway before slowly turning back to face his mother directly.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Sterling... and Rupert.
Tight close-up on Alexander's mother as her breath hitches and her eyes widen in pure horror.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Rupert?
Wide shot of the wooden cabin interior. Alexander stands upright opposite his mother across the lantern-lit map.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They knew where I was.
Close-up on Alexander leaning over the table, his eyes locked onto his mother as suppressed rage surfaces.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: My position was leaked to the French... before I could expose what I had discovered.
Close-up of Alexander's mother clutching the collar of her dark cloak, her chest heaving with agony.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They gave you to the enemy?

units.text: Medium low-angle shot on Gerald at the altar steps, looking down dismissively, while Clarissa in her shimmering gold gown stands behind him gloating.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: I cannot marry you, Juliana.
Medium close-up on Juliana trembling in disbelief, her hands clasped tightly to her chest.
Juliana gasps softly in heartbreak, her eyes wide and brimming with tears.
Medium shot returning to Gerald, sneering down at Juliana.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: You are far too plain...
Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face, crushed under his biting words.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: ...far too silent...
Medium shot on Gerald turning slightly toward Clarissa as she smiles admiringly at him.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: ...and completely beneath the future I deserve.
Wide shot down the aisle as Juliana takes an agonizing step forward toward the altar, extending a trembling hand.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Gerald... Look at me.
Close-up on Gerald's cold, merciless face staring ahead unblinkingly.
Tight insert on Juliana's hand clutching the heirloom amethyst pendant resting against her gown.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You gave me your word before both our families.

units.text: Medium shot of Alexander and Juliana sitting together on the edge of the velvet bed, dressed in morning robes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: What if Father Thomas sways the High Council?
Close-up of Juliana's distressed face, tears shimmering in her eyes as she looks up at Alexander.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: What if they strip your title? Because of me?
Juliana looks down at her hands, turning over her scarred palms shaped by years of herbal work.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I am only a healer. The lords will never accept me.
Profile shot as Alexander reaches out and firmly clasps Juliana's trembling hands in his own.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Look at me, Juliana.
Close-up of Alexander raising his scarred hand to tenderly cradle Juliana's cheek.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You saved my mother's life. You stood by me when I had nothing.
Tight close-up on Alexander's gaze locking onto Juliana's tearful eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You are my wife.
Alexander gently pulls Juliana closer, his hands resting securely on her shoulders.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You were my wife before that priest ever opened his mouth. And we will stand before the King and God again within ten days. Nothing breaks that.
Wide establishing shot of the rain-drenched cobblestone courtyard surrounded by imposing Gothic arches.
Medium shot of Lady Ashbourne leaning heavily on her walking cane, glaring down at Catherine who kneels in the mud.

units.speaker: LADY ASHBOURNE
units.text: You dare show your face in Ashbourne courtyard?

cliffhanger_text: Unanswered question ('You dare show your face in Ashbourn...'); High-stakes reveal ending on 'dare'; Cliffhanger delivered with Sharp, Contemptuous

units.text: Profile close-up of Juliana turning her face back toward the altar, tears still shimmering on her cheeks.
Direct close-up on Juliana's face as a steely, defiant smile emerges through her pain.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Dignity?
Full shot of Juliana standing tall, her posture completely transforming into regal composure before the seated guests.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You abandoned a woman who trusted you...
Medium profile close-up on Gerald's hardening jawline, Clarissa blurred in the background.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: ...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth.
Closer angle on Gerald's uneasy expression as Juliana's voice commands the room.
Medium wide shot framing Juliana confronting Gerald from the foot of the altar stairs.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald.
Medium close-up push-in on Juliana, her blue eyes shining with fierce conviction.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable.
Medium profile on Juliana looking up at Gerald, holding the entire hall spellbound.
Close-up on Juliana's face, calm, dignified, and unwavering.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You have shown them exactly what your word is worth.
Medium shot on Gerald standing frozen on the altar steps, stunned and speechless under her public rebuke.
Low-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral nave, framing Juliana in pristine white at the center of the vaulted aisle.
Juliana lifts her chin high, commanding the space with unassailable dignity.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I may leave this chapel without a husband...
Dramatic medium close-up holding steadily on Juliana's radiant, proud face as she delivers her final proclamation.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: ...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed.

units.text: Close-up of the Duchess gazing up at Juliana, her voice barely a whisper.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: What is your husband's name?
Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.
Juliana gasps, snapping her head toward the entrance in alarm.
The heavy mahogany double doors burst open, revealing the Blond Nobleman flanked by Lady Catherine and a royal guard in uniform.
Wide shot framing the open doorway as the aristocrats step into the dimly lit hallway.
Medium shot of Lady Catherine in her lavish cream gown and tiara, scowling with arrogant disdain.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: What is that maid doing in Her Grace's private chamber?
Medium shot of Juliana standing stiffly beside the bed, concealing her hands.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: She needed help.
Close-up of Lady Catherine narrowing her eyes with venomous suspicion.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: What are you hiding?
Close-up of Juliana, her chin raised.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Nothing.
Medium close-up of Lady Catherine pointing a white-gloved finger directly at Juliana.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: Show me your hand.
Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman stepping forward beside Lady Catherine, clad in a dark tailored coat with black leather gloves.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Girl. Show me what you are holding.
Two-shot of Juliana facing the Blond Nobleman as she slowly extends her palm, revealing the small amber glass dropper bottle.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: What is this?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Medicine.
Close-up of Lady Catherine tapping her gloved finger to her lip, letting out a mocking scoff.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: Medicine? You are a new maid.
Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman staring down at the vial, as Catherine sneers from his side.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?
Close-up of Juliana holding her ground.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No one.
Close-up of Lady Catherine turning fiercely triumphant.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: Then you administered it without permission.
Close-up of Juliana, her voice rising passionately.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Because she was dying!
Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman pacing forward with calculating malice.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?
Close-up of Juliana retorting without hesitation.

units.text: Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.
Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!
Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.
Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!
Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.
Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal.
Low-angle two-shot of the High Priest staring up into Alexander's imposing frame.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours.
Medium close-up of Alexander glaring with icy authority.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel.
Wide profile two-shot of the High Priest and Alexander locked in an intense standoff before the altar.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I'll take that wager over your decree.
Quick reaction shot of the elderly woman in the pew gripping her beads in distress.
Wide shot from behind the guards as they surround Alexander and Juliana, halberds and swords pointed inches from Alexander's chest.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!
Medium shot of the High Priest extending his hand toward the guards, commanding them to stand down.
The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well.
The High Priest turns sharply on his heel and strides past the guards toward the church exit.
Shuffling boots and clattering armor as the royal guards turn and retreat down the ruined aisle.
Slow pan to Catherine standing in her bridal gown beside the sunlit aisle, watching the priest depart before turning to camera with a wicked, predatory smile.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text:
Ten days is plenty of time."

--- SCRIPT END ---

units.text: Medium shot as Alexander stands up and drapes a heavy crimson ducal mantle lined with ermine over Juliana's shoulders.
Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You're the Duke?
Close-up on Alexander looking intensely into her eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton.
Close-up on Juliana, tears of awe spilling over her cheeks.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: All this time?
Close-up two-shot as Alexander tenderly cradles Juliana's cheek in his gloved hand.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Alexander...
Medium shot as Alexander steps right up to Catherine, towering over her with righteous fury.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife.
Extreme close-up split profile between Alexander's angry face and Catherine's gasping, terrified expression.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I didn't know!

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You knew exactly what you were doing!
Medium close-up of Alexander turning slightly toward the gathered congregation as his voice rings across the cathedral.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife.
Close-up on Catherine's devastated, terrified face as the word shatters her entire worldview.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Wife?!
Grand wide shot of the ruined cathedral nave as Alexander takes Juliana's hand and walks her proudly down the center aisle.
Alexander and Juliana advance side-by-side between the rows of shocked aristocratic guests.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Before the Crown and before God...

units.text: No! That watch was not in his coat!
Close-up of the Constable narrowing his eyes coldly at Juliana.

units.speaker: CONSTABLE
units.text: I found it there myself.
Close-up of Juliana glaring back with unwavering conviction.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Then someone put it there!
Medium full shot of Gerald framed in the open cottage doorway holding his riding crop, stepping inside with a patronizing, gloating grin.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: The proof is in his coat, Juliana. A valuable pocket watch doesn't just walk into a beggar's pocket.
Close-up of Alexander, his scarred brow furrowed in dark, quiet defiance.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I have never touched your property.
Medium shot of Gerald pointing his riding crop toward them, with Clarissa hovering behind him in her violet silk gown.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Then perhaps your wife should explain why it was found in your coat.
Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You planted it!
Medium shot of Clarissa gliding past Gerald, a venomous, amused smile playing upon her lips.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Oh, dear sister...
Tight shot of Alexander's hand clenching into a tight, trembling fist against the glow of the roaring fireplace.
Close-up of Alexander glaring daggers at Clarissa.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: ...still defending your broken scrap of a man?
Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes narrowing with sharp perception.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Name your price, Clarissa. I know you.
Medium close-up of Clarissa smiling with vicious delight.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape.
Tight shot of Clarissa smoothing her long purple evening glove along her wrist.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Perhaps I can give you one.
Close-up of Juliana watching her with cautious skepticism.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: What do you want?

units.text: Of course you are not.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: You are merely confused.
Medium profile tracking shot of Catherine walking deliberately toward Juliana, speaking with airy cynicism.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists...

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: ...is the maid who claims to have discovered it.
Low-angle medium shot of Rupert turning sharply toward the guard, his eyes icy and authoritative.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house.

units.text: No!

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: No.
Low-angle medium shot of the Judge leaning over his elevated bench, staring down critically.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Do you deny using its remedies?
Tight close-up of Lady Juliana's face, bruised cheekbone highlighting her calm defiance.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: No.
Medium shot of the aristocratic Lord standing at the railing in his tailored dark coat, turning slowly with a smirk of malicious satisfaction.
Close-up of the Judge leaning forward across his bench, eyes narrowing with grim conviction.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Then you admit to practicing forbidden arts.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking upward with quiet dignity, her eyes luminous.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I admit to healing the sick.
The Judge furiously raises his wooden gavel and strikes the sound block with sharp force.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Silence!
[Sharp, echoing crack of the gavel slamming onto wood]
Medium shot of the Judge slamming the gavel down on his bench.
Tracking shot moving from the Judge on his bench as he points his outstretched arm across the courtroom floor toward the witness stand.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Prudence. You served beside the accused?
Prudence the young maid stands trembling in the center of the courtroom floor, her head bowed in deep shame, clutching the sides of her apron.
Medium close-up of Prudence looking up with tears streaming down her pale face.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Yes, Your Honor.
Medium close-up of the Judge leaning forward with folded hands.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Did you witness Lady Juliana perform these treatments?
Profile over-the-shoulder shot from behind Prudence toward Lady Juliana standing bound in iron cuffs at the prisoner's dock.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Tell the truth.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Yes.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking at her former maid, a momentary flicker of hurt passing through her eyes before settling into stoic composure.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: What did you see?

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: She used herbs... and her mother's book.
Medium shot of the Judge leaning back slightly, pointing his hand accusingly.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Did she draw strange markings?

A heavy tear drips down from her jaw, falling into the dark dampness below.
Medium close-up profile of Juliana closing her eyes, drawing a deep breath to steady herself.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Keep him safe.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Wherever he is.
Frontal medium shot of Juliana kneeling upright, her right hand pressed firmly over her heart, her posture transforming into quiet dignity.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Let him live.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: And if I have only one thing left to give...
Tight close-up of Juliana turning toward the cell wall, her blue eyes flashing with fierce loyalty.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: The succession papers are being finalized as we speak.
Medium close-up of Catherine raising the porcelain teacup to her lips, her expression turning sharp and dismissive.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: 'Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I marry the Lord of Ashbury.
Medium shot of Rupert striding toward the tea table, leaning forward with predatory conviction.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: And so you shall.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown...

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: ...the title is mine.
Close-up of Catherine lowering her teacup, her icy blue eyes narrowing in calculated concern.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Her shadow still hangs over this house.
Tight close-up of Rupert's face as a sinister grin spreads across his features.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: They call it a wasting of the lungs.
Close-up side profile of Catherine bringing the teacup to her lips, savoring his words with chilling detachment.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: How tragic. The slow, quiet decline.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: How much longer can the frail thing survive?

cliffhanger_text: Unanswered question ('How much longer can the frail thing...'); Dramatic close-up freeze-frame cut

units.text: Close-up on Juliana, her manacled hands clutching at her smock as tears well in her eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander...
Close-up on Alexander, his gaze softening momentarily toward her.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana.
Medium shot of Rupert descending the altar steps, furiously pointing toward Alexander.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Guards! Arrest this imposter!
Medium shot of the royal guardsman standing rigidly in red uniform and bearskin cap, resting his white-gloved hand on his sabre.

units.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
units.text: We will not.
Close-up on Rupert, veins bulging in his neck as his composure shatters.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: I said arrest him!

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Why?!
Close-up on the Royal Guard holding his upright blade with unwavering conviction.

units.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
units.text: Because we know who he is.
Medium shot of Catherine clutching her father's arm, her bridal bouquet drooping as panic seizes her face.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Rupert...
Medium close-up of Rupert gripping the edge of a pew for balance, his eyes wild with terror.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: You cannot be him. Alexander died!
Wide tracking shot behind Alexander as he advances down the center aisle, silhouetted against the ruins of the cathedral nave.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon.
Medium shot of an elderly silver-haired woman in simple ivory robes stepping into the aisle, her hands outstretched in trembling awe.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Alexander...

hook_text: Intense close-up camera hook; Intense close-up camera hook; High urgency/exclamation; Shock keyword 'imposter'; High-tension delivery (Furious, Hysterical)

units.text: Close-up of Gerald narrowing his eyes vindictively.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: The last time I came here.
Medium shot of Juliana scoffing, stepping forward as Alexander stands motionless behind her.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You never even entered the cottage!
Close-up of Gerald smirking with condescending amusement.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Then you should have nothing to fear from a search.
Three-shot of Alexander, Juliana, and Gerald in the bleak drizzle.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander would never steal from you.
Low-angle shot of Gerald throwing his head back in arrogant, mocking laughter.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!
Medium close-up of Alexander stepping past Juliana, his gaze murderous and jaw rigid.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Choose your next words carefully.
Medium shot of Gerald pointing back toward the approaching Constable, feigning alarm.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: You hear that? He threatens me again!
Medium shot of the Constable marching into frame between them, holding his truncheon horizontally.

units.speaker: CONSTABLE
units.text: I have received a complaint of theft.
Extreme close-up of Juliana, defiant and resolute.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A complaint is not proof.
Close-up of the Constable gesturing with his truncheon toward the cottage door.

units.speaker: CONSTABLE
units.text: Then a search will settle the matter.
Medium shot of Juliana backing up to the doorway, spreading her arms wide to block the entrance.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You cannot simply invade our home because this man makes an accusation!
Medium close-up of Gerald crossing his arms smugly.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: If he has nothing to hide...
Extreme close-up push-in on Alexander's scarred face, his eyes smoldering with lethal restraint.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: ...let the constable search.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Search it.
Medium two-shot of Juliana looking up at Alexander in panicked confusion.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Let them.
Medium shot looking out the doorway as Juliana steps aside and the Constable barges past into the dimly lit cottage.
Heavy thud of boots entering wooden floorboards, followed by forceful banging of furniture.
The Constable begins violently overturning crates and dumping contents across the floor.
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana dropping to her knees, frantically trying to salvage bundles of dried herbs scattering across the boards.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!
The Constable aggressively pulls folded bed linens from a shelf and hurls them onto the damp floor.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling on the floor, looking up with tears streaming down her cheeks.

units.text: Close-up of Alexander, his scarred brow furrowed in dark, quiet defiance.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I have never touched your property.
Medium shot of Gerald pointing his riding crop toward them, with Clarissa hovering behind him in her violet silk gown.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Then perhaps your wife should explain why it was found in your coat.
Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You planted it!
Medium shot of Clarissa gliding past Gerald, a venomous, amused smile playing upon her lips.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Oh, dear sister...
Tight shot of Alexander's hand clenching into a tight, trembling fist against the glow of the roaring fireplace.
Close-up of Alexander glaring daggers at Clarissa.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: ...still defending your broken scrap of a man?
Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes narrowing with sharp perception.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Name your price, Clarissa. I know you.
Medium close-up of Clarissa smiling with vicious delight.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape.
Tight shot of Clarissa smoothing her long purple evening glove along her wrist.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Perhaps I can give you one.
Close-up of Juliana watching her with cautious skepticism.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: What do you want?
Medium two-shot of Clarissa in the foreground, turning slowly to face Juliana.

hook_text: Intense close-up camera hook; Shock keyword 'never'; High-tension delivery (Mocking, Malicious)
cliffhanger_text: Unanswered question ('What do you want?...'); Cliffhanger delivered with Guarded, Cold; Dramatic close-up freeze-frame cut

units.text: Close-up of the maid weeping profusely, cornered and helpless.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: What do you want me to say?!
Wide shot of the study as the Lord stands calmly before the trembling servant.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: The truth.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: She drew something around the bed, did she not?
Close-up of the maid stammering through her tears.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: She... placed dried herbs around him.
Medium close-up of the Lord standing right beside her shoulder, whispering in her ear like an insidious specter.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Around him.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Like a circle?

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: Yes.
Close-up from behind the maid as the Lord leans close to her ear.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: And she opened her mother's book...
Extreme close-up of the maid's tear-drenched eyes and quivering lips.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: Yes.
Close-up of the Lord delivering the final trap.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: ...and spoke words you could not understand.
Close-up of the maid gasping out in desperate agony.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: She was praying!
Close-up of the Lord grinning with sinister triumph.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Praying... or chanting?

cliffhanger_text: Unanswered question ('Praying... or chanting?...'); Dramatic close-up freeze-frame cut

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana!
Close-up of Juliana lying on her stomach among the thorns, bleeding cuts running down her forehead, cheeks, and bare arms.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Please, ring... you have to be here.
Her blood-smeared index finger brushes against a solid metallic object half-buried in the frozen dirt beneath a thorny branch.
Extreme close-up macro shot of an ornate antique gold ring set with a massive, radiant emerald resting in the frosted soil.
Close-up of Juliana's wide, disbelieving blue eyes as breath catches in her throat.
Juliana reaches out her torn, bloodied hand and wraps her fingers tightly around the emerald ring.
Extreme close-up of her bloody hand closing around the emerald signet ring.
Close-up of Juliana grimacing in fierce triumph and intense pain as thorns catch her knuckles.
Brief cut to Alexander staring into the briar patch in suspended terror.
Close-up on Juliana's sweat- and frost-streaked face as she grinds her teeth, tears pooling in her eyes, fighting through the blinding pain.

Macro close-up holding on Juliana's bloodied fist firmly gripping the emerald ring against the frozen ground as the episode cuts to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---
Close-up low angle looking through dense, sharp blackthorn branches onto the cracked, frozen soil.
Juliana's blood-streaked, mud-caked hand slowly uncurls amidst the thorns, revealing the ornate emerald signet ring resting in her palm.
Eerie cold wind whistling over the briars with deep, atmospheric cello chords.
Medium close-up of Juliana stepping out from the briar patch, her cloak torn, cheeks scratched, holding the ring outward with unwavering resolve.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I found it.
Wide shot of Juliana holding the ring out toward the austere Police Constable standing guard beside the frozen garden.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Now release my husband.
The Constable takes the ring from her bloodied fingers.
Tight shot on the iron shackles locking Alexander's wrists together against the thorny backdrop.
Sharp metallic click and clinking rattle of heavy iron handcuffs unlocking and falling away.
The Constable unlocks the cuffs, freeing Alexander's large hands.
Tracking shot as Alexander lunges forward without hesitation, rushing past the Constable straight to Juliana.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana.
Close-up on Alexander's rugged hands tenderly grasping Juliana's bloodied, lacerated hands, turning them over with immense care.
Alexander gently turns her palms up, his thumbs trembling as he inspects the deep, bleeding gashes gouged into her skin.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: What have they done to you?

units.text: Medium two-shot of Gerald and Clarissa standing side by side before the priest.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: Promises change when a better choice appears.
Medium close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her voice quivering with disbelief.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: A better choice? Is that what she is?
Wide shot from behind Juliana looking up the altar stairs at Gerald with Clarissa linked to his arm.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: She is what I should have chosen from the beginning.
Medium shot of Juliana's father seated prominently in the family pew, clutching his gold-topped cane.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Father...
Close-up of the father's stern, unyielding face.
Medium shot of Juliana turning toward her father in the pews, imploring him.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Surely you will not let him humiliate me like this?
Medium shot tracking in on Juliana's father as he leans firmly upon his cane, looking down coldly.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Gerald has made his choice. Accept it, Juliana.
Close-up on the father's hardening eyes, entirely unsympathetic.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Do not disgrace us further.
Extreme close-up on Juliana's tear-drenched eyes as the sting of her father's rejection lands.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You won't even look at me.
Medium shot on Clarissa, beaming smugly as she clings to Gerald's arm.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: Why are you surprised, sister? Look at you.
Tight insert on Clarissa's gloved fingers contemptuously pinching the satin folds of Juliana's gown.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: That plain, old-fashioned gown.
Medium shot of Clarissa smiling radiantly, condescendingly gesturing at Juliana.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: You look like a kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding.
Close-up on Juliana, whose tearful expression begins to tighten with quiet indignation.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: And that quiet little face.
Wide over-the-shoulder shot from behind Clarissa and Gerald, framing Juliana standing solitary down the center aisle.
Medium shot returning to Clarissa laughing at Juliana's expense.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: Gerald needs a real lady...
Close-up on Juliana staring straight ahead as Clarissa insults her mother's memory.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: ...not a dull creature who hides in her mother's apothecary herbs.
High-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral aisle as a matriarch dressed in an ornate black velvet gown glides toward Juliana.
The matriarch steps into the center aisle, glaring down at Juliana with cold superiority.

units.speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
units.text: Oh, don't look so wounded, Juliana.
Medium profile two-shot of the matriarch confronting Juliana face-to-face.

units.speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
units.text: You should be grateful you're at least allowed to attend the wedding.
Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward on the altar steps, impatiently gesturing Juliana toward the church exit.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: Go home quietly, Juliana. At least leave this chapel with some dignity.
Profile close-up of Juliana turning her face back toward the altar, tears still shimmering on her cheeks.
Direct close-up on Juliana's face as a steely, defiant smile emerges through her pain.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Dignity?
Full shot of Juliana standing tall, her posture completely transforming into regal composure before the seated guests.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You abandoned a woman who trusted you...

Direct close-up on Juliana's face as a steely, defiant smile emerges through her pain.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Dignity?
Full shot of Juliana standing tall, her posture completely transforming into regal composure before the seated guests.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You abandoned a woman who trusted you...
Medium profile close-up on Gerald's hardening jawline, Clarissa blurred in the background.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: ...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth.
Closer angle on Gerald's uneasy expression as Juliana's voice commands the room.
Medium wide shot framing Juliana confronting Gerald from the foot of the altar stairs.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald.
Medium close-up push-in on Juliana, her blue eyes shining with fierce conviction.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable.
Medium profile on Juliana looking up at Gerald, holding the entire hall spellbound.
Close-up on Juliana's face, calm, dignified, and unwavering.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You have shown them exactly what your word is worth.
Medium shot on Gerald standing frozen on the altar steps, stunned and speechless under her public rebuke.
Low-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral nave, framing Juliana in pristine white at the center of the vaulted aisle.
Juliana lifts her chin high, commanding the space with unassailable dignity.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I may leave this chapel without a husband...

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Most of them were.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Then how did you survive?
Side profile of Alexander as his eyes look into the distance, haunted by the past.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I wasn't supposed to.
Alexander steps over to the wooden table, looking down at the parchment map spread out under the lantern.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Three years ago, I was sent to the Iberian front.
Close-up of Alexander's weathered face looking down pensively as he recounts the mission.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies.
Alexander's scarred finger points to a red-circled location on the parchment map marked near Madrid.
Close-up on his mother, gasping with wide, horrified eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: A traitor?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Yes.
Medium shot framing both of them across the wooden table bathed in amber lantern glow.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: We were close to finding him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then came the ambush.
Close-up on Alexander's scarred hand clenching into a fist, furiously crumbling the parchment map beneath his knuckles.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: My men were slaughtered.
Close-up of his mother clutching at her throat, tears glistening in her eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: And you?

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You have a solution?
Side profile close-up of the Elder Nobleman speaking with icy confidence.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: We use the law to destroy her.
Close-up of Rupert looking bewildered.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: The law?
Tracking medium shot as the Elder Nobleman paces slowly behind the massive mahogany desk lined with books and a glass of whiskey.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: A maid with herbs in her possession, a secret medicine, an unauthorized visit to the Duchess's chamber.
The Elder Nobleman leans both hands against the desk, leaning forward intently.
Medium close-up of Catherine fluttering her fan beneath her chin, smirking approvingly.
Medium shot framing the Elder Nobleman seated at the desk beside Catherine standing in the firelight.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner.
Medium close-up of Catherine gently moving her fan, raising an intrigued brow.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And if she claims she is a healer?
Tight close-up of the Elder Nobleman's face illuminated by warm firelight.

units.text: Low-angle medium close-up of Lady Juliana standing erect in the dock, her prisoner label pinned to her rustic buttoned gown, her expression resolute.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: No.
Low-angle medium shot of the Judge leaning over his elevated bench, staring down critically.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Do you deny using its remedies?
Tight close-up of Lady Juliana's face, bruised cheekbone highlighting her calm defiance.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: No.
Medium shot of the aristocratic Lord standing at the railing in his tailored dark coat, turning slowly with a smirk of malicious satisfaction.
Close-up of the Judge leaning forward across his bench, eyes narrowing with grim conviction.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Then you admit to practicing forbidden arts.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking upward with quiet dignity, her eyes luminous.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I admit to healing the sick.
The Judge furiously raises his wooden gavel and strikes the sound block with sharp force.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Silence!
[Sharp, echoing crack of the gavel slamming onto wood]
Medium shot of the Judge slamming the gavel down on his bench.
Tracking shot moving from the Judge on his bench as he points his outstretched arm across the courtroom floor toward the witness stand.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Prudence. You served beside the accused?
Prudence the young maid stands trembling in the center of the courtroom floor, her head bowed in deep shame, clutching the sides of her apron.
Medium close-up of Prudence looking up with tears streaming down her pale face.

units.text: Starving and overcome with emotion, Juliana presses the bread to her lips and tears off a desperate, ravenous bite.
Close-up profile of Juliana chewing the bread, tears rolling down her soot-streaked cheek.
Juliana chews hungrily, closing her eyes as the agonizing reality of her plight hits her anew.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander...
Low-angle wide shot of Juliana seated against the damp stone wall beneath high overhead iron ceiling grates, clutching the half-eaten bread in her lap.
Tight macro shot on Juliana's chin and throat as she presses a trembling hand against her chest.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: What if I die here?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: What if I never see you again?
A heavy tear drips down from her jaw, falling into the dark dampness below.
Medium close-up profile of Juliana closing her eyes, drawing a deep breath to steady herself.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Keep him safe.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Wherever he is.
Frontal medium shot of Juliana kneeling upright, her right hand pressed firmly over her heart, her posture transforming into quiet dignity.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Let him live.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: And if I have only one thing left to give...
Tight close-up of Juliana turning toward the cell wall, her blue eyes flashing with fierce loyalty.

units.text: Close-up of the Noble Matriarch delivering her verdict.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: You leave.
Close-up on Juliana blinking in disbelief.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Leave where?
Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch looking down her nose in disdain.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: Wherever a discarded daughter belongs.
Low-angle close-up focusing on Juliana's neck as her fingers desperately clutch the oval locket.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: This is my mother's church.
Close-up on Juliana's face, teeth clenched in desperate defiance.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I have every right to stand here.
Tight close-up of the Noble Matriarch leaning in with vicious delight.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: Not anymore.
Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch gesturing expansively to the filled cathedral nave behind her.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: Your father has chosen his family...
Close-up profile of the Noble Matriarch's piercing eyes glaring directly at Juliana.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: ...and it isn't you.
The Noble Matriarch turns sharply toward the back of the chapel and barks an order.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: Guards! Remove her!
Medium shot as two royal guards in red uniforms and bearskin caps step in behind Juliana and seize her arms.
The guards forcefully grab Juliana by both shoulders and drag her backwards.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Let me go!
Close-up of Juliana's hand frantically grabbing the wooden rim of a pew, knuckles white with strain.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Please! Someone!
The guards tear her grip away from the pew.
Muffled scuffle, rustle of heavy silk and frantic gasps echoing off cathedral stone.
High wide shot down the vaulted cathedral aisle showing the entire congregation watching in stunned silence as the guards drag Juliana.

units.text: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at him with genuine curiosity.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: How do you know that?
Close-up of Alexander speaking in a steady, measured tone.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Soldiers learn quickly which plants keep a man alive.
Insert shot of Juliana's hands gently arranging several tied bundles of dried yarrow sprigs on the tabletop.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You know more about healing than you let on.
Close-up of Alexander, bathed in warm hearth embers, offering a subtle, knowing half-smile.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Enough to survive.
Medium close-up of Juliana setting down a bunch of flowers and looking intently at his rugged visage.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Your hair and beard...
Medium shot of Alexander standing tall over her, looking down patiently.
Medium two-shot as Juliana rises from her stool to stand close in front of him, reaching an affectionate hand toward his temple.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I could trim them for you.
Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hand firmly but gently catching Juliana's wrist in midair.
Medium two-shot profile of Alexander holding her wrist, his piercing gaze locked onto hers.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Not yet.
Close-up of Juliana looking into his eyes, her brow lightly furrowed in bemused question.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Not yet?
Close-up of Alexander, still maintaining his gentle hold on her arm.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Let them grow.
Close-up of Juliana smiling with playful warmth.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You prefer looking like a forest hermit?
Intimate two-shot as Alexander slowly lowers her hand, his expression softening.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: It has advantages.
Medium shot of Juliana chuckling quietly as she steps back toward the table.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Very well.
Close-up of Alexander watching her with deep, affectionate attention.
Close-up of Juliana grinning with sparkling eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: But one day, I am trimming that beard.
Close-up of Alexander lowering his head slightly with a faint smirk.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: We'll see.
Medium two-shot of both sitting back down at the table together, Alexander turning a brittle page of the herb book.
Close-up insert of Alexander's weathered finger pointing directly at a delicate botanical illustration of a flowering stem.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: That one grows near the northern stream. Crushed leaves ease swelling.
Wide side-profile two-shot of Juliana and Alexander seated across from each other at the rustic table, the stone fireplace roaring warmly behind them.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: My mother wrote the same thing.
Close-up of Juliana looking across at his battle-marked features with empathy.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: And the scars... were they from the war?

hook_text: Intense close-up camera hook; Suspenseful opening question; Intense close-up camera hook; Shock keyword 'die'
cliffhanger_text: Unanswered question ('And the scars... were they from the...'); Dramatic close-up freeze-frame cut

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You're certain?
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes with resolute conviction.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I have to be.
Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander, I need hot water.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I'm on it.
Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: Please save him.
Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.
Medium close-up of Juliana clasping the mother's trembling hand across the wooden table.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He is not beyond saving.
Close-up of Juliana carefully administering the herbal brew with a small wooden spoon into the sick boy's mouth.
The child swallows weakly and lets out a soft cough.
Close-up of the mother clutching her chest in anxious suspense.
Medium close-up of Juliana sitting quietly beside the boy, holding two fingers over his wrist to monitor his pulse.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the mother leaning across the table in panic.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: Why isn't it working?
Close-up of Juliana raising a calm finger, urging patience.

hook_text: Suspenseful opening question; Intense close-up camera hook; Kinetic dramatic action; High-arousal physical trigger
cliffhanger_text: Unanswered question ('Why isn't it working?...'); Dramatic close-up freeze-frame cut
why_it_works: Hooks scrolling viewers via suspenseful opening question and builds rapid relationship conflict, cutting off at peak curiosity with unanswered question ('why isn't it working?...') to drive immediate click-through to Episode 2.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You still call this a legacy?
Close-up of Juliana held firmly between the guards, glaring back with fierce defiance.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It is medicine!
Medium close-up of Catherine smiling condescendingly.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Of course.
Overhead close-up of Catherine's gloved fingers flipping through the herbarium's delicate, hand-drawn floral remedies and annotations.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Roots. Leaves. Powders. Strange mixtures written in a dead woman's hand.
Medium shot of Catherine tucking the book under her arm, her eyes glinting with malicious intent.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: The magistrate will call it witchcraft.
Close-up of Juliana lunging against the guard's grip, her teeth bared in indignation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You know that is a lie!
Medium shot of Catherine lifting her chin arrogantly against the stone backdrop.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I know exactly what I need him to believe.
Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the two guards.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You cannot just destroy it!
Tight close-up of Catherine's eyes narrowing into an icy, venomous gaze.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I can burn it.
Close-up of Juliana's stricken expression, her eyes widening in horror.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope...

units.text: Close-up of the elder villager's rough, weathered hands offering a fresh loaf of artisan bread wrapped in cloth against the smoking timber ruins.

units.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
units.text: You saved mine, too.
Close-up of Juliana, tears spilling down her cheeks as she smiles through her grief.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Thank you.
Alexander steps forward and accepts the thick folded blankets and a wooden bucket from the villager.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: We will not forget this kindness.

units.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
units.text: Neither will the village.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking back one last time at the devastated doorway of her ruined sanctuary, hugging the ledger tightly.
Medium shot of the bald informant standing among the towering trees, reporting solemnly.

units.speaker: INFORMANT
units.text: And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess.
Close-up of the informant, his voice dropping into urgent, discreet concern.

units.speaker: INFORMANT
units.text: But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand clenching into a powerful, trembling fist at his coat seam, veins bulging with restrained violence.

units.speaker: INFORMANT
units.text: There are almost no loyal servants left around her.
Low-angle shot past Alexander toward the informant.

units.speaker: INFORMANT
units.text: The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced.
Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: My mother is a prisoner in her own house.
Close-up of the informant looking steadily at Alexander.

units.speaker: INFORMANT
units.text: And everyone believes you are dead.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred eye and grimly set mouth.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then let them believe it a little longer.

units.speaker: INFORMANT
units.text: And when we have the proof?

units.text: Close-up of Alexander turning toward her, his scarred face stoic and intense.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: For what?
Close-up of Juliana looking up at him with deep emotional vulnerability, her eyes shimmering with tears.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: For standing between me and those men.
Close-up of Alexander, his piercing blue-grey eyes fixed upon her with absolute conviction.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I would do it again.
Close-up of Juliana, her lips parting as her voice wavers with emotion.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Even if there were ten of them?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: As long as I draw breath...
Tracking shot following Alexander as he strides across the muddy garden and approaches Juliana.
Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, gently taking her trembling, bandaged hands into his large, weathered palms.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: ...no one will hurt you again.
Close-up on Juliana's tear-filled face, overwhelmed by his fierce devotion.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You cannot promise that.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's intense, protective gaze locking onto hers.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I just did.
Close-up of their joined hands, his rugged, scarred fingers wrapping securely around her bandaged fingers.
Alexander squeezes Juliana's hands reassuringly as she rests her fingertips against his skin. The scene fades to black.
Medium shot in the warm, flickering firelight of the stone cottage. Juliana kneels on the stone floor beside a washbasin of water while Alexander sits quietly in a chair beside the blazing hearth.
Juliana wrings out a clean linen cloth from the basin and tenderly dabs at the fresh cuts and abrasions on the back of Alexander's right hand.
Close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands delicately pressing the white cloth against Alexander's wounded knuckles.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You were bleeding last night.
Medium close-up showing Alexander gazing down at her, his expression softening with unspoken affection as he gently takes hold of her wrist.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: So were you.
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, a faint, tender smile gracing her lips.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You make it very difficult to argue with you.
Close-up of Alexander ducking his chin, a subtle, bashful smile fleetingly touching his scarred face.
Juliana returns the damp cloth to the ceramic basin, her expression turning somber and reflective.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her vulnerability resurfacing in the warm amber glow.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I was frightened.
Close-up of Alexander, his brow furrowing with sudden concern.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Of them?

hook_text: Intense close-up camera hook; Suspenseful opening question; Intense close-up camera hook; High-tension delivery (Trembling, Heartfelt)
cliffhanger_text: Unanswered question ('Of them?...'); Dramatic close-up freeze-frame cut

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I do not yield to a cold draft.
Close-up of Seamus, his face agonizingly strained with grief for her lost status.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: You are a viscount's daughter!

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Sleeping on straw, sorting weeds!

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Let the village tend to itself for once!
Medium close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unwavering moral strength.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: The chapel is gone, Seamus. I am the only healer these people have left.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I keep the basket.
Medium two-shot of Juliana and Seamus standing facing each other in the barn, the lantern casting a warm amber glow between them.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: They have reduced you to a peasant.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: They have reduced me to myself.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: And I am not finished.
Catherine's gloved hand sets her fine porcelain teacup down onto the silver tray with a delicate clatter.
Sharp porcelain chime of teacup meeting saucer.
Close-up of Catherine looking up, her face twisting into venomous arrogance.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Let the peasants rot in their barns.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Let them pray to their weeds.
Medium shot as Rupert steps around the mahogany table and leans close into Catherine's ear, smiling seductively.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: You have no rival here, Catherine.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: No one to stand in your way.
Close-up of Catherine looking into Rupert's eyes, her smile turning predatory and cold.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Once the old Duchess is gone...

units.text: Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You think love makes you better than me?
Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me.
Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?
Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Knowledge. Love. And people who need me.
Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: [scoffs] Peasants? People?

units.text: Tight, terrifying close-up on Alexander's eyes flashing with murderous wrath.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: ...and killing my wife afterward.
Medium shot as his mother urgently grabs Alexander's coat, pleading with him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!
Close-up on Alexander, towering over her, immovable and consumed by purpose.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They already took my name.
Close-up on Alexander stepping forward, his voice rising with lethal thunder.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They stole my home!
Tight close-up on his furious, bared teeth and wild eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And now they have taken Juliana!
Close-up of Alexander's gloved hand clenching into a tight, leather-creaking fist.
The sharp, taut creak of leather straining under monstrous grip strength.
Tracking shot following Alexander as he turns his back on the warmth of the cabin and walks boldly toward the open double barn doors.
Alexander stands framed in the doorway, staring out into the vast, snow-covered pine forest under the cold moonlight.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Two days.
Medium shot from inside the cabin, showing his mother clutching her chest, looking after Alexander's imposing silhouette standing at the threshold of the blizzard.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then they have two days to celebrate.
Side profile close-up on Alexander as his breath fogs into the icy winter night air, his jaw clenched tight.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Because before that wedding begins...
Tight side profile close-up of Alexander's battle-scarred cheek and burning gaze as he makes his final declaration.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: ...their dead Duke is coming home.
Alexander stares resolutely ahead into the dark, snowy woods as the camera holds on his grim, determined expression before cutting to black.

units.text: Lady Juliana rushes in, sets the ledger on the rustic wooden table, and quickly flips open the pages.
Close-up of Lady Juliana rapidly scanning the botanical illustrations and handwritten remedies in the book.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: His skin is burning hot.
Lady Juliana places her bandaged hand against Toby's flushed, sweating forehead as he wheezes painfully.
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana tending to Toby, with Prudence standing anxiously in the background.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!
Medium shot of Prudence nodding rapidly, rushing toward the stone hearth.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Yes! Right away, I will get it!
Prudence wraps a cloth around the iron handle of the steaming kettle resting over the hearth fire and lifts it.
Close-up top-down view of Lady Juliana's bandaged fingers gently touching an ink illustration of chamomile flowers in the open ledger.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge.
Lady Juliana crushes dried herbal leaves into a dark wooden bowl between her bandaged hands, then pours steaming water over them from the kettle.
Close-up of hot water pouring into the bowl, releasing aromatic vapors from the dried herbs.
Lady Juliana sits beside the pallet and brings the steaming herbal bowl close to Toby's face while Prudence cradles his shoulders.
Medium shot of Lady Juliana, Prudence, and Toby huddled together by the warm glow of the fire.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale.
Close-up of Prudence supporting Toby's head, whispering tenderly into his ear.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy.
Close-up of Lady Juliana gently waving her hand to direct the medicinal steam toward Toby's nose and mouth.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Yes, just like that. Keep breathing, Toby. Let the vapor clear your chest.
Toby's strained wheezing eases into quiet, rhythmic breathing as he slips into peaceful sleep on his pillow.
Close-up of Toby's face relaxing, his chest falling still and calm.
Close-up of Prudence covering her mouth in overwhelmed relief, tears streaming down her face.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!
Lady Juliana pulls the plaid wool blanket snug over Toby's chest, smiling softly with profound relief.
Medium shot of Lady Juliana sitting on a stool beside Toby's bedside, placing a cup of coltsfoot tea on a small wooden table.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning.
Medium close-up of Prudence looking at Lady Juliana with awe and boundless gratitude, her hands clasped in front of her.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you...

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you.
Lady Juliana takes Prudence's trembling hands into hers, smiling with heartfelt warmth.
Close-up of Lady Juliana comforting Prudence warmly.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence.
Low-angle shot past sleeping Toby toward Prudence standing in the room, her expression darkening with anger.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: But their gold cannot buy them health.
Lady Juliana turns sharply, her eyes widening with sudden recognition.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking directly into Prudence's eyes with startled concern.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?

units.text: Medium shot of Rupert pausing mid-stride as he hears his mother's voice, slowly turning his head toward the bed.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Stop this!
Wide shot of the bedchamber framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess props herself up on one elbow and points an accusing finger.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: She is innocent.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: She saved me!
Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Your Grace...
Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: I know what happened to me!
Medium low-angle shot past the Duchess pointing directly at Rupert, who stands rigid and expressionless.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: I was poisoned!

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: And you... you knew!
Medium shot of the Duchess lunging forward from the pillows, gasping for breath as she points toward Catherine.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Catherine knew!

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: They have been—
The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.
Wide shot as Juliana lunges across the room toward the bed, but the armed guard seizes her from behind and drags her back.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Let me help her!

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!
Medium close-up of Rupert smoothing down his black leather gloves, a chilling smile forming on his lips.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: You see?

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: The poison has clearly damaged her mind.
Over-the-shoulder shot of Rupert leaning menacingly over the gasping Duchess in bed.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: I am not delusional!

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Of course you are not.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: You are merely confused.
Medium profile tracking shot of Catherine walking deliberately toward Juliana, speaking with airy cynicism.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists...

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: ...is the maid who claims to have discovered it.
Low-angle medium shot of Rupert turning sharply toward the guard, his eyes icy and authoritative.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house.
Tight close-up of Catherine's gloved hands grabbing the delicate chain around Juliana's neck.
Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No!
Medium close-up of Catherine holding up the oval silver and amethyst pendant, inspecting it with disdain.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?
Close-up of Juliana crying out in agony, writhing in the guard's iron grip.

units.text: Tight shot of Alexander's hand clenching into a tight, trembling fist against the glow of the roaring fireplace.
Close-up of Alexander glaring daggers at Clarissa.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: ...still defending your broken scrap of a man?
Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes narrowing with sharp perception.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Name your price, Clarissa. I know you.
Medium close-up of Clarissa smiling with vicious delight.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape.
Tight shot of Clarissa smoothing her long purple evening glove along her wrist.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Perhaps I can give you one.
Close-up of Juliana watching her with cautious skepticism.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: What do you want?
Medium two-shot of Clarissa in the foreground, turning slowly to face Juliana.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: I want to see you crawl, sister.
Medium close-up profile tracking shot of Clarissa pacing slowly as she spins her sadistic tale.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it...
Close-up of Clarissa flexing her gloved fingers theatrically in front of her face.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: ...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice.
Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.
Medium two-shot of Clarissa stepping closer to Juliana, peering down into her eyes with a predatory smile.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives.
Medium shot of Gerald tapping his whip against his palm and laughing heartily beside the Constable.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!
Medium three-shot of Clarissa stepping behind Juliana, as Alexander watches helplessly with dark fury.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Do it, and we withdraw the charges.
Extreme close-up of Clarissa's mouth leaning directly into Juliana's ear, whispering venomously.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows.
Medium close-up of Alexander stepping up beside Juliana, tenderly placing his large hand on her shoulder.
Alexander rests his scarred hand reassuringly on Juliana's shoulder, leaning in toward her.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana, no. Do not let them hurt you. I can handle the law.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, her hand gripping the fabric over her heart in agony and resolve.
Juliana clutches the front of her rustic grey dress, her breathing trembling.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I am not letting them take you.
Juliana turns her head sharply back toward Clarissa, her expression hardening with fierce resolution.
Over-the-shoulder shot past Clarissa onto Juliana's determined face, holding on her fierce, defiant stare as the tension peaks.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Tell me where the garden is.

Juliana locks eyes with Clarissa without flinching as the scene freezes on her brave, sacrificial defiance.

--- SCRIPT END ---

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Then how did you survive?
Side profile of Alexander as his eyes look into the distance, haunted by the past.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I wasn't supposed to.
Alexander steps over to the wooden table, looking down at the parchment map spread out under the lantern.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Three years ago, I was sent to the Iberian front.
Close-up of Alexander's weathered face looking down pensively as he recounts the mission.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies.
Alexander's scarred finger points to a red-circled location on the parchment map marked near Madrid.
Close-up on his mother, gasping with wide, horrified eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: A traitor?

units.text: Close-up on his mother as her expression shifts to profound bewilderment and outrage.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Then why did they never tell us?
Close-up on Alexander's intense, piercing gaze.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Who?
Alexander turns away toward the frosted window, staring out into the dark raging blizzard outside.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I spent three years trying to find out.
Alexander abruptly pushes away from the window, storming back toward the table with burning rage.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: The ambush was not an accident.
He leans heavily over the wooden table, looming close as his fury boils over.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Someone ordered my men to die.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Someone wanted me erased.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Who?

units.text: Medium shot of Alexander clenching his fists at his sides, trembling with rage.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You told them the truth!
Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They called her a witch!
Frontal medium shot of Alexander standing frozen, the weight of the realization crashing down on him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana... is in a cell?
Close-up of his mother clutching her temple, reeling in remembered trauma.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: She was taken before a magistrate.
Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes wild with terror for his wife.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And?!
Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They condemned her.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: No.
Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: She is to be executed.
Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: When?

units.text: Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You were never my Duchess.
Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: But I loved you!
Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You loved the Duke you thought you would marry.
Close-up on Catherine, gasping in protest.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: No!
Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I loved you before all this!
Close-up on Alexander tilting his head slightly, his gaze piercing through her.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Did you?
Close-up on Catherine, rendered speechless by his doubt.
Tilt-up shot starting from heavy iron chains resting on the wooden floor up to the shackled wrists of Juliana dressed in her rustic grey gown.
Wide shot from behind Catherine as Alexander turns his back on her and walks resolutely down the rubble-strewn aisle toward Juliana standing in chains at the doorway.
Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana, who waits solemnly by the cathedral entrance.
Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, lifting her gaze gently.
Extreme close-up on Catherine's horrified, bewildered expression as she realizes who Alexander chose.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text:
Her?!"

units.text: Medium tracking shot as the Bald Thug charges in with a shout, only for Alexander to pivot and seize him by the neck, hurling him across the garden path.

units.speaker: BALD THUG
units.text: Aaargh!
Loud wooden scrape and crunch as the Bald Thug slides across the planks into the fence.
Medium shot of the Third Thug backing away nervously, raising a blunt rod with trembling arms before lunging.

units.speaker: THIRD THUG
units.text: Stay back!
Alexander deflects the strike with his forearm, drives a swift counter-blow into the thug's torso, and spins him violently to the ground.
Solid bone-and-fist impact followed by a groaning thud.
Wide cinematic shot under the full moon. Alexander towers over the three writhing thugs groaning in the mud as Juliana looks up from her knees.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up at Alexander, tears glistening on her mud-splattered cheeks in profound relief.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander...
Medium shot over Juliana's shoulder as Alexander turns his gaze toward her, his stern demeanor softening with concern.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Are you hurt?
Close-up of Juliana's trembling, soil-stained hands wrapped in blood-soaked bandages.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Only my hands.
Medium shot as Alexander suddenly wheels around, strides to the groaning Thug with Cap, and yanks him straight off the ground by his coat collar with one arm.
Alexander lifts the thug onto his tiptoes against the cottage wall, glaring with lethal intensity.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Who sent you?
Close-up of the Thug with Cap gagging under Alexander's iron fist.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: No one!
Close-up of Alexander, his eyes darkening with lethal fury.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Wrong answer.
Alexander tightens his grip on the thug's throat, lifting him higher against the stone wall.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Who?!
Extreme close-up of the terrified thug gasping for air, his eyes bulging.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: Harrington! Gerald Harrington paid us!
Close-up of Juliana on the ground, reeling in devastated disbelief as the betrayal hits her.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Gerald...
Medium wide shot as Alexander releases the thug, sending him tumbling into the ruined flowerbeds.
The Thug with Cap scrambles to his feet and sprints into the dark woods alongside his two limping accomplices.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: We were only paid to destroy the garden, that's all!
Close-up on Alexander's hand hanging by his coat. Fresh blood trickles from his split knuckles, and he slowly curls his fingers into a tight fist.
Alexander flexes his bleeding hand, showing no sign of pain.
Medium shot as Juliana gingerly rises to her feet, stepping toward Alexander with deep awe and wonder in her eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You knew exactly what to do.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, searching his scarred face.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You fought like you've done this a hundred times.
Medium close-up of Alexander turning his profile away, shadowed by haunted memories of his past.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: A soldier learns things he wishes he could forget.
Close-up of Juliana softening with deep empathy as her eyes drop to his bleeding knuckle.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Are you hurt?

units.text: The Duchess clutches the blanket against her chest, her breathing quickening with dismay.
Medium close-up of the Duchess looking upward toward Juliana, her voice trembling with tragic certainty.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?
Medium shot of Juliana leaning over the edge of the mattress, nodding earnestly to soothe her fears.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Yes. But the charcoal is fighting the poison. You are safe now.
Close-up of the small amber dropper bottle sitting atop the polished wooden bedside table in the dim glow of the lamp.
Medium shot of the Dowager Duchess looking intently at Juliana from her pillows, studying her bearing.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?
