units.text: Tight close-up of Rupert swallows hard, breathless with dread.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: If she speaks...
Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.
The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!
Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: What are you suggesting?
Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: We stop hiding the prisoner.
Tracking shot from behind the Elder Nobleman as he pushes open the heavy double doors into the dark wood-paneled library.
The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.
Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: We give them a reason to condemn her.
Wide shot of Catherine standing regally before the roaring stone hearth, dressed in an ornate burgundy and gold brocade gown, slowly unfurling a red lace fan.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You have a solution?
Side profile close-up of the Elder Nobleman speaking with icy confidence.

units.text: Close-up of Catherine looking down at the invitations, her braided blonde hair immaculately pinned, before she raises her eyes with a slight smirk.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: The wedding?
Close-up on Rupert, his sharp aristocratic features set in cold conviction.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: The transfer of Ashbridge.
Medium close-up of Catherine picking up one of the invitations, turning it over in her gloved hands with predatory delight.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: After the ceremony, no one will question who owns this house.
Intense close-up of Rupert leaning in slightly, his eyes narrowing with venomous malice.
Close-up on Juliana's bruised hand, locked in a heavy iron shackle chained to the wall, trembling as she hesitates inches away from a dirty earthen bowl filled with murky liquid.
Juliana curls her fingers back, pulling away from the foul sustenance in defiance.
Tight close-up of Juliana's dirty, tear-stained face. Her eyes squeeze shut as tears stream down her cheeks from overwhelming physical agony and hunger.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: They think hunger will make me surrender.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's blue eyes snapping open, blazing with unyielding defiance.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: They think fear will make me beg.
Full shot of Juliana using her bare hands against the slimy stone floor to drag herself upright to her knees, chains rattling loudly.
The harsh scrape and clatter of heavy iron chains dragging across wet stone.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I will not!
Low-angle shot looking up at Juliana as she thrusts her chin high toward the iron ceiling grate, bathed in cold shafts of light.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: They can take my name. They can take my home.
Tight close-up of Juliana's iron-shackled hand reaching out and gripping the massive iron ring anchored into the dungeon pillar with crushing determination.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: They cannot take who I am!
Medium two-shot in the dimly lit parlor, illuminated by the warm glow of the fireplace. Clarissa now wears a deep blue velvet gown, reclining in an armchair beside the nobleman.

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN
units.text: Do you think she'll actually be executed?

units.text: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at him with genuine curiosity.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: How do you know that?
Close-up of Alexander speaking in a steady, measured tone.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Soldiers learn quickly which plants keep a man alive.
Insert shot of Juliana's hands gently arranging several tied bundles of dried yarrow sprigs on the tabletop.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You know more about healing than you let on.
Close-up of Alexander, bathed in warm hearth embers, offering a subtle, knowing half-smile.

units.text: Ah!

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Stop!

units.text: Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her.

units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Leave it!

units.text: No! No!

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana!

units.text: Medium close-up of Juliana resting her hands on the closed journal, looking squarely at Prudence.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Someone is poisoning her.
Medium shot of Prudence gasping sharply and clamping both hands over her mouth in sheer horror.
Sharp intake of breath from Prudence.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Poison?
Extreme close-up pushing in tight on Lady Juliana's eyes as her expression hardens into fury and righteous disgust.

units.text: Arsenic.
Sudden violent coughing and sputtering from the Duchess.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: The charcoal may help remove what is still inside her. We must act quickly.
Sudden muffled thump and heavy footsteps echoing from the hallway outside the door!

Close-up of Prudence staring at the door in utter terror, her face drained of all color.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Who are you?
Medium close-up of Juliana, her gaze lowered deferentially beside the carved wooden bedpost.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Juliana, my lady. I was hired for the winter cleaning.
Medium shot of the noblewoman, her chin tilted up in icy condescension.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: And who gave you permission to enter this chamber?
Close-up of the frail Dowager Duchess lying pale and unconscious against the white pillows, gasping weakly for air.
Behind her grey skirt, Juliana quickly slips the small glass remedy vial into her apron pocket with her charcoal-dusted fingers.
Close-up on Juliana's hand swiftly concealing the medicine bottle.
Medium shot of Juliana facing the noblewoman, maintaining a calm, protective facade.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I heard her. I thought Her Grace needed help.
Two-shot framing the noblewoman looking down at Juliana, bursting into mocking laughter.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: You thought? A new maid thinks she knows better than the physicians?
Close-up of Juliana's resolute expression, her eyes flashing with righteous urgency.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: She is suffering.
Tight close-up of the noblewoman's face twisting into a malicious sneer.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA

Medium shot of Juliana hunched over in pain, clutching her abdomen.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: You are a maid.
Low-angle shot looking past the bedpost toward the Duchess, whose trembling hand reaches out limply.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Not a physician. Not a lady.
Dramatic low-angle wide shot of the noblewoman standing imperiously over the doubled-over Juliana.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters.
Close-up of Juliana looking down, enduring the humiliation while stifling her breath.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Yes, my lady.
Medium shot of the noblewoman turning the crop in her white-gloved hands with smug satisfaction.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place.
The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.
Low tracking shot down the corridor as the hem of the lilac dress sweeps past, followed by Juliana's swift steps.
Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.
Wide shot of the vast soot-stained stone fireplace. The noblewoman turns back toward Juliana, crop held at her side.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Clean it.
Medium shot of the noblewoman extending her gloved hand toward the cavernous, filth-laden hearth.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at the towering, soot-blackened chimney.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: All of it, my lady?
Extreme close-up two-shot as the noblewoman steps unnervingly close to Juliana's face, whispering with sadistic relish.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Alexander... I thought you had died.
Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Do you know what this did to me?
Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I mourned you.
Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I waited for you.
Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea.
Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.
Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I never stopped loving you.
Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.
Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.
Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You don't remember?
High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I was supposed to be your Duchess!
Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You were never my Duchess.
Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: But I loved you!
Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You loved the Duke you thought you would marry.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: No!
Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I loved you before all this!

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Did you?

Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, lifting her gaze gently.
Extreme close-up on Catherine's horrified, bewildered expression as she realizes who Alexander chose.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text:
Her?!"

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: They have reduced you to a peasant.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Let the peasants rot in their barns.

units.text: Let them pray to their weeds.

units.text: A woman who was betrayed.

units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal.
Low-angle two-shot of the High Priest staring up into Alexander's imposing frame.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours.
Medium close-up of Alexander glaring with icy authority.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: We're clearing this rubbish.
Close-up on Juliana, her face tight with anguish and fury as she clutches her bandaged hands against her chest.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Those are medicinal plants!
Low-angle shot tracking down from the bald thug's grinning face to his worn leather boots on the muddy flagstones.

units.speaker: BALD THUG
units.text: They look like weeds to me.
The bald thug flings the bouquet into the mud and grinds his heavy boot directly onto the delicate flowers.
High-angle two-shot as Juliana rushes forward and drops directly onto her knees in the cold mud before the thug.
Juliana frantically tries to scoop the crushed soil and torn stems back into the bed with her bandaged hands.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Please! Those plants took months to grow!
Medium two-shot of the Tall Thug with the club and the Thug with Cap bursting into raucous laughter under the full moon.

units.speaker: TALL THUG
units.text: Months? You actually spend your days growing this filth?
Tight close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands trembling as she tenderly gathers the soiled white flowers from the puddles.

units.text: The Duchess clutches the blanket against her chest, her breathing quickening with dismay.
Medium close-up of the Duchess looking upward toward Juliana, her voice trembling with tragic certainty.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?
Medium shot of Juliana leaning over the edge of the mattress, nodding earnestly to soothe her fears.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Yes. But the charcoal is fighting the poison. You are safe now.
Close-up of the small amber dropper bottle sitting atop the polished wooden bedside table in the dim glow of the lamp.
Medium shot of the Dowager Duchess looking intently at Juliana from her pillows, studying her bearing.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?
Close-up of Juliana, her chin lifting with dignified sorrow and quiet defiance.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor.
Medium tracking down Juliana's apron to her hand as she rests it against the bed linens, revealing a distinctive engraved signet ring on her finger.
Juliana rests her right hand against the edge of the bedcover, unwittingly placing the unique ring directly within the Duchess's line of sight.
A sharp, stunned gasp.
Extreme close-up of the Dowager Duchess gasping sharply, her eyes widening in profound shock as all color drains from her face.
The Duchess's mouth hangs open in pure disbelief as she stares fixedly at Juliana's hand.
Medium shot of the Duchess pushing herself up against the headboard, trembling as she stretches out her frail hand.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Your hand... Let me see your hand.
Close-up of Juliana reacting with confusion and growing concern at the elder woman's sudden frenzy.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Your Grace? What is wrong? You look as though you've seen a ghost.

units.text: Close-up of Rupert looking bewildered.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: The law?
Tracking medium shot as the Elder Nobleman paces slowly behind the massive mahogany desk lined with books and a glass of whiskey.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: A maid with herbs in her possession, a secret medicine, an unauthorized visit to the Duchess's chamber.
The Elder Nobleman leans both hands against the desk, leaning forward intently.
Medium close-up of Catherine fluttering her fan beneath her chin, smirking approvingly.
Medium shot framing the Elder Nobleman seated at the desk beside Catherine standing in the firelight.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner.
Medium close-up of Catherine gently moving her fan, raising an intrigued brow.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And if she claims she is a healer?
Tight close-up of the Elder Nobleman's face illuminated by warm firelight.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Then call it witchcraft.
Close-up of Rupert wide-eyed with shock at the severity of the plan.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: Witchcraft is a capital charge.
Straight-on close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring back without a flicker of remorse.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Precisely.
Medium three-shot framing Rupert, the Elder Nobleman between them, and Catherine listening closely.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her.
Close-up of Catherine smiling with malicious satisfaction, fluttering her fan.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Her botanical ledger...
Close-up of the Elder Nobleman nodding slowly.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Exactly.
Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And the Dowager?

units.text: Close-up of the maid gasping, shaking her head vigorously in panic.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: No!
Profile medium two-shot as the Lord looms inches from the maid's face.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Think carefully.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Your brother is still a pauper.
Extreme close-up of the Lord's cold eyes and hawkish profile speaking with chilling finality.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise.
The maid gasps in sheer terror, her chest heaving as tears stream.
Close-up of the maid clutching her chest with trembling hands, crying desperately.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: Please, my Lord... he is only seven!
Close-up of the Lord staring down without an ounce of pity.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Then help him.
Close-up of the maid weeping profusely, cornered and helpless.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: What do you want me to say?!
Wide shot of the study as the Lord stands calmly before the trembling servant.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: The truth.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: She drew something around the bed, did she not?
Close-up of the maid stammering through her tears.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: She... placed dried herbs around him.
Medium close-up of the Lord standing right beside her shoulder, whispering in her ear like an insidious specter.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Around him.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Like a circle?

units.text: The Lord turns dramatically to face the entire assembly, gesturing toward the spectators.
Medium shot of the Lord addressing the courtroom.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: The people call it poisoning!
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking past him directly toward the gallery with sharp clarity.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: What were their illnesses?
Low-angle close-up of the Lord looking down arrogantly over his shoulder.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Irrelevant.
Close-up of Lady Juliana gritting her teeth in fierce defiance.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: It is not irrelevant!
Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana standing tall against the courtroom window light, her chained hands resting on the balustrade as she addresses the entire hall.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Herbs are not magic! They are medicine!
Medium shot of the Judge sitting with steepled fingers upon his high bench.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: You admit you administered them?
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking straight forward.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Yes.
Medium shot of the Judge gesturing with an open hand.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Without the approval of a licensed physician?
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana shaking her head slightly, truth ringing in her voice.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: There was no physician willing to help them.
Close-up of Lady Juliana's steady gaze.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: So I helped them.
Medium close-up of the Lord smiling cynically as he turns back toward the magistrate.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Even now, she refuses to repent.
Low-angle medium shot of the Judge holding his hand over the open law book.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Lady Juliana, if you wish to save yourself, renounce these practices.
Close-up of the burned grimoire resting on the green leather surface of the court table.
Close-up of Lady Juliana lifting her chin without an ounce of hesitation.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: No.
Medium shot of the Judge lowering his brow with dark finality.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Think carefully.
Low-angle close-up of Lady Juliana looking skyward through the arched court windows.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I have.
Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched finger across the bench, his tone hardening into lethal severity.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: You understand that refusal may be treated as proof that you knowingly practiced witchcraft?
Close-up of Lady Juliana unflinchingly accepting her fate.

units.text: Close-up on Juliana staring straight ahead as Clarissa insults her mother's memory.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: ...not a dull creature who hides in her mother's apothecary herbs.
High-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral aisle as a matriarch dressed in an ornate black velvet gown glides toward Juliana.
The matriarch steps into the center aisle, glaring down at Juliana with cold superiority.

units.speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
units.text: Oh, don't look so wounded, Juliana.
Medium profile two-shot of the matriarch confronting Juliana face-to-face.

units.speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
units.text: You should be grateful you're at least allowed to attend the wedding.
Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward on the altar steps, impatiently gesturing Juliana toward the church exit.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: Go home quietly, Juliana. At least leave this chapel with some dignity.
Profile close-up of Juliana turning her face back toward the altar, tears still shimmering on her cheeks.
Direct close-up on Juliana's face as a steely, defiant smile emerges through her pain.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Dignity?
Full shot of Juliana standing tall, her posture completely transforming into regal composure before the seated guests.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You abandoned a woman who trusted you...
Medium profile close-up on Gerald's hardening jawline, Clarissa blurred in the background.

units.text: Wide shot looking down from the stone terrace. Gerald and Clarissa stand elevated on the balustrade, while Juliana, Alexander in handcuffs, and the Constable stand before the dense briar garden.
Alexander turns toward Juliana, his manacled hands trembling as he grips her arm.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana, look at those thorns. You cannot do this.
Medium close-up of Alexander and Juliana facing each other, his chained wrists held between them.
Close-up on Juliana's hooded face, her eyes filled with resolute sorrow.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I must.
Close-up on Alexander, his combat scar stark against his pained expression.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They will tear your hands apart.
Low-angle shot looking up at Gerald and Clarissa leaning over the stone balustrade, smirking down with cruel amusement.
Close-up of Juliana looking up into Alexander's eyes with tender courage.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I will be fine.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I would rather face the gallows than watch you hurt yourself for me.
Two-shot framing Alexander leaning down toward Juliana, fighting against his bonds.
Close-up of Gerald chuckling smugly on the terrace above, crossing his arms.
Tight close-up of Juliana gently clasping Alexander's handcuffed hands, gazing up at him with unyielding love.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You stood beside me when everyone else abandoned me. I will not abandon you now.
Juliana releases his hands and turns toward the briar thicket. Alexander stretches out his chained hands, attempting to hold her back, but the Constable restrains him.
Medium shot behind Juliana as she walks toward the vast expanse of frozen briars.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Careful, sister.
Low-angle shot of Clarissa smirking down over the carved stone balustrade.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: That garden has swallowed better women than you.
Medium close-up of Gerald leaning against the balcony beside Clarissa, wearing an arrogant smirk.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Perhaps the beggar's wife will finally learn what her new life is worth.

units.text: Close-up of Juliana's hand getting snagged between two vicious thorns, tearing her sleeve and flesh.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Ah!
Alexander loses control, violently lunging past the Constable toward the briars.
Medium tracking shot of Alexander breaking into a desperate charge.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Stop!
Juliana continues clawing forward, branches lacerating her arm and cheek.
Close-up of Juliana wincing in agony and screaming through clenched teeth.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Ahhh!
Medium shot of the Constable forcefully grappling Alexander by his coat collar, slamming him back against the gate.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana!
Ground-level shot of Juliana frantically digging and scraping at the frozen dirt and dried bramble pods with both bloody hands.
Juliana digs her torn fingers into the frost-hardened earth, turning over rocks and dead vegetation.
Medium close-up of Alexander struggling against the Constable, his face twisted in grief and rage.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana!
Close-up of Juliana lying on her stomach among the thorns, bleeding cuts running down her forehead, cheeks, and bare arms.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Please, ring... you have to be here.
Her blood-smeared index finger brushes against a solid metallic object half-buried in the frozen dirt beneath a thorny branch.
Extreme close-up macro shot of an ornate antique gold ring set with a massive, radiant emerald resting in the frosted soil.
Close-up of Juliana's wide, disbelieving blue eyes as breath catches in her throat.
Juliana reaches out her torn, bloodied hand and wraps her fingers tightly around the emerald ring.

units.text: Wide shot from behind Alexander's trench coat looking toward the three thugs standing across the trampled garden under the full moon.
Alexander stands tall and unyielding, blocking the path to Juliana, while the Thug with Cap steps forward clutching an iron pipe.
Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap, his eyes wide and sneering with false bravado as his bald accomplice watches from behind.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: Move aside, soldier.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred, weathered face, his cold blue-grey eyes fixed intently on his opponent.
Low-angle medium shot of the Thug with Cap gripping his weapon with both hands and roaring into the night air.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: I said, move!
Medium close-up of Alexander remaining completely motionless, his jaw clenched in stoic calm.
Close-up of Juliana kneeling in the mud against the ruined planter, clutching her bandaged hands to her chest in trembling fear.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander...

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Stay behind me.
Medium action shot as the Thug with Cap lunges forward with his weapon raised high.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: Aaargh!
The thug swings the club down with full force, but Alexander catches the weapon mid-air in his bare hand with chilling ease.
Heavy blunt impact of a solid hand gripping wood.
Close-up of the Thug with Cap staring in wide-eyed terror as Alexander grips the bar and wrenches it away effortlessly.
Alexander strikes the thug across the chest and slams him violently into the muddy ground beside the stone wall.
Heavy thud of a body crashing into soil and wood.
Close-up of Juliana watching in breathless astonishment.
Medium tracking shot as the Bald Thug charges in with a shout, only for Alexander to pivot and seize him by the neck, hurling him across the garden path.

units.speaker: BALD THUG
units.text: Aaargh!
Loud wooden scrape and crunch as the Bald Thug slides across the planks into the fence.
Medium shot of the Third Thug backing away nervously, raising a blunt rod with trembling arms before lunging.

units.speaker: THIRD THUG
units.text: Stay back!
Alexander deflects the strike with his forearm, drives a swift counter-blow into the thug's torso, and spins him violently to the ground.
Solid bone-and-fist impact followed by a groaning thud.
Wide cinematic shot under the full moon. Alexander towers over the three writhing thugs groaning in the mud as Juliana looks up from her knees.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up at Alexander, tears glistening on her mud-splattered cheeks in profound relief.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander...

units.text: Medium close-up of Catherine, holding the smoldering iron between them.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You call that marriage?
Extreme close-up of Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with profound conviction.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I call it love.
High-angle wide shot looking straight down through the ceiling iron grating into the deep dungeon shaft where Catherine looms over Juliana.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: [laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking directly up past the glowing tip of the iron poker into Catherine's eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: To a place where I can still look you in the eyes.
Close-up of Catherine, her lips curling in indignant disbelief.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You think love makes you better than me?
Close-up of Juliana speaking calmly and razor-sharp.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me.
Medium shot of Catherine sweeping her arm out, flaunting her aristocratic privilege and opulence.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?
Close-up of Juliana, her expression serene and grounded in moral superiority.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Knowledge. Love. And people who need me.
Tight shot of Catherine's gloved hands holding Juliana's mother's partially burned botanical volume, 'The Virtues of Plants & Herbs'.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: [scoffs] Peasants? People?
Medium shot of Catherine casually holding the ancient book while pacing slowly before Juliana.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve.
Tight close-up of Juliana's face, tilting her head with an insightful, knowing smirk.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?
Catherine's smug expression freezes, her eyes widening in momentary shock and fury as the blow lands squarely.
Low-angle medium shot of Juliana, her voice ringing clearly through the subterranean chamber.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow.
Close-up of Catherine completely losing control, her aristocratic facade shattering into sheer rage.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Enough!
Close-up of the red-hot poker pressing directly down into the delicate open pages of the botanical book.

units.text: Close-up of Juliana, chained against the brick wall, tears glistening on her cheeks as she trembles in grief.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: There it is.
Low-angle medium shot of Catherine in her opulent velvet gown, clutching the hot poker with a sadistic sneer.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Fear.
Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward over the burning book, eyes glittering with malice.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You have been so proud of that brave little face...
Wide shot showing Juliana chained against the cold dungeon wall, small and restrained beneath Catherine's towering shadow.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: ...but now you are afraid.
Medium shot of Catherine straightening up haughtily.
Extreme close-up of Juliana, her lips trembling in agonizing sorrow.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Say goodbye to your mother.
Low-angle shot of Catherine swinging the flaming orange iron upward from the book.
Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.
Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Burn it.
Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.
Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: What?
Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Burn the ledger. Burn every page.
Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You may destroy the book...
Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.

units.text: Yes, Your Honor.
Medium close-up of the Judge leaning forward with folded hands.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Did you witness Lady Juliana perform these treatments?
Profile over-the-shoulder shot from behind Prudence toward Lady Juliana standing bound in iron cuffs at the prisoner's dock.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Tell the truth.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Yes.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking at her former maid, a momentary flicker of hurt passing through her eyes before settling into stoic composure.
Medium profile shot of the Judge recording notes in the open court ledger with a feather quill.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: What did you see?
Medium close-up of Prudence clutching both hands to her chest in anguish.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: She used herbs... and her mother's book.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Did she draw strange markings?

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: She... placed herbs around my brother's bed.
Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched index finger with piercing intensity.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: And did she speak words you could not understand?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Mother?
She drops her walking staff and rushes forward, throwing her arms around Alexander's neck. He pulls her tightly into his chest.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: You're alive.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Mother.
She leans back slightly, her frail hand reaching up to gently cup his bearded, scarred cheek, staring into his eyes in disbelief.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: I buried you.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I know.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They told me you died. They told me your entire regiment was destroyed.
Close-up on Alexander's hardened, shadowed profile, his jaw tight with grim memories.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Most of them were.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Then how did you survive?

units.text: Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana looking into Prudence's tearful face with compassionate urgency.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened.
Close-up of Prudence weeping, clutching her hands to her chest in agony.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!
Close-up of Lady Juliana, her brow furrowing with concern.
Toby's strained wheezing eases into quiet, rhythmic breathing as he slips into peaceful sleep on his pillow.
Close-up of Toby's face relaxing, his chest falling still and calm.
Close-up of Prudence covering her mouth in overwhelmed relief, tears streaming down her face.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!
Lady Juliana pulls the plaid wool blanket snug over Toby's chest, smiling softly with profound relief.
Medium shot of Lady Juliana sitting on a stool beside Toby's bedside, placing a cup of coltsfoot tea on a small wooden table.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning.
Medium close-up of Prudence looking at Lady Juliana with awe and boundless gratitude, her hands clasped in front of her.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you...

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you.
Lady Juliana takes Prudence's trembling hands into hers, smiling with heartfelt warmth.
Close-up of Lady Juliana comforting Prudence warmly.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence.
Low-angle shot past sleeping Toby toward Prudence standing in the room, her expression darkening with anger.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: But their gold cannot buy them health.
Lady Juliana turns sharply, her eyes widening with sudden recognition.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking directly into Prudence's eyes with startled concern.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?

units.text: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred hand holding out the silver band ring.
Medium close-up of Juliana, staring down in disbelief at the offered ring.
Juliana's eyes widen, stunned breath catching in her throat.
Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward from his pew with a smug, sneering grin.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Look at him.
Tight close-up of Gerald's venomous, self-satisfied face.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: A penniless nobody for a discarded bride.
Medium shot of Clarissa covering her mouth with her gloved hand, bursting into cruel laughter.
Clarissa giggles spitefully, lowering her gloved hand to gloat.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: How fitting.
Two-shot of Clarissa and Gerald standing proudly side-by-side in their pew as Clarissa points mocking fingers.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: You have finally found a man as worthless as everyone thinks you are.
Close-up of Juliana's side profile, hurt glistening in her eyes as the insult cuts deep.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up toward the high arches of the chapel, drawing inward strength.
Juliana closes her eyes briefly and releases a steadying breath.
Low-angle shot looking past the kneeling Mysterious Bearded Man up at Juliana.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You don't even know me.
Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gazing upward with unwavering earnestness.
Tight close-up of Juliana's anguished face.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You heard what they think I am.
Medium shot looking down as Juliana addresses the kneeling stranger directly.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Why would you offer me your name?
Low-angle close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: Because I know what I see.
Medium close-up of Juliana reacting with a mix of suspicion and wonder.
Intimate tight shot framing Juliana's profile beside his dark silhouette.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: And what do you see?
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: A woman who was betrayed.
Over-the-shoulder shot past the bearded warrior toward Gerald watching nervously from the family pew.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: Not a woman who deserves to be discarded.
Low-angle medium shot of Juliana bending slightly forward, shaken by his words.
Medium close-up of Juliana.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You don't know what my family has done to me.

units.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine sneering sharply.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: An antidote to what?
Extreme close-up of Juliana's focused eyes.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Answer her.
Close-up on the Blond Nobleman's impatient scowl.
Close-up of Juliana speaking the truth clearly.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Poison.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Poison.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Someone has been poisoning Her Grace.
Medium shot of Lady Catherine turning abruptly to the guard stationed by the open door, pointing with feigned outrage.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: You hear that?!

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: That is not what I said!

units.text: Enough.
Medium two-shot as the Blond Nobleman steps into Juliana's personal space and plucks the glass dropper vial from her hand.
The Blond Nobleman takes the medicine vial from Juliana's grasp, inspecting it under the candlelight.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: An unknown servant enters a restricted chamber.
Tight close-up of the Blond Nobleman holding the vial beside his temple, his blue eyes cold and triumphant.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Take her.

units.text: Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up from the stone floor, her gaze hardening despite her fear.
Tight close-up of Catherine's face, bathed in the orange flickering glow of the red-hot branding iron, smiling with pure malice.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft.
Over-the-shoulder wide shot past Catherine looking down at Juliana shackled helplessly on the wet stone floor.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, speaking with quiet defiance.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You seem very pleased.
Low-angle shot looking up at Catherine towering over Juliana, holding the glowing poker at her side.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I am.
Extreme close-up of the bent, white-hot tip of the poker radiating heat, with Catherine's face blurred in the background as she gazes down with predatory pleasure.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Because this is what you were always meant to be.
Over-the-shoulder medium shot focusing on Juliana as Catherine presents the charred, singed pages of the botanical book.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name.
Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: [chuckles] And still you became a disgrace.
Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel.
Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar.
Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Do you remember?

units.text: Close-up on Rupert staring wide-eyed, completely petrified.
Medium close-up on the Crown Official continuing the official reading.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised.
Frontal medium shot of the Crown Official turning a page as the congregation listens in breathless silence.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: The report identifies the leak as deliberate.
Wide shot across the rubble of the cathedral floor showing Rupert crumbling in fear against the choir railing.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Information regarding the Duke's position was transmitted through British channels.
Rupert staggers backward, his knees buckling as he leans his weight heavily on the stone balustrade.
Close-up on Rupert clinging to the stone pillar, his breath shallow and terrified.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: No...
Medium shot on Alexander stepping forward, thrusting the secondary dossier forward.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Read the names.
Medium close-up on the Crown Official reading the concluding section.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Lord Henry Sterling.
Quick pan to Lord Sterling stiffening in his pew, then the Crown Official.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Rupert Ashburn.
Extreme close-up on Rupert's horrified eyes darting in sheer terror.
Close-up on the Dowager Duchess covering her mouth in agonizing disbelief.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: My God...
Low-angle shot on Alexander towering over the fallen Rupert.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You sold my men to the enemy.
Close-up on Rupert waving his hands defensively, hyperventilating.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: I didn't!
Low-angle tracking push-in on Alexander raising the red-ribboned war document toward the cathedral arches.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And when you believed I was dead...

Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the frozen soil at the edge of the briars.
Medium shot of Alexander lunging forward with chained hands raised high, roaring in fury as the Constable grabs him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana, stop!
Rattling of heavy iron chains.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Please...

Ground-level shot of Juliana's bare hands reaching out onto the cracked, frozen ground.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Look at her hands.
Medium shot on the balcony as Clarissa gleefully points down at Juliana, Gerald chuckling beside her.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: The lady has finally found something worthy of her.
Gerald leans his hands on the terrace railing, sneering callously.
Low-angle medium close-up of Gerald shouting down into the garden.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Keep searching, Juliana. Your husband's freedom is somewhere in that garden.

Close-up of Alexander struggling in agony, tears forming in his eyes.

units.text: Please... enough!

Profile close-up of the father staring blankly forward.
Low-angle shot looking up at the Matriarch commanding the space with regal severity.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: Enough!

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: You have embarrassed this family long enough.
Close-up on Juliana as she rises, stung by the utter betrayal.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Embarrassed you?
Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing toward Clarissa, who stands elegantly in gold.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: Clarissa knows how to carry herself.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: She has beauty, connections, and a future worth protecting.
Medium profile two-shot of the Matriarch confronting Juliana face to face.
Close-up on Juliana, demanding answers in spite of her humiliation.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: And I am what?
Medium tracking shot showing the Lady in Gold Gown stepping past Juliana toward the center.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to.
Close-up on Juliana absorbing the venomous words, her breathing shallow.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: I am the daughter they choose.
Medium shot of the Lady in Gold Gown smiling warmly at Gerald beside the altar candles.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: Clarissa is the jewel of this family.
Close two-shot of the Matriarch and Juliana standing side by side in profile.
Medium shot framing Juliana looking directly at Gerald, who towers over her coldly.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: So that is what I was worth to you?
Close-up on Gerald's sharp jawline as he looks down at her without an ounce of remorse.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: You have nothing to offer me anymore.
Extreme close-up on Juliana's eye as a single tear rolls down her cheek.
Full shot tracking Gerald as he turns his back on Juliana and walks back toward Clarissa and the altar.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: I cannot marry a woman of such plainness and low value...

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Who are you? Speak to me. I have not seen your face before.
Close-up of Juliana leaning over the bed, holding the dropper bottle carefully toward the Duchess's mouth, her expression urgent yet tender.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Please, Your Grace. Drink the last of this antidote. Drink it slowly.
Extreme close-up of the Duchess taking drops of the dark liquid from the glass bottle onto her lips.
The Duchess swallows the remedy with difficulty as Juliana carefully tilts the amber bottle.
Medium two-shot as Juliana withdraws the medicine bottle, standing beside the bedside lamp.
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess observing Juliana with faint recognition through her exhaustion.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: You... you are no common servant. You took Catherine's whip for me the other day.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes reflecting quiet resolve and pain.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I did what I had to. It does not change my duty.
Medium two-shot as Juliana leans closer to tuck the blankets securely over the Duchess.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Rest now, Your Grace. You are safe tonight.
Close-up of Juliana looking around the shadowy room, her voice dropping to a tense whisper.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: If the guards hear us, we are both dead.
Static shot of the heavy carved double doors to the bedchamber, left slightly ajar with a sliver of hallway candlelight gleaming through the gap.
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying back, processing Juliana's warning as dark realization settles into her face.
The Duchess clutches the blanket against her chest, her breathing quickening with dismay.
Medium close-up of the Duchess looking upward toward Juliana, her voice trembling with tragic certainty.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: If she speaks...
Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.
The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!
Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: What are you suggesting?
Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: We stop hiding the prisoner.
Tracking shot from behind the Elder Nobleman as he pushes open the heavy double doors into the dark wood-paneled library.
The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.
Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: We give them a reason to condemn her.
Wide shot of Catherine standing regally before the roaring stone hearth, dressed in an ornate burgundy and gold brocade gown, slowly unfurling a red lace fan.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You have a solution?
Side profile close-up of the Elder Nobleman speaking with icy confidence.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: We use the law to destroy her.
Close-up of Rupert looking bewildered.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: The law?
Tracking medium shot as the Elder Nobleman paces slowly behind the massive mahogany desk lined with books and a glass of whiskey.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: A maid with herbs in her possession, a secret medicine, an unauthorized visit to the Duchess's chamber.
The Elder Nobleman leans both hands against the desk, leaning forward intently.
Medium close-up of Catherine fluttering her fan beneath her chin, smirking approvingly.
Medium shot framing the Elder Nobleman seated at the desk beside Catherine standing in the firelight.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And if she claims she is a healer?

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: What were their illnesses?

units.text: Yes.

units.text: I am tired. That is all.
Alexander steps forward and reaches out, his gloved hand firmly grasping her left shoulder. Juliana winces sharply and gasps in sudden pain.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You're hurt.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: The wedding?
Close-up on Rupert, his sharp aristocratic features set in cold conviction.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: The transfer of Ashbridge.
Medium close-up of Catherine picking up one of the invitations, turning it over in her gloved hands with predatory delight.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: After the ceremony, no one will question who owns this house.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Juliana's execution comes after the wedding.

units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Especially to the Ashcrofts.

Medium shot inside an opulent drawing room with a roaring fireplace. Lady Clarissa sits gracefully in an emerald satin gown as the butler presents the tray.

units.speaker: BUTLER
units.text: Lady Clarissa, an invitation from Ashbridge Manor.
Clarissa takes the cream envelope, breaks the red wax seal with her gloved thumbs, and slides out the heavy card.
Close-up of Clarissa's face lighting up with malicious excitement, the warm hearth flickering in the background.

units.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
units.text: Catherine's wedding.
Medium two-shot as her dark-haired husband steps up behind her chair, crossing his arms.

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN
units.text: So it is finally official.

units.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
units.text: Lady Catherine Ashbridge.
Medium shot as Clarissa unfolds the second page attached to the invitation, her expression shifting to intrigue.

units.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
units.text: And after the ceremony...

units.speaker: MATRIARCH

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Why?

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Gerald is waiting for me.
Close-up on the Matriarch wearing an ornate tiara and sapphire jewelry, gazing down with merciless disdain.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: Not anymore.
Close-up on Juliana's stricken face as the weight of the words sinks in.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: What do you mean?
Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing dismissively toward the altar.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: Look for yourself.
Juliana walks forward past the Matriarch, her breath hitching as she approaches the altar steps, looking up in shock.
Medium front tracking shot moving backward ahead of Juliana as she advances down the center aisle.
Panning shot across the seated wedding guests whispering and casting judging glances from the wooden pews.
Low-angle shot from behind Juliana looking up at Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing proudly before the altar.
Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips and shocked, tearful blue eyes.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Gerald?

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Why are you holding her hand?
Close-up insert of Gerald's fingers firmly interlocked with the white-gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown.
Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown beaming with cruel triumph.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: Because he is marrying me.
Close-up on Juliana as tears spill over her eyelashes.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: No...
Wide profile shot showing Juliana standing below the altar platform, looking up at Gerald and her sister.
Close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her sorrow turning into burning outrage.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You knew this before I walked through those doors!
Medium shot of Gerald standing stoic and impassive next to the smug Lady in Gold Gown.
Close-up on Juliana's hands desperately clenching fistfuls of her white dress fabric.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You let me come here...
Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes with grief.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You let me dress in my mother's gown...

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You let me believe I was walking toward my husband!
Medium shot on Gerald stepping forward, cold and indifferent, with the Lady in Gold Gown lingering in soft focus behind him.
Tight close-up on Gerald's hardened profile as he glances down.

units.text: Close-up of Alexander, pressing her without hesitation.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: What were you doing there?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana... why were you inside Ashburg Manor?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I went there to help someone.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Who?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: The Dowager Duchess.
Tight close-up of Alexander's face freezing in shock, his eyes widening as the revelation hits him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: The Dowager?
Medium profile tracking shot as Juliana begins walking slowly along the trail, Alexander following closely by her side.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Prudence told me she was dying.
Medium close-up of Juliana turning toward him, recounting the scene in the bedchamber.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: She was barely breathing when I found her. The doctor said she was simply growing old.
Two-shot as Juliana stops and looks up into Alexander's grim expression.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: But it wasn't age.
Medium shot of Alexander staring down at her, waiting for the dark truth.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: What did you find?
Tight close-up on Juliana's trembling lips.

units.text: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman pacing forward with calculating malice.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?
Close-up of Juliana retorting without hesitation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: The physicians were not saving her!
Over-the-shoulder shot past the Blond Nobleman looking toward the frail Duchess watching helplessly from the bed.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: My aunt has been wasting away for months.
Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman turning slowly back toward Juliana, building his trap.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed...

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: ...holding a substance no one authorized her to give.

units.text: It is an antidote.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it.
Close-up of Rupert defensive and agitated.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there.
Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman fixing Rupert with a piercing, contemptuous glare.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates.
Medium shot of Rupert looking down, nervously pulling at his black leather gloves as dread creeps over his face.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: She knows the Duchess was poisoned.
Tight close-up on the Elder Nobleman's unyielding eyes narrowing in cold calculation.
Tight close-up of Rupert swallows hard, breathless with dread.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: If she speaks...
Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.
The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!
Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: What are you suggesting?
Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: We stop hiding the prisoner.
Tracking shot from behind the Elder Nobleman as he pushes open the heavy double doors into the dark wood-paneled library.
The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.
Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: We give them a reason to condemn her.
Wide shot of Catherine standing regally before the roaring stone hearth, dressed in an ornate burgundy and gold brocade gown, slowly unfurling a red lace fan.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You have a solution?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They stole my home!

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Two days.
Medium shot from inside the cabin, showing his mother clutching her chest, looking after Alexander's imposing silhouette standing at the threshold of the blizzard.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then they have two days to celebrate.
Side profile close-up on Alexander as his breath fogs into the icy winter night air, his jaw clenched tight.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Because before that wedding begins...

units.text: And my father said nothing.

Low-angle close-up focusing on Juliana's neck as her fingers desperately clutch the oval locket.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: This is my mother's church.
Close-up on Juliana's face, teeth clenched in desperate defiance.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I have every right to stand here.

units.text: Not anymore.

units.text: Your father has chosen his family...

units.text: Close-up of the Constable gesturing with his truncheon toward the cottage door.

units.speaker: CONSTABLE
units.text: Then a search will settle the matter.
Medium shot of Juliana backing up to the doorway, spreading her arms wide to block the entrance.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You cannot simply invade our home because this man makes an accusation!
Medium close-up of Gerald crossing his arms smugly.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: If he has nothing to hide...

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: ...let the constable search.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Search it.
Medium two-shot of Juliana looking up at Alexander in panicked confusion.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Let them.
Medium shot looking out the doorway as Juliana steps aside and the Constable barges past into the dimly lit cottage.
Heavy thud of boots entering wooden floorboards, followed by forceful banging of furniture.
The Constable begins violently overturning crates and dumping contents across the floor.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!

units.text: Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.
Medium shot of Juliana hunched over in pain, clutching her abdomen.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: You are a maid.
Low-angle shot looking past the bedpost toward the Duchess, whose trembling hand reaches out limply.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Not a physician. Not a lady.
Dramatic low-angle wide shot of the noblewoman standing imperiously over the doubled-over Juliana.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters.
Close-up of Juliana looking down, enduring the humiliation while stifling her breath.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Yes, my lady.
Medium shot of the noblewoman turning the crop in her white-gloved hands with smug satisfaction.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place.
The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.
Low tracking shot down the corridor as the hem of the lilac dress sweeps past, followed by Juliana's swift steps.
Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.
Wide shot of the vast soot-stained stone fireplace. The noblewoman turns back toward Juliana, crop held at her side.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Clean it.
Medium shot of the noblewoman extending her gloved hand toward the cavernous, filth-laden hearth.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at the towering, soot-blackened chimney.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: All of it, my lady?
Extreme close-up two-shot as the noblewoman steps unnervingly close to Juliana's face, whispering with sadistic relish.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are.
Juliana slowly drops to her knees on the cold flagstones before the soot-filled fireplace.
Medium shot of Juliana sinking to her knees, her face grim and composed.
Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.
Close-up of Prudence's anxious, trembling face.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: My lady—
The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.
Medium close-up of the noblewoman baring her teeth in rage, aiming the crop threateningly.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Do you want the same punishment?
Close-up of Prudence flinching in terror, lowering her eyes immediately.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: No, my lady.
Juliana grips a coarse scrubbing brush with both hands and begins vigorously scraping the thick black ash across the hearthstones.
Close-up shot of Juliana's soot-covered hands fiercely scrubbing the black ash along the stone floor.
Rhythmic, harsh rasping sound of bristles scraping against stone.
Medium shot of the noblewoman leaning casually against the wooden doorframe, watching Juliana toil with smug condescension.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: That is where clever little servants belong.
Medium profile shot of Juliana kneeling by the hearth in the dim window light, scrubbing steadily.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Let her think I am only a maid.

Juliana pauses scrubbing. Her soot-caked fingers reach into the deep pocket of her apron, carefully feeling the worn leather cover of her mother's remedy journal and the glass dropper bottle securely concealed within.
Close-up of Juliana's soot-stained hand touching the hidden remedy book and the antidote vial inside her apron pocket.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Let her believe I am ignorant.
Juliana raises her head. Smudges of dark soot stain her fair cheek, but her piercing blue eyes burn with unwavering defiance and unyielding resolve as she stares toward the hallway.
Tight close-up of Juliana's soot-streaked face turning slowly toward the chamber exit, her jaw set firm as dramatic music builds to a powerful crescendo.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander... why are you so angry?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Because you were standing inside a house where someone is poisoning a woman... and you never told me.

units.speaker: JULIANA

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Worry? They struck you. They could have killed you.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: But they didn't.
Close-up of their clasped hands, panning up to Alexander's tormented gaze.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: This time.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I am being careful.
Two-shot as Juliana looks at him earnestly.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I cannot abandon her.
Alexander closes his eyes for a brief, agonizing second, exhaling deeply as he yields to her unshakeable conviction.
Close-up of Alexander opening his piercing eyes, resignation and steadfast devotion washing over his features.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then tell me everything.

units.text: How did you escape?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Then why did they never tell us?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Who?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Who?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Sterling... and Rupert.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Rupert?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They knew where I was.
Close-up on Alexander leaning over the table, his eyes locked onto his mother as suppressed rage surfaces.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: My position was leaked to the French... before I could expose what I had discovered.
Close-up of Alexander's mother clutching the collar of her dark cloak, her chest heaving with agony.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They gave you to the enemy?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They gave them my location.
Extreme close-up on Alexander's eyes and scarred cheek, teeth bared in contempt.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They wanted the investigation buried.
Medium close-up of Alexander's mother leaning over the map, her voice cracking.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: And when you disappeared...?

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: No...
Medium shot on Alexander stepping forward, thrusting the secondary dossier forward.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Read the names.
Medium close-up on the Crown Official reading the concluding section.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Lord Henry Sterling.
Quick pan to Lord Sterling stiffening in his pew, then the Crown Official.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Rupert Ashburn.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: I didn't!

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And when you believed I was dead...
Quick reaction shot on Rupert gasping on the steps.
Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, furious face.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You took my title.
Extreme close-up on the Crown Official's gloved thumb cracking the red wax seal open.
Brittle snap of breaking sealing wax.
Full shot of the Crown Official standing amidst church debris reading the death register.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Official death confirmation was filed three months after the ambush.
Two-shot of the Crown Official in the background and Alexander's dark silhouette in the foreground.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Duke Alexander Ashburn was declared dead.
Wide majestic shot capturing the entire nave, the rows of horrified guests, and the ruined cathedral windows.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: His estate and title were subsequently transferred under false authority.
Medium close-up on Rupert clutching his chest as if choking on his own lies.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: I was told he was dead!
Low shot following Alexander's heavy boots stepping steadily up the stone steps toward the altar.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You were told exactly what you needed to hear.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I work with my hands. There is no shame in that.

units.speaker: GERALD

units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling on the floor, looking up with tears streaming down her cheeks.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Please! There is nothing here!
Close-up of the Constable's hands flipping open a small wooden keepsake box on a work table.

units.speaker: CONSTABLE
units.text: Then you have nothing to fear.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana clutching the fallen linens to her chest, her voice breaking.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Those are all I have left!
Medium shot of Gerald leaning casually against the cottage doorframe, looking around with contemptuous disgust.

units.speaker: GERALD

units.speaker: GERALD

units.speaker: JULIANA

Close-up of Juliana clutching her dress collar in acute panic.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: One blow would end this.

Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes blazing with indignation and wounded pride.

units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Close-up of the High Priest glaring intently.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: ...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer.
Medium shot pushing into a close-up as the High Priest thrusts the royal War Office proclamation directly into the camera.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead.
Close-up of Juliana lifting her chin, tearful yet burning with righteous fury.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father.
Medium two-shot of Juliana standing proudly beside Alexander.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I won't ask it for permission to love.
Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.
Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Then look at this floor honestly, for once.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A church called me unworthy.
Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A church chained me.
Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Now a church calls my marriage a lie!

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!
Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you.
Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.
Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!

units.text: The trembling mother gently lays the feverish boy down atop the wooden table as Juliana leans in close.
Close-up of Juliana gently placing her fingers against the boy's burning forehead.
Medium close-up of Juliana examining the boy's breathing, looking up toward the frantic mother.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He seems very unwell, but he is resting steadily. How long has he been like this?
Medium two-shot of Alexander watching anxiously over the child's shoulder as Juliana tends to him.
Medium close-up of the peasant mother clutching her shawl, tears running down her cheeks.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: Since yesterday morning. He has barely eaten since sunset.
Close-up of Juliana resting two fingers against the boy's wrist, measuring his shallow pulse.
Juliana lifts the weathered herbal book and rapidly browses the handwritten pages.
Insert close-up of the open page illustrated with botanical drawings labeled 'Feverfew'.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Feverfew... Not alone.
Profile close-up of Juliana studying the grimoire's remedies intently while the mother weeps in the soft background.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Chamomile... and willow bark.
Close-up of Alexander leaning over the table, gazing at her with intense concern.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You're certain?
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes with resolute conviction.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I have to be.
Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander, I need hot water.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I'm on it.
Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: Please save him.
Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.
Medium close-up of Juliana clasping the mother's trembling hand across the wooden table.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He is not beyond saving.
Close-up of Juliana carefully administering the herbal brew with a small wooden spoon into the sick boy's mouth.
The child swallows weakly and lets out a soft cough.
Close-up of the mother clutching her chest in anxious suspense.
Medium close-up of Juliana sitting quietly beside the boy, holding two fingers over his wrist to monitor his pulse.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the mother leaning across the table in panic.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: Why isn't it working?

units.text: Tight close-up of Catherine as a cruel sneer twists her lips.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Juliana's execution comes after the wedding.
Wide shot framing the two conspirators beneath the towering archways of the estate.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Perfect timing. It will be a feast for our guests.
Medium close-up of Rupert turning his gaze toward the grand entrance.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Send the invitations.
Close-up of Catherine looking sideways with narrowed eyes.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Especially to the Ashcrofts.

Medium shot inside an opulent drawing room with a roaring fireplace. Lady Clarissa sits gracefully in an emerald satin gown as the butler presents the tray.

units.speaker: BUTLER

Clarissa takes the cream envelope, breaks the red wax seal with her gloved thumbs, and slides out the heavy card.
Close-up of Clarissa's face lighting up with malicious excitement, the warm hearth flickering in the background.

units.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
units.text: Catherine's wedding.
Medium two-shot as her dark-haired husband steps up behind her chair, crossing his arms.

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN
units.text: So it is finally official.
Close-up of Clarissa smiling down at the calligraphy.

units.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
units.text: Lady Catherine Ashbridge.
Medium shot as Clarissa unfolds the second page attached to the invitation, her expression shifting to intrigue.

units.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
units.text: And after the ceremony...

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN
units.text: What?
Clarissa hands the letter upward to him. He takes it and looks down at the bold heading.
Close-up of the nobleman reading, his eyes widening in shock before breaking into a grin.

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN
units.text: The sentencing of the condemned.
Close-up of Clarissa turning back to the fire, laughing softly with dark delight.

units.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
units.text: They want the families to witness it.
Medium shot of the nobleman holding the invitation, chuckling at the audacity.

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN
units.text: A public execution after a wedding.
Medium profile shot of Clarissa gazing back at him over her shoulder.

units.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
units.text: Not just an execution. A warning.
Close-up of the nobleman's stern face, leaning down.

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN
units.text: To whom?
