units.text: Look at her.

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN
units.text: She actually came back to the chapel.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Not as a bride this time.

Close profile of Juliana as she halts in the center aisle, lifting her chin proudly to face the sneering onlookers.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: This is the world you thought you belonged to.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And now they can all see what you truly are.

units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: You know that is a lie!

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Beauty. Money.
Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.
Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Family. A perfect name.
Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow...

Medium close-up of Juliana looking up with quiet pity.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Before the magistrate.
Close-up of the maid grabbing both sides of her head, screaming out in utter grief and guilt.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: I never said she was a witch!
Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning his back and walking back behind his desk.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: You do not need to.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: I have already written the story for you.
Close-up of the maid clutching her cheeks, crying in heartbreak.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: She saved my brother...
Close-up of the Lord turning back, resting one hand upon the desk with cold finality.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: And now... you will save your brother.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: I am sorry, Lady Juliana...

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Yes.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Your Honor... the witness has confirmed the ritual.
Lady Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the wooden railing of the dock, her voice ringing out in indignant fury.
Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana gripping the railing, leaning forward.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: It was not a ritual!
The Judge repeatedly hammers his gavel down onto the desk, roaring over her.
Medium shot of the Judge striking the wooden block twice in rapid succession.

units.speaker: LORD

units.speaker: TOWNSMAN
units.text: My wife took one of Lady Juliana's mixtures...

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: And?

units.speaker: TOWNSMAN
units.text: She became violently ill.
Medium shot among the spectators as an elderly peasant woman stands up from the wooden bench, pointing an accusatory finger across the courtroom.

units.speaker: OLD WOMAN
units.text: My daughter drank one of her herbal preparations! She was sick for three days!
Side two-shot of the Lord stepping up to the dock, looming beside Lady Juliana as she looks him in the eye.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: She calls it healing.
The Lord turns dramatically to face the entire assembly, gesturing toward the spectators.
Medium shot of the Lord addressing the courtroom.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: The people call it poisoning!
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking past him directly toward the gallery with sharp clarity.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: What were their illnesses?
Low-angle close-up of the Lord looking down arrogantly over his shoulder.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Irrelevant.
Close-up of Lady Juliana gritting her teeth in fierce defiance.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: It is not irrelevant!
Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana standing tall against the courtroom window light, her chained hands resting on the balustrade as she addresses the entire hall.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Herbs are not magic! They are medicine!

Medium close-up of Lady Juliana looking into Prudence's tearful face with compassionate urgency.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened.
Close-up of Prudence weeping, clutching her hands to her chest in agony.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!
Close-up of Lady Juliana, her brow furrowing with concern.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?
Close-up of Prudence, her face twisted in bitter anguish as she gestures back toward the rain-soaked outdoors.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!
Wide shot of Lady Juliana and Prudence facing each other inside the wooden barn, dust motes drifting in the pale light.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!
Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: We have no clinic now.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot.

High-angle looking down at Prudence kneeling before Lady Juliana, pleading upward.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!

Lady Juliana clutches the thick book to her chest as she and Prudence sprint swiftly through the village.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA

Tracking shot swinging around Rupert as he turns toward the royal guards stationed along the aisle, pointing furiously down the center of the hall.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: This man is an imposter! Arrest him!
Wide symmetrical shot framing Alexander Ashburn standing immovable in the center of the cathedral, flanking lines of red-coated guards on both sides.
Alexander stands completely composed in his dark embroidered aristocratic coat, staring Rupert down with unyielding authority.
Extreme close-up on Rupert's furious face, veins bulging at his temples.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: I said arrest him!
Medium shot on the Royal Guard Captain in ceremonial bearskin uniform standing steadfast.
The Guard Captain brings his ceremonial sword upright to attention, his expression stern and resolute.

units.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
units.text: We will not.
Low-angle shot looking down along the polished stone floor as the guard's sword tip grounds firmly between Rupert and the guards.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: I am Lord Rupert Ashburn!
Medium close-up on Rupert thumping his chest in indignant disbelief.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Your Duke!
Medium shot framing the Guard Captain and Alexander in profile.
The Guard Captain snaps a crisp salute toward Alexander.

units.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
units.text: No. He is your Duke.
Medium shot on Catherine in her bridal gown and Lord Henry Sterling seated in the front pew, both frozen in stunned shock.
Lord Sterling clutches his gold-headed walking cane tightly, his jaw clenching as tension spreads through the church.
Medium shot on Rupert spinning toward the gathered congregation, his hands flailing.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: You have all been deceived!
Medium close-up on Alexander, commanding and icy.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then let the Crown decide.
Close-up on Alexander's hands holding an official War Office document bundle sealed with red wax and ribbon.
Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.
Medium shot of Alexander holding up the sealed parcel before the room.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Read the first.
Close-up on Lord Sterling looking sideways, his face pale with rising dread.

units.text: Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Now a church calls my marriage a lie!

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!
Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you.
Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.
Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!
Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.
Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!
Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.

units.text: Close-up pushing in on Catherine as she leans lower over his face, her gaze sharpening with dangerous intimacy.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite.
Medium two-shot from the side as both sit up in bed, sheets pulled up around their waists.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Name your price.
Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office.
Slight pull back as Catherine pulls her hand back slightly, staring at him in disbelief.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune.
Two-shot centering on Father Thomas leaning toward her, his expression resolute and uncompromising.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: Absolution is free. Discretion has a price.
Tight profile close-up between their faces, golden candlelight illuminating Catherine's jaw as she raises her hand to touch his cheek.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Unsupervised. In your hands alone.
Tight close-up as Father Thomas reaches up and firmly clasps Catherine's hand at his neck.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: For as long as it holds.
Medium close-up as Catherine breaks into a knowing, seductive smile and taps his chest with her index finger.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Done. You told yourself this ends when the hearing does.
Close-up on Father Thomas letting out a soft, self-deprecating chuckle before meeting her eyes with smoldering hunger.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: I've told myself that since the dawn in your bedchamber, and here we are again.
Extreme close-up of their lips almost grazing, warm candlelight catching the edges of their profiles.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: In another room no one uses?

units.text: Close-up on Prudence, her eyes wide with dread.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: And if they discover who you are?
Close-up on Lady Juliana holding her gaze steadily.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Then I will face that when she is breathing again.
Medium two-shot outside the heavy wooden servant entrance door.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Then forget you were ever a lady.
Close-up of Lady Juliana swallowing her pride and accepting her perilous disguise.

Heavy wooden latch clicks shut with a thud.

units.text: Prudence.
Medium shot of the formidable Housekeeper standing in the dim stone hallway with arms folded, ring of keys dangling from her waist.

units.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
units.text: Who is this?
Medium shot of Prudence curtsying low with downcast eyes while Lady Juliana stands behind her carrying a heavy wooden water bucket.

Close-up on Lady Juliana keeping her eyes dutifully lowered.

units.text: I can work, ma'am.

units.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
units.text: Can you scrub stone?

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA

units.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER

units.text: Medium tracking shot of Juliana marching between the stern constables down the central aisle toward the altar.
Medium shot of a seated aristocratic couple in the pews, whispering and sneering behind an ivory lace fan.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Look at her.

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN
units.text: She actually came back to the chapel.
Close-up of the noblewoman giggling with hand over mouth, glancing spitefully at the disgraced bride.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Not as a bride this time.
Medium shot of two senior aristocrats in the carved choir stalls, resting on their canes and nodding in smug agreement.
Close profile of Juliana as she halts in the center aisle, lifting her chin proudly to face the sneering onlookers.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around.
High-angle wide shot showing Juliana flanked by guards in the center of the lavishly decorated nave, dwarfed by the grand cathedral.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: This is the world you thought you belonged to.
Low-angle medium shot of Catherine gesturing broadly from the altar steps, looking down upon Juliana like an empress.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And now they can all see what you truly are.
Medium shot of Juliana standing firmly between the guards, calmly meeting Catherine's venomous gaze.
Juliana looks around the cathedral at the sea of pompous faces, then raises her eyes straight back to Catherine with utter disdain.
Tight close-up on Juliana's bruised, unshaken face.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?
Dramatic low-angle full shot looking up at Juliana, her posture straight, imposing, and regal despite the heavy chains.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Still arrogant. Still standing.
Full shot of Catherine turning back to Rupert at the altar, dismissing Juliana's defiance as beneath her.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Come.
Close-up of Catherine's and Rupert's gloved hands clasping together over the velvet altar cushion.
Medium two-shot of Catherine gazing up adoringly into Rupert's eyes, her tone intoxicatingly intimate.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Soon, there will be nothing left between us and the Ashburgh title.
Close-up of Rupert's face breaking into a calculating, ambitious grin.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Nothing.
Medium shot of the elderly Priest opening the leather-bound liturgical book between Rupert and Catherine.

units.speaker: PRIEST
units.text: Shall we?

units.text: You should turn around, Juliana.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Why?

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Gerald is waiting for me.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH
units.text: Not anymore.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: What do you mean?

Close-up on Juliana, demanding answers in spite of her humiliation.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: And I am what?
Medium tracking shot showing the Lady in Gold Gown stepping past Juliana toward the center.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to.
Close-up on Juliana absorbing the venomous words, her breathing shallow.

units.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
units.text: I am the daughter they choose.
Medium shot of the Lady in Gold Gown smiling warmly at Gerald beside the altar candles.

units.speaker: MATRIARCH

Close two-shot of the Matriarch and Juliana standing side by side in profile.
Medium shot framing Juliana looking directly at Gerald, who towers over her coldly.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: So that is what I was worth to you?

units.text: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: What rumor?
Close-up of The Former Groom speaking cautiously.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke.
Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman scoffing dismissively as he closes the book.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: People see ghosts whenever they want a story.
Extreme close-up of The Former Groom's eyes widening with urgent dread.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war.
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman snapping his head around, his smug expression freezing into sudden alarm.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Where?
Medium close-up of The Former Groom shifting uncomfortably.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: No one seems certain.
Close-up of the Blond Nobleman composing his features into cold disdain, though tension trembles beneath his tone.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Then let it remain a rumor.
Medium shot as The Former Groom turns and retreats silently out of the study, leaving the doors closed.
Side profile shot of the Blond Nobleman seated alone before the roaring fire, staring blankly into the flames in creeping paranoia.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Impossible.

units.text: Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing regally under an arched stone doorway, clutching the leather-bound herbarium.
Tight close-up of Juliana's tearful face as she reaches an arm out toward Catherine in anguish.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Catherine! Please! That book is my mother's only legacy!
Medium shot from behind Catherine as she stands motionless, watching Juliana being dragged away.
Close-up of Juliana turning her head back toward Catherine, screaming through tears.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It contains years of her work! Her knowledge! Everything she left me!
Full shot of Catherine turning gracefully on the dungeon steps, holding the book loosely at her side.
Medium close-up pushing in on Catherine as she presents the worn botanical book with both gloved hands.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Your mother's little book of weeds?

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You still call this a legacy?
Close-up of Juliana held firmly between the guards, glaring back with fierce defiance.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It is medicine!
Medium close-up of Catherine smiling condescendingly.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Of course.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Roots. Leaves. Powders. Strange mixtures written in a dead woman's hand.
Medium shot of Catherine tucking the book under her arm, her eyes glinting with malicious intent.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: The magistrate will call it witchcraft.
Close-up of Juliana lunging against the guard's grip, her teeth bared in indignation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You know that is a lie!
Medium shot of Catherine lifting her chin arrogantly against the stone backdrop.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I know exactly what I need him to believe.
Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the two guards.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You cannot just destroy it!
Tight close-up of Catherine's eyes narrowing into an icy, venomous gaze.

units.text: No...

units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Lord Henry Sterling.

units.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
units.text: Rupert Ashburn.

Close-up on the Dowager Duchess covering her mouth in agonizing disbelief.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: My God...
Low-angle shot on Alexander towering over the fallen Rupert.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You sold my men to the enemy.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: I didn't!
Low-angle tracking push-in on Alexander raising the red-ribboned war document toward the cathedral arches.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And when you believed I was dead...

units.speaker: AGNES
units.text: You sent for me, my lady?

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Lock it.
Close-up on Agnes's hands turning the ornate iron key in the wooden door's brass lock.
Heavy metallic click of an iron key latching into a deadbolt.
Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.
Two-shot profile of Catherine towering over Agnes in the candlelight.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Good. Let them remember it.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now.

units.speaker: AGNES
units.text: My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Father Thomas did his part beautifully today.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes.
Medium close-up of Agnes glancing nervously over her shoulder.

units.speaker: AGNES
units.text: If someone sees him come to you...

Close-up of Toby's face relaxing, his chest falling still and calm.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA

units.speaker: PRUDENCE

units.speaker: PRUDENCE

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence.
Low-angle shot past sleeping Toby toward Prudence standing in the room, her expression darkening with anger.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: But their gold cannot buy them health.
Lady Juliana turns sharply, her eyes widening with sudden recognition.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking directly into Prudence's eyes with startled concern.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?

Medium shot as the Scarred Bearded Man stoops down, scoops up the heavy bundle of firewood in one arm, and walks calmly past Juliana toward their door.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I did not poison her! Look at her eyes, the fever has broken!
Medium full shot of Rupert standing beside the four-poster bed, calmly pulling on his black leather gloves.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: A clever story, girl.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: But the guards know how to extract the truth.
Medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess stirring against her pillows, lifting her trembling head with visible effort.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Rupert...
Medium shot of Rupert pausing mid-stride as he hears his mother's voice, slowly turning his head toward the bed.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Stop this!
Wide shot of the bedchamber framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess props herself up on one elbow and points an accusing finger.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: She is innocent.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: She saved me!
Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Your Grace...
Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: I know what happened to me!
Medium low-angle shot past the Duchess pointing directly at Rupert, who stands rigid and expressionless.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: I was poisoned!

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: And you... you knew!
Medium shot of the Duchess lunging forward from the pillows, gasping for breath as she points toward Catherine.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Catherine knew!

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: They have been—
The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.

units.text: Close-up on Catherine's devastated, terrified face as the word shatters her entire worldview.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Wife?!
Grand wide shot of the ruined cathedral nave as Alexander takes Juliana's hand and walks her proudly down the center aisle.
Alexander and Juliana advance side-by-side between the rows of shocked aristocratic guests.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Before the Crown and before God...
Medium shot as Alexander stops in the center of the nave and raises Juliana's hand high above their heads.
Alexander hoists Juliana's hand triumphantly into the air, presenting her to the nobility.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft is my lawful wife... and the Duchess of Ashburton!
Close-up on Rupert and Mary standing in the pews, their eyes wide with horrified disbelief.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: Juliana?!
Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing proudly together, exchanging a loving gaze amid the awestruck crowd.
Wide tracking shot down the cathedral aisle as the massive wooden entrance doors slam open, framed by blinding daylight and mist.
Loud, echoing thud of cathedral doors swinging open violently.
A Catholic Bishop in dark vestments steps through the cathedral doors accompanied by an armed Crown officer.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: No one will bow yet!
Low-angle shot on Alexander and Juliana turning in alarm toward the rear of the cathedral.
Medium shot of the High Priest striding down the aisle, holding up an official royal parchment bearing red wax seals.
The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union.
Close-up on the High Priest unfolding the document, reading aloud to the congregation.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register.

units.text: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana shaking her head slightly, truth ringing in her voice.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: There was no physician willing to help them.
Close-up of Lady Juliana's steady gaze.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: So I helped them.
Medium close-up of the Lord smiling cynically as he turns back toward the magistrate.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Even now, she refuses to repent.
Low-angle medium shot of the Judge holding his hand over the open law book.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Lady Juliana, if you wish to save yourself, renounce these practices.
Close-up of the burned grimoire resting on the green leather surface of the court table.
Close-up of Lady Juliana lifting her chin without an ounce of hesitation.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: No.
Medium shot of the Judge lowering his brow with dark finality.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: Think carefully.
Low-angle close-up of Lady Juliana looking skyward through the arched court windows.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I have.
Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched finger across the bench, his tone hardening into lethal severity.

units.speaker: JUDGE
units.text: You understand that refusal may be treated as proof that you knowingly practiced witchcraft?
Close-up of Lady Juliana unflinchingly accepting her fate.

units.text: Medium shot of the Third Thug backing away nervously, raising a blunt rod with trembling arms before lunging.

units.speaker: THIRD THUG
units.text: Stay back!
Alexander deflects the strike with his forearm, drives a swift counter-blow into the thug's torso, and spins him violently to the ground.
Solid bone-and-fist impact followed by a groaning thud.
Wide cinematic shot under the full moon. Alexander towers over the three writhing thugs groaning in the mud as Juliana looks up from her knees.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up at Alexander, tears glistening on her mud-splattered cheeks in profound relief.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander...
Medium shot over Juliana's shoulder as Alexander turns his gaze toward her, his stern demeanor softening with concern.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Are you hurt?
Close-up of Juliana's trembling, soil-stained hands wrapped in blood-soaked bandages.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Only my hands.
Medium shot as Alexander suddenly wheels around, strides to the groaning Thug with Cap, and yanks him straight off the ground by his coat collar with one arm.
Alexander lifts the thug onto his tiptoes against the cottage wall, glaring with lethal intensity.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Who sent you?
Close-up of the Thug with Cap gagging under Alexander's iron fist.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: No one!
Close-up of Alexander, his eyes darkening with lethal fury.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Wrong answer.
Alexander tightens his grip on the thug's throat, lifting him higher against the stone wall.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Who?!
Extreme close-up of the terrified thug gasping for air, his eyes bulging.

units.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
units.text: Harrington! Gerald Harrington paid us!
Close-up of Juliana on the ground, reeling in devastated disbelief as the betrayal hits her.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Gerald...

units.text: Medium close-up of Catherine raising the porcelain teacup to her lips, her expression turning sharp and dismissive.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: 'Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I marry the Lord of Ashbury.
Medium shot of Rupert striding toward the tea table, leaning forward with predatory conviction.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: And so you shall.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown...

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: ...the title is mine.
Close-up of Catherine lowering her teacup, her icy blue eyes narrowing in calculated concern.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Her shadow still hangs over this house.
Tight close-up of Rupert's face as a sinister grin spreads across his features.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: They call it a wasting of the lungs.
Close-up side profile of Catherine bringing the teacup to her lips, savoring his words with chilling detachment.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: How tragic. The slow, quiet decline.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: How much longer can the frail thing survive?
Medium profile of Rupert looking out the window, hands clasped behind him.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort.
Close-up of Catherine turning her head toward the window, her lips curled in venomous disgust.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Good. The village is already whispering about her.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: They disgust me.
Medium two-shot. Rupert stands over Catherine seated at the polished table, placing a gloved hand possessively near her shoulder.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown.

Medium close-up tilting down on JULIANA kneeling in the straw beside a rustic wooden crate, sorting sprigs of dried lavender and sage into a woven basket. Her hands are bound in linen bandages from the recent fire.
The barn door opens, revealing daylight outside. SEAMUS, an older weathered villager in a waistcoat, carries a wooden bucket inside, his expression etched with deep sorrow and concern.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Let me take that basket, Lady Juliana.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft.
Seamus reaches down to take the handle of the basket from her.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at Seamus, her smudged face fierce with unyielding determination as she holds firmly onto the basket.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins.

units.text: Close-up on Lady Juliana clutching the wash bucket, her eyes scanning ahead urgently.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Where is the West Wing?
Medium shot of Prudence pointing toward the archway leading toward the grand staircase.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Beyond the grand staircase. Few servants go there.
Tracking shot from behind Lady Juliana as she walks out into the vast, opulent marble hall of Ashbury Manor carrying her bucket.
Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.
Low-angle push-in on Lady Juliana looking up at the enormous portrait of the late Duke and Duchess hanging above the gallery.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: This house...
Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.
Medium close-up of Prudence whispering frantically into Juliana's ear.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Do not stare. Keep walking.
Wide tracking shot behind Lady Juliana as she hastens down the long marble gallery toward the secluded West Wing wing.
Medium shot of Lady Juliana standing outside a massive carved mahogany door, glancing around the empty hallway to ensure she is unobserved.
Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.
Close-up of Lady Juliana's hand twisting the latch handle.
Faint, muffled click of the heavy door lock turning.
Slow tracking shot into the cavernous, shadowy bedchamber. In the center stands an ornate four-poster canopy bed draped in pale silk where a frail, silver-haired figure lies motionless.
Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.
Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Your Grace?
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped on pillows, her face gaunt, ashen, and drenched in cold sweat, her eyes half-fluttering.
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana taking the Duchess's fragile, cold hands into her own.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Do not speak.
Close-up of Lady Juliana checking the Duchess's pulse and gently pressing her fingertips against the Duchess's chest and neck, her herbalist instincts taking over.
Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: This isn't ordinary fever.
The Dowager Duchess suddenly gasps violently for breath, convulsing weakly as her eyes snap open in agony.
Close-up of the Duchess gasping in sudden spasms.
Intense two-shot as Lady Juliana leans in close, gripping the Duchess's shoulder with urgent desperation.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Who has been treating you?

Extreme close-up on the Dowager Duchess's terrified, wide eyes staring up as she chokes for air, the haunting realization of poison lingering as dramatic music hits an abrupt, suspenseful cliffhanger.

units.text: Close-up on Juliana, her lips parting in quiet astonishment.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Why are you doing this?
Close-up on The Bearded Stranger, completely unfazed.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: Because I want to.
Close-up on Juliana's father wringing his gold ring, eyes heavy with regret.
Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger slipping his hand into his coat pocket.
Close-up of Juliana watching him with rapt, trembling anticipation.
Extreme close-up of The Bearded Stranger's rugged fingers holding up a simple, polished silver band.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: You came here to become a wife.
Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger extending the ring toward Juliana.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: They took that from you.
Over-the-shoulder medium shot past The Bearded Stranger onto Gerald standing petrified and humiliated in the aisle.
Medium close-up on The Bearded Stranger presenting the ring directly to Juliana.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: I am offering it back.
Close-up on Juliana glancing down at the ring, breathless and overwhelmed.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You don't even know me.
Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's warm, piercing gaze.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: I know enough.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No! That watch was not in his coat!
Close-up of the Constable narrowing his eyes coldly at Juliana.

units.speaker: CONSTABLE
units.text: I found it there myself.
Close-up of Juliana glaring back with unwavering conviction.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Then someone put it there!
Medium full shot of Gerald framed in the open cottage doorway holding his riding crop, stepping inside with a patronizing, gloating grin.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: The proof is in his coat, Juliana. A valuable pocket watch doesn't just walk into a beggar's pocket.
Close-up of Alexander, his scarred brow furrowed in dark, quiet defiance.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I have never touched your property.
Medium shot of Gerald pointing his riding crop toward them, with Clarissa hovering behind him in her violet silk gown.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Then perhaps your wife should explain why it was found in your coat.

units.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine narrowing her eyes with venomous suspicion.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: What are you hiding?
Close-up of Juliana, her chin raised.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Nothing.
Medium close-up of Lady Catherine pointing a white-gloved finger directly at Juliana.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: Show me your hand.
Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman stepping forward beside Lady Catherine, clad in a dark tailored coat with black leather gloves.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Girl. Show me what you are holding.
Two-shot of Juliana facing the Blond Nobleman as she slowly extends her palm, revealing the small amber glass dropper bottle.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: What is this?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Medicine.
Close-up of Lady Catherine tapping her gloved finger to her lip, letting out a mocking scoff.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: Medicine? You are a new maid.
Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman staring down at the vial, as Catherine sneers from his side.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?

units.text: Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing regally under an arched stone doorway, clutching the leather-bound herbarium.
Tight close-up of Juliana's tearful face as she reaches an arm out toward Catherine in anguish.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Catherine! Please! That book is my mother's only legacy!
Medium shot from behind Catherine as she stands motionless, watching Juliana being dragged away.
Close-up of Juliana turning her head back toward Catherine, screaming through tears.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It contains years of her work! Her knowledge! Everything she left me!
Full shot of Catherine turning gracefully on the dungeon steps, holding the book loosely at her side.
Medium close-up pushing in on Catherine as she presents the worn botanical book with both gloved hands.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Your mother's little book of weeds?

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You still call this a legacy?

units.text: Medium close-up of Juliana rising swiftly from her chair, shock and terror flashing across her face.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander!
Close-up of Alexander struggling to breathe, clutching his bloodied coat over his chest.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: It is nothing.
Medium shot of Juliana hurriedly stepping toward him across the stone floor.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: There is blood running down your arm.
Medium profile two-shot as Alexander stands rigid while Juliana confronts him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: A cut from the tenant fields.
Wide shot of the hearth room as Juliana firmly points toward a wooden armchair beside the fire.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Sit down.
Close-up of Juliana's determined, unyielding expression.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Now.
Medium shot of Alexander reluctantly lowering his heavy frame onto the chair in front of the fire.
Medium tracking shot following Juliana as she brings a wooden washbowl, fresh cloth, and an earthen jar of ointment to the foot of his chair.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I need to see the wound.
Low-angle close-up of Alexander looking up at her stubbornly.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: It is only a scratch.
Medium shot of Juliana crossing her arms over her chest, eyeing him with quiet defiance.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Then removing your shirt should not trouble you.
Medium shot as Alexander stares at her for a beat before pushing himself up from the chair and shedding his heavy leather coat.
Close-up of Juliana observing him with guarded anticipation.
Close-up shot of Alexander pulling his dark shirt over his head, revealing his muscular torso crisscrossed with jagged battle scars and fresh bleeding lacerations.
Tight pan over the scarred, wounded flesh along his chest and ribs.
Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in horror and deep pity.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Dear God.
Medium wide shot as Alexander sinks back into the chair, exhausted, while Juliana slowly kneels before him on the stone floor.
Extreme close-up macro shot of Juliana's trembling fingers hovering tenderly over the raised, jagged scar across Alexander's chest.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her eyes softened with profound empathy.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You have suffered terribly.
Close-up of Alexander's weathered, scarred face gazing down at her with quiet stoicism.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: It is over.
Medium close-up of Juliana dipping a linen cloth into the water bowl.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Your scars disagree.
Close-up shot of Juliana carefully dabbing the damp cloth against the bloody cut on Alexander's shoulder.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Does it hurt?

units.text: Medium shot of Alexander staring down at her, waiting for the dark truth.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: What did you find?
Tight close-up on Juliana's trembling lips.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Poison.
Slightly wider close-up as Juliana's eyes well with distress.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Arsenic.
Alexander's hand drops to his side and clenches into a white-knuckled fist, the thick scar across his hand tightening with intense restraint.
Close-up on Alexander's fist clenching tightly in fury.
Medium close-up of Juliana, her voice filled with mounting dread.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Someone has been giving it to her again and again. Small amounts. Enough to make her weaker without killing her quickly.
Close-up of Alexander processing the sinister calculation behind the poisoning.
Two-shot as Juliana looks up at him with quiet hope.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I made her medicine. She was still barely conscious, but her breathing became easier.
Close-up of Alexander's startled gaze.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You treated her?

units.text: Close-up on Gerald's cold, merciless face staring ahead unblinkingly.
Tight insert on Juliana's hand clutching the heirloom amethyst pendant resting against her gown.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You gave me your word before both our families.
Medium two-shot of Gerald and Clarissa standing side by side before the priest.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: Promises change when a better choice appears.
Medium close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her voice quivering with disbelief.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: A better choice? Is that what she is?
Wide shot from behind Juliana looking up the altar stairs at Gerald with Clarissa linked to his arm.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: She is what I should have chosen from the beginning.
Medium shot of Juliana's father seated prominently in the family pew, clutching his gold-topped cane.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Father...
Close-up of the father's stern, unyielding face.
Medium shot of Juliana turning toward her father in the pews, imploring him.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Surely you will not let him humiliate me like this?

units.text: Close-up of Gerald chuckling smugly on the terrace above, crossing his arms.
Tight close-up of Juliana gently clasping Alexander's handcuffed hands, gazing up at him with unyielding love.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You stood beside me when everyone else abandoned me. I will not abandon you now.
Juliana releases his hands and turns toward the briar thicket. Alexander stretches out his chained hands, attempting to hold her back, but the Constable restrains him.
Medium shot behind Juliana as she walks toward the vast expanse of frozen briars.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Careful, sister.
Low-angle shot of Clarissa smirking down over the carved stone balustrade.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: That garden has swallowed better women than you.
Medium close-up of Gerald leaning against the balcony beside Clarissa, wearing an arrogant smirk.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Perhaps the beggar's wife will finally learn what her new life is worth.
Juliana drops to her knees in front of the frozen blackthorn branches, steadying her trembling breath.
Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the frozen soil at the edge of the briars.
Medium shot of Alexander lunging forward with chained hands raised high, roaring in fury as the Constable grabs him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana, stop!
Rattling of heavy iron chains.
Juliana crawls forward on all fours, lowering her head under the jagged, arching thorns.
Eye-level shot looking through the thorny thicket at Juliana crawling deeper into the briars.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Please...
Extreme close-up of Alexander's anguished face as he strains furiously against his handcuffs.
Ground-level shot of Juliana's bare hands reaching out onto the cracked, frozen ground.
Sharp blackthorn spines rake across Juliana's fingers and knuckles, carving bloody gashes across her skin.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No...
Extreme close-up of Juliana's hand scraping against the frost-covered stone, bright red blood welling from deep puncture wounds.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Look at her hands.
Medium shot on the balcony as Clarissa gleefully points down at Juliana, Gerald chuckling beside her.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: The lady has finally found something worthy of her.
Gerald leans his hands on the terrace railing, sneering callously.
Low-angle medium close-up of Gerald shouting down into the garden.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Keep searching, Juliana. Your husband's freedom is somewhere in that garden.
Macro close-up of a massive blackthorn needle stabbing deep into the back of Juliana's bleeding hand.
Sickening crunch and scrape of thorns slicing through flesh.
Close-up of Alexander struggling in agony, tears forming in his eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Please... enough!

units.text: Gerald chose money.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Clarissa chose a coward.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I chose myself.

units.text: You chose a beggar.

units.text: I chose a man.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: A scarred nobody.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You call that marriage?

Crisp tear of wax and parchment string snapping open.
Low-angle medium shot of the High Priest opening the yellowed War Office document.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: None shall leave until every witness is accounted for.
Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing defiant at the altar as congregation members watch in silence.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: You married this woman as a nameless beggar...
Medium close-up of the High Priest holding the decree, his gaze burning with disdain.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: ...in a hedge ceremony no clerk in England ever recorded.
Full shot of the High Priest brandishing the letter aloft in the center of the chapel nave.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him.
Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana, placing a protective hand on her arm.
Juliana places her hand over Alexander's as he steps forward to shield her.
Close-up of Alexander, his scarred face hardening with unwavering conviction.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: She married the man... not the title.
Low-angle shot looking up at the High Priest as he raises the parchment toward the vaulted ceiling.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone.
Medium shot of the High Priest lowering the document, raising a single finger in admonishment.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry.
Two-shot of Juliana and Alexander listening intently, Juliana's eyes flashing with hurt and defiance.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: No licensed clergyman presided...
Close-up of the High Priest glaring intently.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I have seen these symptoms before.
Close-up of Prudence's terrified face.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: What are you saying?
Close-up of Juliana's hands snapping the leather journal shut on the bedside table beside an oil lamp.
Medium close-up of Juliana resting her hands on the closed journal, looking squarely at Prudence.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Someone is poisoning her.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Poison?

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA

units.text: Your brother is breathing again.

Medium close-up of the maid trembling as she raises her eyes hesitantly.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: Yes, my Lord.
Medium shot of the Lord standing beside his mahogany desk, looking down with cold, calculating scrutiny.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: And who saved him?
Close-up of the maid's anxious, innocent face.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: Lady Juliana.
Close-up of the Lord's hand slowly rotating the heavy gold signet ring on his pinky finger.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Tell me how.
Medium close-up of the maid nervously wringing her apron fabric.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: She... she used herbs.
Close-up on the Lord leaning forward abruptly, his piercing gaze bearing down.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: What herbs?

units.text: Close-up pushing in on Catherine as she leans lower over his face, her gaze sharpening with dangerous intimacy.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite.
Medium two-shot from the side as both sit up in bed, sheets pulled up around their waists.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Name your price.
Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: For as long as it holds.
Medium close-up as Catherine breaks into a knowing, seductive smile and taps his chest with her index finger.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Done. You told yourself this ends when the hearing does.
Close-up on Father Thomas letting out a soft, self-deprecating chuckle before meeting her eyes with smoldering hunger.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: I've told myself that since the dawn in your bedchamber, and here we are again.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: In another room no one uses?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And?!
Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: They condemned her.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: No.
Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: She is to be executed.
Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: When?
Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: After the wedding.
Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: What wedding?
Profile close-up of his mother looking at him across the lantern light.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Rupert... and Catherine's.

Frontal close-up on his mother, solemn and resolute in her warning.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Two days from now.
Profile shot of Alexander as dark realization settles over his face, turning to a grim, predatory glare.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They are marrying in two days...
Tight, terrifying close-up on Alexander's eyes flashing with murderous wrath.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: ...and killing my wife afterward.
Medium shot as his mother urgently grabs Alexander's coat, pleading with him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!
Close-up on Alexander, towering over her, immovable and consumed by purpose.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They already took my name.
Close-up on Alexander stepping forward, his voice rising with lethal thunder.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They stole my home!
Tight close-up on his furious, bared teeth and wild eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And now they have taken Juliana!

units.text: I said arrest him!

units.text: Why?!

Medium shot of Catherine clutching her father's arm, her bridal bouquet drooping as panic seizes her face.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Rupert...

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: You cannot be him. Alexander died!
Wide tracking shot behind Alexander as he advances down the center aisle, silhouetted against the ruins of the cathedral nave.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Alexander...
Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Mother.
His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: What is it you actually need from me, Catherine? Say it plainly, for once.
Medium close-up of Catherine raising one hand slightly, emphasizing her terms.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: First, the hearing stays unresolved as long as possible. Every extension, every delay, every excuse to reconvene.
Frontal close-up of Catherine raising two fingers in the candlelight, her eyes burning with ruthless intent.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Second, I want to know what the council knows before it decides anything. Every argument, every witness, every whisper against her.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: You want eyes inside the council chamber itself?
Close-up low angle on Catherine, tilting her chin up in defiant pride.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I want eyes and ears everywhere that decides my future.
Full two-shot of Catherine and Father Thomas facing off across the small table in the cavernous hallway.
Father Thomas clasps his hands behind his back, turning slightly away to ponder the gravity of her words.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Is that so unreasonable coming from a woman the church itself just humiliated back into relevance?

units.text: Close-up of Juliana's hand frantically grabbing the wooden rim of a pew, knuckles white with strain.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Please! Someone!
The guards tear her grip away from the pew.
Muffled scuffle, rustle of heavy silk and frantic gasps echoing off cathedral stone.
High wide shot down the vaulted cathedral aisle showing the entire congregation watching in stunned silence as the guards drag Juliana.
Wide eye-level shot looking down the petal-strewn marble aisle. A tall, rugged man in a worn dark trench coat—The Bearded Stranger—emerges into the center of the nave.
The Bearded Stranger steps deliberately into the aisle, his heavy boots echoing.
Close-up on the Noble Matriarch freezing in utter shock and outrage.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: Take your hands off her.
Medium tracking shot front-on as The Bearded Stranger marches down the flower-strewn aisle with resolute purpose.
Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch stepping forward on the altar steps, furiously pointing a finger at him.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!
High wide shot of the magnificent vaulted hall as The Bearded Stranger walks steadily forward, dwarfing the aisle.
Medium shot on the lead royal guard squaring his shoulders, barring the stranger's advance while Juliana stands behind him.

units.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
units.text: Stand aside, stranger!
Medium close-up profile on The Bearded Stranger, eyes burning with quiet, lethal resolve.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: I said...
Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's intense, scarred face.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: ...let her go.
Medium action shot as the guard charges toward The Bearded Stranger.
The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed guard instantly to the floor.
A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.
Medium close-up of Gerald turning frantically to the remaining guards and congregation, panicking.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!
Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger standing unmoved over the fallen guard, turning his gaze toward Juliana.
Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger stepping up to Lady Juliana, who gazes up at him in stunned breathlessness.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: Are you hurt?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: The window!

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Hold on to me.
Medium close-up of Alexander gritting his teeth, holding Juliana securely as she buries her face into his neck.

Loud explosion of shattering window glass and splintering wood.

Wide shot of villagers running toward the cottage carrying wooden water buckets through the smoke-filled darkness.
Close-up of Juliana kneeling in the mud, her face blackened with soot and tears streaming down her cheeks as she clutches the charred ledger.
Wide shot of the cottage completely consumed by towering flames against the dark night sky.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Our home...

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Everything we had is gone.
Alexander kneels beside her in the grass, resting a steady, protective hand on her back.
Juliana turns toward Alexander, her hand trembling as she reaches out and touches his chest.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Why would anyone do this?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander...

units.text: Medium close-up of Catherine gently moving her fan, raising an intrigued brow.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And if she claims she is a healer?
Tight close-up of the Elder Nobleman's face illuminated by warm firelight.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Then call it witchcraft.
Close-up of Rupert wide-eyed with shock at the severity of the plan.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: Witchcraft is a capital charge.
Straight-on close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring back without a flicker of remorse.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Precisely.
Medium three-shot framing Rupert, the Elder Nobleman between them, and Catherine listening closely.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her.
Close-up of Catherine smiling with malicious satisfaction, fluttering her fan.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Her botanical ledger...
Close-up of the Elder Nobleman nodding slowly.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Exactly.
Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And the Dowager?
Medium shot of the Elder Nobleman gesturing dismissively with one gloved hand.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household.
Medium close-up of Rupert exhaling deeply, processing the horrifying certainty of their conspiracy.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: And Juliana?

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN

units.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
units.text: Lady Catherine Ashbridge.
Medium shot as Clarissa unfolds the second page attached to the invitation, her expression shifting to intrigue.

units.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
units.text: And after the ceremony...

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN
units.text: What?
Clarissa hands the letter upward to him. He takes it and looks down at the bold heading.
Close-up of the nobleman reading, his eyes widening in shock before breaking into a grin.

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN
units.text: The sentencing of the condemned.
Close-up of Clarissa turning back to the fire, laughing softly with dark delight.

units.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
units.text: They want the families to witness it.
Medium shot of the nobleman holding the invitation, chuckling at the audacity.

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN
units.text: A public execution after a wedding.
Medium profile shot of Clarissa gazing back at him over her shoulder.

units.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
units.text: Not just an execution. A warning.
Close-up of the nobleman's stern face, leaning down.

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN
units.text: To whom?

units.text: Medium close-up of Lady Ashcroft, resplendent in navy velvet and jewels, stepping forward with a smirk of malicious authority.

units.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
units.text: Enough sentiment.

units.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
units.text: And the ledger...
Medium shot as Lady Ashcroft approaches Juliana menacingly.

units.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
units.text: ...that belongs to this family.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It belonged to my mother! It is all I have left of her.

units.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
units.text: Then you should have guarded it better.

units.text: Perhaps that is where it belongs.

Juliana drops to her knees onto the wet courtyard pavement, oblivious to the dirt soaking through her white bridal gown.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Keep your head down. If anyone recognizes you, everything is over.
Close-up of Lady Juliana leaning back against the rough stone wall, whispering back firmly.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: No one will recognize me dressed like this.
Medium close-up of Prudence glancing nervously toward the courtyard before fixing her gaze on Juliana.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: This is Ashburton Manor. The housekeeper watches everyone. Lady Catherine watches everyone, and Lord Rupert...

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: The Duchess is dying.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I saved Toby. I can save her.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: And if they discover who you are?

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Then I will face that when she is breathing again.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Your Grace?

units.text: Close-up of Alexander, his scarred face hardening with unwavering conviction.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: She married the man... not the title.
Low-angle shot looking up at the High Priest as he raises the parchment toward the vaulted ceiling.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone.
Medium shot of the High Priest lowering the document, raising a single finger in admonishment.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.
Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Then look at this floor honestly, for once.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A church called me unworthy.
Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A church chained me.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Now a church calls my marriage a lie!

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.
Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: His skin is burning hot.
Lady Juliana places her bandaged hand against Toby's flushed, sweating forehead as he wheezes painfully.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Yes! Right away, I will get it!

Close-up top-down view of Lady Juliana's bandaged fingers gently touching an ink illustration of chamomile flowers in the open ledger.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Yes, just like that. Keep breathing, Toby. Let the vapor clear your chest.

Close-up of Toby's face relaxing, his chest falling still and calm.
Close-up of Prudence covering her mouth in overwhelmed relief, tears streaming down her face.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!

Medium shot of Lady Juliana sitting on a stool beside Toby's bedside, placing a cup of coltsfoot tea on a small wooden table.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you...

Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal.
Low-angle two-shot of the High Priest staring up into Alexander's imposing frame.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER

Close-up on Lady Juliana nodding slightly.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Yes, ma'am.

units.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
units.text: Carry coal?
Close-up of the Housekeeper's stern face.
Cut back to Lady Juliana maintaining her meek posture.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Yes, ma'am.
Profile medium two-shot as the Housekeeper steps right up into Lady Juliana's face, staring intently into her downcast eyes.

units.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
units.text: And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?
Extreme close-up on Lady Juliana's composed, lowered face.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Yes, ma'am.
Medium shot of the Housekeeper turning and pointing a bony finger toward the servant corridor stairs.

units.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
units.text: Then prove it. The manor has no use for useless girls.
The Housekeeper turns and stalks away down the corridor. Prudence exhales a trembling breath of relief.
Wide shot of the dimly lit hallway showing the Housekeeper walking away into the distance.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: That was close.
Close-up on Lady Juliana clutching the wash bucket, her eyes scanning ahead urgently.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Where is the West Wing?
Medium shot of Prudence pointing toward the archway leading toward the grand staircase.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: Beyond the grand staircase. Few servants go there.
Tracking shot from behind Lady Juliana as she walks out into the vast, opulent marble hall of Ashbury Manor carrying her bucket.
Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.
Low-angle push-in on Lady Juliana looking up at the enormous portrait of the late Duke and Duchess hanging above the gallery.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: This house...
Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.
Medium close-up of Prudence whispering frantically into Juliana's ear.

units.text: Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You were rejected!
Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth.
Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.
Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Your soldier?
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glowing with genuine devotion.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: My husband.
Close-up of Catherine scowling with deep disgust.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: He is a nobody.
Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, totally untroubled.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Then I love a nobody.
Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did.
Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You know nothing about my world.

units.text: Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: When?
Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: After the wedding.
Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: What wedding?
Profile close-up of his mother looking at him across the lantern light.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Rupert... and Catherine's.
A sudden dramatic metallic swell underscores the impending deadline.
Frontal close-up on his mother, solemn and resolute in her warning.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Two days from now.
Profile shot of Alexander as dark realization settles over his face, turning to a grim, predatory glare.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: They are marrying in two days...

units.text: Catherine abruptly pulls away from Rupert and raises her white-gloved hand high, commanding silence from the congregation.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Wait.
Medium shot tracking Catherine as she pivots toward the seated aristocracy, her veil floating gracefully behind her.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Before I become Duchess of Ashburgh...
Close-up of Catherine's face, her lips curling into a sadistic, triumphant sneer.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: ...I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who dares defy this family.
Two-shot profile of Rupert and Catherine. Rupert turns to her with mild caution.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Catherine...

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Bring her in.
Heavy wooden creak of the cathedral double doors swinging open.
Wide shot from behind the altar down the aisle as the great church doors slowly open, revealing the silhouette of three figures against the daylight.
Juliana, dressed in a coarse drab prison dress with a numbered identification badge, is marched forward by two armed constables holding her by the arms.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's scarred, dirtied wrists bound tight in heavy iron shackles.
Intense close-up of Juliana's bruised, dirt-streaked face. Her piercing blue eyes burn with fierce dignity despite her captive state.
Medium shot of Catherine standing beside the altar, watching Juliana's entrance with gloating satisfaction.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: There she is.
Medium tracking shot of Juliana marching between the stern constables down the central aisle toward the altar.
Medium shot of a seated aristocratic couple in the pews, whispering and sneering behind an ivory lace fan.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Look at her.

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN
units.text: She actually came back to the chapel.
Close-up of the noblewoman giggling with hand over mouth, glancing spitefully at the disgraced bride.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Not as a bride this time.
Medium shot of two senior aristocrats in the carved choir stalls, resting on their canes and nodding in smug agreement.
Close profile of Juliana as she halts in the center aisle, lifting her chin proudly to face the sneering onlookers.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around.
High-angle wide shot showing Juliana flanked by guards in the center of the lavishly decorated nave, dwarfed by the grand cathedral.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: This is the world you thought you belonged to.
Low-angle medium shot of Catherine gesturing broadly from the altar steps, looking down upon Juliana like an empress.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And now they can all see what you truly are.
Medium shot of Juliana standing firmly between the guards, calmly meeting Catherine's venomous gaze.
Juliana looks around the cathedral at the sea of pompous faces, then raises her eyes straight back to Catherine with utter disdain.
Tight close-up on Juliana's bruised, unshaken face.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?

units.text: Medium shot through the cell bars as a Guard in a black collared uniform with silver buttons halts outside.
The Guard pauses, glancing over his shoulder into the gloomy corridor to ensure he is unobserved.
Low-angle shot focusing on the wet flagstones at the base of the cell door.
The Guard kneels down and slips a small loaf of rustic bread through the bottom gap between the iron bars, nudging it inside before withdrawing his gloved hand.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling forward across the stone floor toward the bread, her gaze fixed on the offering in disbelief.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Why?
Medium close-up of the Guard looking through the vertical bars with quiet compassion.

units.speaker: GUARD
units.text: Because no one should die hungry.

units.speaker: GUARD
units.text: Eat it before they see.
Over-the-shoulder shot through the cell bars as the Guard turns and walks swiftly away into the dark corridor.
The Guard's silhouette retreats into the shadows.
Tight shot following Juliana's trembling, shackle-bound hands as she reaches out and drags the loaf toward her chest.
Juliana clutches the bread tightly with both hands, tears welling in her eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Thank you.
Starving and overcome with emotion, Juliana presses the bread to her lips and tears off a desperate, ravenous bite.
Close-up profile of Juliana chewing the bread, tears rolling down her soot-streaked cheek.
Juliana chews hungrily, closing her eyes as the agonizing reality of her plight hits her anew.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander...

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Look at me, Juliana.
Close-up of Alexander raising his scarred hand to tenderly cradle Juliana's cheek.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You saved my mother's life. You stood by me when I had nothing.
Tight close-up on Alexander's gaze locking onto Juliana's tearful eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You are my wife.
Alexander gently pulls Juliana closer, his hands resting securely on her shoulders.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You were my wife before that priest ever opened his mouth. And we will stand before the King and God again within ten days. Nothing breaks that.
Wide establishing shot of the rain-drenched cobblestone courtyard surrounded by imposing Gothic arches.
Medium shot of Lady Ashbourne leaning heavily on her walking cane, glaring down at Catherine who kneels in the mud.

units.speaker: LADY ASHBOURNE
units.text: You dare show your face in Ashbourne courtyard?
High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in her disheveled burgundy gown, clutching her skirts and weeping profusely.

units.text: Close-up of Juliana, trying to keep her composure.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula.
Medium two-shot as the Duchess leans forward slightly, staring at the ring between their joined hands.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest.
Close-up on Juliana, shaking her head in disbelief and growing confusion.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word.
Low-angle shot on the Duchess, tears welling in her eyes as grief and shock overtake her.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war...
Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in stunned revelation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant.
Side-angle medium shot of the bed, the Duchess holding onto Juliana's forearm with fierce insistence.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: My lost son wore that ring!
Close-up of Juliana looking down with compassionate concern.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Did your husband serve beside him?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival.
Close-up of the Duchess gazing up at Juliana, her voice barely a whisper.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: What is your husband's name?
Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.
Juliana gasps, snapping her head toward the entrance in alarm.
The heavy mahogany double doors burst open, revealing the Blond Nobleman flanked by Lady Catherine and a royal guard in uniform.
Wide shot framing the open doorway as the aristocrats step into the dimly lit hallway.
Medium shot of Lady Catherine in her lavish cream gown and tiara, scowling with arrogant disdain.

units.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
units.text: What is that maid doing in Her Grace's private chamber?
Medium shot of Juliana standing stiffly beside the bed, concealing her hands.
