units.text: Close-up of the Lord calmly watching her futile resistance.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: That will be your testimony.
Close-up of the maid's face frozen in horrified realization.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: My testimony?!
Close-up of the Lord delivering the ultimatum without blinking.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Before the magistrate.
Close-up of the maid grabbing both sides of her head, screaming out in utter grief and guilt.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: I never said she was a witch!
Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning his back and walking back behind his desk.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: You do not need to.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: I have already written the story for you.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: She saved my brother...

units.text: Low-angle focus on a dripping candle burning on a wooden table beside a dark window looking out into the misty night.
Medium close-up of Catherine in a lace nightgown and lilac robe, holding a goblet of red wine with cold determination.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Rupert is rotting in the undercroft cells. Not me. I intend to stay on this estate.
Two-shot framing Catherine in the background with a muscular, bare-chested conspirator standing in shadow beside her.

units.speaker: CONSPIRATOR
units.text: Alexander will scour the grounds at first light. The High Council has already blocked the marriage registry.
Close-up profile of Catherine leaning close to the man's shoulder, her eyes burning with ambition.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Then you will make sure I remain inside these walls.
Silhouette shot against the tall arched window as Catherine turns her back to him.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Keep the council paralyzed. I will do the rest.
Atmospheric wide pan across the spacious master bedroom, daylight spilling softly through tall Gothic windows onto the hearth fire.
Medium shot of Alexander and Juliana sitting together on the edge of the velvet bed, dressed in morning robes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: What if Father Thomas sways the High Council?
Close-up of Juliana's distressed face, tears shimmering in her eyes as she looks up at Alexander.

units.text: Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You planted it!
Medium shot of Clarissa gliding past Gerald, a venomous, amused smile playing upon her lips.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Oh, dear sister...
Tight shot of Alexander's hand clenching into a tight, trembling fist against the glow of the roaring fireplace.
Close-up of Alexander glaring daggers at Clarissa.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: ...still defending your broken scrap of a man?
Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes narrowing with sharp perception.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Name your price, Clarissa. I know you.
Medium close-up of Clarissa smiling with vicious delight.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape.
Tight shot of Clarissa smoothing her long purple evening glove along her wrist.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Perhaps I can give you one.
Close-up of Juliana watching her with cautious skepticism.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: What do you want?
Medium two-shot of Clarissa in the foreground, turning slowly to face Juliana.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: I want to see you crawl, sister.
Medium close-up profile tracking shot of Clarissa pacing slowly as she spins her sadistic tale.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it...
Close-up of Clarissa flexing her gloved fingers theatrically in front of her face.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: ...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice.
Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.
Medium two-shot of Clarissa stepping closer to Juliana, peering down into her eyes with a predatory smile.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives.
Medium shot of Gerald tapping his whip against his palm and laughing heartily beside the Constable.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!
Medium three-shot of Clarissa stepping behind Juliana, as Alexander watches helplessly with dark fury.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Do it, and we withdraw the charges.

Extreme close-up of Clarissa's mouth leaning directly into Juliana's ear, whispering venomously.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows.
Medium close-up of Alexander stepping up beside Juliana, tenderly placing his large hand on her shoulder.
Alexander rests his scarred hand reassuringly on Juliana's shoulder, leaning in toward her.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana, no. Do not let them hurt you. I can handle the law.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, her hand gripping the fabric over her heart in agony and resolve.
Juliana clutches the front of her rustic grey dress, her breathing trembling.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I am not letting them take you.
Juliana turns her head sharply back toward Clarissa, her expression hardening with fierce resolution.
Over-the-shoulder shot past Clarissa onto Juliana's determined face, holding on her fierce, defiant stare as the tension peaks.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Tell me where the garden is.

Juliana locks eyes with Clarissa without flinching as the scene freezes on her brave, sacrificial defiance.

units.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up into Alexander's eyes with tender courage.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I will be fine.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I would rather face the gallows than watch you hurt yourself for me.
Two-shot framing Alexander leaning down toward Juliana, fighting against his bonds.
Close-up of Gerald chuckling smugly on the terrace above, crossing his arms.
Tight close-up of Juliana gently clasping Alexander's handcuffed hands, gazing up at him with unyielding love.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You stood beside me when everyone else abandoned me. I will not abandon you now.
Juliana releases his hands and turns toward the briar thicket. Alexander stretches out his chained hands, attempting to hold her back, but the Constable restrains him.
Medium shot behind Juliana as she walks toward the vast expanse of frozen briars.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Careful, sister.
Low-angle shot of Clarissa smirking down over the carved stone balustrade.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: That garden has swallowed better women than you.
Medium close-up of Gerald leaning against the balcony beside Clarissa, wearing an arrogant smirk.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Perhaps the beggar's wife will finally learn what her new life is worth.
Juliana drops to her knees in front of the frozen blackthorn branches, steadying her trembling breath.
Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the frozen soil at the edge of the briars.
Medium shot of Alexander lunging forward with chained hands raised high, roaring in fury as the Constable grabs him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana, stop!
Rattling of heavy iron chains.
Juliana crawls forward on all fours, lowering her head under the jagged, arching thorns.
Eye-level shot looking through the thorny thicket at Juliana crawling deeper into the briars.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Please...
Extreme close-up of Alexander's anguished face as he strains furiously against his handcuffs.
Ground-level shot of Juliana's bare hands reaching out onto the cracked, frozen ground.
Sharp blackthorn spines rake across Juliana's fingers and knuckles, carving bloody gashes across her skin.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: What have they done to you?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Nothing they didn't promise.
Medium profile two-shot of Alexander and Juliana gazing into each other's eyes amidst the cold mist.

units.speaker: JULIANA

Crackling flames and wood popping in the open fireplace.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You could have lost your hands.

Tight close-up of Gerald, face contorted in rage.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: For a penniless nobody!
Medium two-shot of Juliana standing tall before Gerald in the chapel aisle, her husband standing guard behind her.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I would rather choose my own life...
Close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unshakable pride.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: ...than spend another moment begging for yours.
Tight close-up of Gerald, eyes wide with speechless shock and wounded pride.
Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.
Wide shot of Lady Ashcroft rising abruptly from the front pew, pointing an accusatory hand toward the doors.

units.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
units.text: Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!
Tight close-up of Lady Ashcroft, eyes blazing with cold malice.

units.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
units.text: You are disowned!
Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft bowing his head deeply over his cane in shame.
Close-up of Juliana. Tears brim in her eyes at the formal rejection, but she does not break.
Medium two-shot as the Mysterious Bearded Man turns gently to Juliana, reaching his hand out once more.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: Come, Lady Juliana.
Close-up of Juliana placing her hand securely into his, gripping his scarred hand.
Wide tracking shot behind Juliana and the warrior as they begin walking down the central aisle toward the chapel doors.
Medium three-shot of Gerald, Clarissa, and Lady Ashcroft watching in stunned silence and disbelief.
Clarissa gapes in shock while Lady Ashcroft exhales in exasperation.
Wide shot from the back of the chapel as the massive oak doors swing wide open, revealing bright daylight and the courtyard outside.
Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walk hand-in-hand through the towering doors into the sunlight together, turning their backs on the ruined wedding as the screen fades out.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: Miss Ashcroft.
Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man pause on the stone steps, turning slightly back toward Lord Ashcroft.
Close-up of Lord Ashcroft, his weathered face rigid with aristocratic pride and disgust.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: You will not leave this church carrying the Ashcroft name.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at her father. Her hand rises to touch the amethyst heirloom pendant resting at her throat.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: The vows are spoken, Father. I am his wife now.
Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft standing rigid outside the chapel archway, unforgiving and unyielding.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: Then leave as his wife.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: You leave as no daughter of mine.
Low-angle shot tracking Lord Ashcroft's polished black boots as he slowly descends the stone steps toward them.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: Your dowry is revoked.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: Your inheritance is revoked.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes wide with shock and heartbreak as she holds the ledger close against her chest.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: From this moment, you are dead to the Ashcroft family.

units.text: Close-up of Juliana observing him with guarded anticipation.
Close-up shot of Alexander pulling his dark shirt over his head, revealing his muscular torso crisscrossed with jagged battle scars and fresh bleeding lacerations.
Tight pan over the scarred, wounded flesh along his chest and ribs.
Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in horror and deep pity.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Dear God.
Medium wide shot as Alexander sinks back into the chair, exhausted, while Juliana slowly kneels before him on the stone floor.
Extreme close-up macro shot of Juliana's trembling fingers hovering tenderly over the raised, jagged scar across Alexander's chest.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her eyes softened with profound empathy.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You have suffered terribly.
Close-up of Alexander's weathered, scarred face gazing down at her with quiet stoicism.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: It is over.
Medium close-up of Juliana dipping a linen cloth into the water bowl.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Your scars disagree.
Close-up shot of Juliana carefully dabbing the damp cloth against the bloody cut on Alexander's shoulder.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Does it hurt?

units.text: Medium shot of the noblewoman turning the crop in her white-gloved hands with smug satisfaction.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place.
The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.
Low tracking shot down the corridor as the hem of the lilac dress sweeps past, followed by Juliana's swift steps.
Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.
Wide shot of the vast soot-stained stone fireplace. The noblewoman turns back toward Juliana, crop held at her side.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Clean it.
Medium shot of the noblewoman extending her gloved hand toward the cavernous, filth-laden hearth.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at the towering, soot-blackened chimney.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: All of it, my lady?
Extreme close-up two-shot as the noblewoman steps unnervingly close to Juliana's face, whispering with sadistic relish.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are.
Juliana slowly drops to her knees on the cold flagstones before the soot-filled fireplace.
Medium shot of Juliana sinking to her knees, her face grim and composed.
Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.
Close-up of Prudence's anxious, trembling face.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: My lady—
The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.
Medium close-up of the noblewoman baring her teeth in rage, aiming the crop threateningly.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Do you want the same punishment?
Close-up of Prudence flinching in terror, lowering her eyes immediately.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: What a magnificent fall, Lady Juliana.
Medium shot of Rupert gesturing toward the exit with an outstretched arm.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Drag her to the wet cells beneath the south tower.
Close-up of Catherine fanning open the illustrated botanical pages of the herbarium with gloved fingers.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And this?

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: This book of weeds will hang her before the magistrate.
Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the guard's grip, her arm reaching out toward the book.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: That book is my mother's life's work!
Medium close-up of Catherine smiling coldly, clutching the closed book against her bodice.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Then perhaps you can explain every page to the magistrate...

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: ...before he sends you to the gallows.

Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eyes as the guard wrenches her backward into the dark hallway, cutting sharply to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---
High angle tracking shot descending a spiral stone staircase illuminated by flickering wall torches and damp, glistening masonry.
Dripping water echoes hollowly against stone steps alongside the shuffling scuffle of boots.
Tracking shot facing two stern uniform guards hauling a struggling Juliana down the dark corridor by her arms.
Juliana resists furiously, her feet stumbling on the wet flagstones as the guards forcibly propel her forward.
Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing regally under an arched stone doorway, clutching the leather-bound herbarium.
Tight close-up of Juliana's tearful face as she reaches an arm out toward Catherine in anguish.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Catherine! Please! That book is my mother's only legacy!
Medium shot from behind Catherine as she stands motionless, watching Juliana being dragged away.
Close-up of Juliana turning her head back toward Catherine, screaming through tears.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It contains years of her work! Her knowledge! Everything she left me!
Full shot of Catherine turning gracefully on the dungeon steps, holding the book loosely at her side.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Your mother's little book of weeds?

units.text: Medium close-up of the Lord standing right beside her shoulder, whispering in her ear like an insidious specter.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Around him.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Like a circle?

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: Yes.
Close-up from behind the maid as the Lord leans close to her ear.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: And she opened her mother's book...
Extreme close-up of the maid's tear-drenched eyes and quivering lips.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: Yes.
Close-up of the Lord delivering the final trap.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: ...and spoke words you could not understand.
Close-up of the maid gasping out in desperate agony.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: She was praying!
Close-up of the Lord grinning with sinister triumph.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: Praying... or chanting?
Close-up of the maid breaking down completely.

units.text: Two-shot of Clarissa and Gerald standing proudly side-by-side in their pew as Clarissa points mocking fingers.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: You have finally found a man as worthless as everyone thinks you are.
Close-up of Juliana's side profile, hurt glistening in her eyes as the insult cuts deep.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up toward the high arches of the chapel, drawing inward strength.
Juliana closes her eyes briefly and releases a steadying breath.
Low-angle shot looking past the kneeling Mysterious Bearded Man up at Juliana.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You don't even know me.
Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gazing upward with unwavering earnestness.
Tight close-up of Juliana's anguished face.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You heard what they think I am.
Medium shot looking down as Juliana addresses the kneeling stranger directly.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Why would you offer me your name?
Low-angle close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: Because I know what I see.
Medium close-up of Juliana reacting with a mix of suspicion and wonder.
Intimate tight shot framing Juliana's profile beside his dark silhouette.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: And what do you see?
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.

units.text: Close-up of Catherine collapsed on the wet stones, looking up with tear-streaked panic.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Please, Alexander! Have mercy!
Medium shot of Juliana raising her right hand firmly to halt the guard.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Stop.
Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana in sheer disbelief.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana, she tried to destroy you!
Close-up of Juliana maintaining serene poise.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: She did.
Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps gracefully past Alexander toward Catherine.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud.
Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it.
Close-up of Catherine's face turning from despair to offended shock.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You want me? As a guest?
Close-up of Juliana staring straight into Catherine's eyes without blinking.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: As a scullery maid.
Medium shot of Catherine recoiling in disgust, looking around at the gathered estate retainers.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?
Dramatic profile two-shot of Juliana standing inches away from Catherine, dominating the confrontation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor.
Juliana extends the ring of iron keys outward in her fist.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn.
Close profile two-shot of the two women locked in an intense psychological battle.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You will scour the kitchen grease until midnight.
Juliana presents the rough hemp apron and heavy keys right to Catherine's face.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing.
Close-up of Catherine's trembling lips, humiliated tears spilling down her heavily made-up cheeks.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You humiliate me.
Medium shot of both women standing beneath the cathedral vaulting of the hall.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I offer you bread and honest labor. Take the apron, or leave the county.
Extreme close-up on Catherine's trembling hands as she reaches out, taking the coarse apron and clattering iron keys, pressing them desperately against her chest.

units.text: Medium close-up of the Priest holding his open liturgical book, bewildered and trembling.

units.speaker: THE PRIEST
units.text: My- My Lady...
Tight close-up of the Priest's alarmed, questioning eyes.

units.speaker: THE PRIEST
units.text: Are you certain?
Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft seated in his pew, gripping his cane, bowed in grim silence.
Close-up profile of Juliana, her expression clear and unshakable.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I am.
Medium close-up of the Priest swallowing hard and looking down at his book.

units.speaker: THE PRIEST
units.text: Then... let us proceed.
Close two-shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man and Juliana gazing intimately into each other's eyes.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: You need not say anything you do not mean.
Close-up of Juliana smiling softly up at him.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I truly mean it.
Close-up shot of his hands sliding the silver ring over her ring finger.
The Mysterious Bearded Man carefully slides the band onto Juliana's finger.
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her hands tenderly.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: You have my protection.
Tight shot of the warrior's face, his eyes full of devotion.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: You have my respect.
Extreme close-up of his intense gaze.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: And you have my word.
Medium three-shot with the Priest standing between them, raising both hands in blessing over their joined hands.

units.speaker: THE PRIEST
units.text: By the authority entrusted to me, I now pronounce you...

units.text: Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: My mother is a prisoner in her own house.
Close-up of the informant looking steadily at Alexander.

units.speaker: INFORMANT
units.text: And everyone believes you are dead.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred eye and grimly set mouth.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then let them believe it a little longer.

units.speaker: INFORMANT
units.text: And when we have the proof?
Dramatic low-angle push-in on Alexander's commanding silhouette, his combat scar etched sharply against the fog.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to.
Wide atmospheric shot of the shadowy barn loft. Moonlight filters through vertical wooden slats, illuminating Juliana seated on a pile of straw beside a warm, glowing kerosene lantern.
Over-the-shoulder close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands tracing the detailed botanical drawing on the charred page of her mother's herbal.
Close-up of Juliana's face, silent tears streaming down her soot-smudged cheeks as her chin quivers.
The heavy wooden barn doors creak open. Alexander steps into the lantern light, carrying a bundle of firewood and a thick blanket under his arm.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: We have lost everything.
Medium shot of Juliana breaking down in tears over her open book, struggling to breathe through her weeping.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I don't know what we will do tomorrow.
Alexander steps up behind her and gently drapes the thick woolen blanket over her trembling shoulders, resting his hands reassuringly on her.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Tomorrow, we begin again.
Close-up of Juliana turning her tear-drenched eyes up toward Alexander, her face filled with longing and newfound hope.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: How much longer can the frail thing survive?
Medium profile of Rupert looking out the window, hands clasped behind him.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort.
Close-up of Catherine turning her head toward the window, her lips curled in venomous disgust.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Good. The village is already whispering about her.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: They disgust me.
Medium two-shot. Rupert stands over Catherine seated at the polished table, placing a gloved hand possessively near her shoulder.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown.

Medium close-up tilting down on JULIANA kneeling in the straw beside a rustic wooden crate, sorting sprigs of dried lavender and sage into a woven basket. Her hands are bound in linen bandages from the recent fire.
The barn door opens, revealing daylight outside. SEAMUS, an older weathered villager in a waistcoat, carries a wooden bucket inside, his expression etched with deep sorrow and concern.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Let me take that basket, Lady Juliana.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft.
Seamus reaches down to take the handle of the basket from her.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at Seamus, her smudged face fierce with unyielding determination as she holds firmly onto the basket.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I do not yield to a cold draft.
Close-up of Seamus, his face agonizingly strained with grief for her lost status.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: You are a viscount's daughter!

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Sleeping on straw, sorting weeds!

units.text: Close-up of Alexander, his brow furrowed with deep protective worry.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Will you be going there again?
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes filled with resolute purpose.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I have to.
Juliana places her gentle hand against Alexander's broad chest, trying to soothe his rising anger.
Two-shot of Juliana leaning in, her hand resting over Alexander's coat.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: She is still sick. I cannot leave her there.
Alexander takes both of her hands into his own, gripping them tightly.
Medium two-shot of Alexander holding Juliana's hands in the dusky woods.
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his darkened face with questioning concern.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander... why are you so angry?
Close-up of Alexander speaking through clenched teeth, barely containing his protective fury.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Because you were standing inside a house where someone is poisoning a woman... and you never told me.

units.text: Extreme close-up of the bent, white-hot tip of the poker radiating heat, with Catherine's face blurred in the background as she gazes down with predatory pleasure.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Because this is what you were always meant to be.
Over-the-shoulder medium shot focusing on Juliana as Catherine presents the charred, singed pages of the botanical book.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name.
Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: [chuckles] And still you became a disgrace.
Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel.
Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar.

units.text: Low-angle shot looking up at the High Priest as he raises the parchment toward the vaulted ceiling.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone.
Medium shot of the High Priest lowering the document, raising a single finger in admonishment.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry.
Two-shot of Juliana and Alexander listening intently, Juliana's eyes flashing with hurt and defiance.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: No licensed clergyman presided...
Close-up of the High Priest glaring intently.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: ...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer.
Medium shot pushing into a close-up as the High Priest thrusts the royal War Office proclamation directly into the camera.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead.
Close-up of Juliana lifting her chin, tearful yet burning with righteous fury.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father.
Medium two-shot of Juliana standing proudly beside Alexander.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I won't ask it for permission to love.
Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.
Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Then look at this floor honestly, for once.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A church called me unworthy.
Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A church chained me.
Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Now a church calls my marriage a lie!

Lady Harrington lets out a soft, amused laugh as they reach the heavy wooden cathedral doors.
Dramatic tracking shot following Lord and Lady Harrington from behind as they stride down the candlelit aisle of the cathedral toward their reserved pew.

units.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
units.text: She stands beneath God's watch and still gets exactly what she deserves.
Lord and Lady Harrington slide gracefully into the polished wooden pew, smoothing their garments.
Medium profile shot of the couple seated in the pew, looking toward the grand altar.

units.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
units.text: We have an excellent view.

units.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
units.text: Of the wedding?

units.text: Medium two-shot of Alexander watching anxiously over the child's shoulder as Juliana tends to him.
Medium close-up of the peasant mother clutching her shawl, tears running down her cheeks.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: Since yesterday morning. He has barely eaten since sunset.
Close-up of Juliana resting two fingers against the boy's wrist, measuring his shallow pulse.
Juliana lifts the weathered herbal book and rapidly browses the handwritten pages.
Insert close-up of the open page illustrated with botanical drawings labeled 'Feverfew'.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Feverfew... Not alone.
Profile close-up of Juliana studying the grimoire's remedies intently while the mother weeps in the soft background.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Chamomile... and willow bark.
Close-up of Alexander leaning over the table, gazing at her with intense concern.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You're certain?
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes with resolute conviction.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I have to be.
Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander, I need hot water.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I'm on it.
Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: Please save him.
Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.
Medium close-up of Juliana clasping the mother's trembling hand across the wooden table.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: He is not beyond saving.
Close-up of Juliana carefully administering the herbal brew with a small wooden spoon into the sick boy's mouth.
The child swallows weakly and lets out a soft cough.
Close-up of the mother clutching her chest in anxious suspense.
Medium close-up of Juliana sitting quietly beside the boy, holding two fingers over his wrist to monitor his pulse.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the mother leaning across the table in panic.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: Why isn't it working?
Close-up of Juliana raising a calm finger, urging patience.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Wait.
Close-up of the sleeping boy as beads of sweat form on his forehead, his breathing deepening.
Close-up of the mother gently caressing her son's cheek, sobbing with relief.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: His fever... it's breaking.
Close-up of Juliana exhaling a deep breath of relief, smiling gently.
Close-up of the mother looking up at Juliana with overwhelming gratitude.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: You saved him.
Medium close-up of Juliana grasping the mother's hand with warm modesty.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: The herbs did their work. Let him rest.
Juliana places a comforting hand over the mother's hands.
The mother gathers her sleeping son in her arms and steps back toward the rainy doorway.
Medium shot from inside the cottage framing the mother standing at the open door looking back.

units.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
units.text: I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you.
The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.

units.text: Close-up of the Elder Nobleman nodding slowly.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Exactly.
Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And the Dowager?
Medium shot of the Elder Nobleman gesturing dismissively with one gloved hand.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household.
Medium close-up of Rupert exhaling deeply, processing the horrifying certainty of their conspiracy.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: And Juliana?
Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring sternly across the desk.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: She goes before the magistrate tomorrow.
Close-up of Catherine beaming with venomous glee, spreading her red fan wide.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: She will hang. A perfect solution. The town will cheer as the witch's disgraced daughter faces the noose.
Medium shot of Rupert pulling out the desk chair and seating himself with dark resolve.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: I will write the arrest warrant myself.
Extreme close-up of the Elder Nobleman's weathered face, his eyes cold and predatory in the firelight.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: You cannot be him. Alexander died!
Wide tracking shot behind Alexander as he advances down the center aisle, silhouetted against the ruins of the cathedral nave.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon.
Medium shot of an elderly silver-haired woman in simple ivory robes stepping into the aisle, her hands outstretched in trembling awe.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Alexander...
Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Mother.
His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: Look at you... my beautiful boy.
Medium two-shot framed down the ruined nave between Alexander and his mother.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
units.text: I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be.

units.text: Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.
Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Then look at this floor honestly, for once.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A church called me unworthy.
Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A church chained me.
Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Now a church calls my marriage a lie!

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!
Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you.
Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.
Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!
Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.
Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!
Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.
Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal.

units.text: Close-up of Juliana's distressed face, tears shimmering in her eyes as she looks up at Alexander.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: What if they strip your title? Because of me?
Juliana looks down at her hands, turning over her scarred palms shaped by years of herbal work.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I am only a healer. The lords will never accept me.
Profile shot as Alexander reaches out and firmly clasps Juliana's trembling hands in his own.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Look at me, Juliana.
Close-up of Alexander raising his scarred hand to tenderly cradle Juliana's cheek.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You saved my mother's life. You stood by me when I had nothing.
Tight close-up on Alexander's gaze locking onto Juliana's tearful eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You are my wife.
Alexander gently pulls Juliana closer, his hands resting securely on her shoulders.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You were my wife before that priest ever opened his mouth. And we will stand before the King and God again within ten days. Nothing breaks that.
Wide establishing shot of the rain-drenched cobblestone courtyard surrounded by imposing Gothic arches.
Medium shot of Lady Ashbourne leaning heavily on her walking cane, glaring down at Catherine who kneels in the mud.

units.speaker: LADY ASHBOURNE
units.text: You dare show your face in Ashbourne courtyard?
High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in her disheveled burgundy gown, clutching her skirts and weeping profusely.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I have nowhere to go, Your Grace.
Low-angle shot tracking Catherine clutching her chest in agony.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: London closed its doors! My family disowned me!
Medium close-up of Lady Ashbourne, her gloved hand resting on her cane as she delivers her cold judgment.

units.speaker: LADY ASHBOURNE
units.text: She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road.
Medium shot of Vaughn drawing his baton, ready to seize Catherine from behind.

units.speaker: VAUGHN
units.text: One command, Your Grace, and I drag her past the gates.
Wide shot as Alexander strides purposefully into the courtyard alongside Juliana, his coat billowing behind him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!
Close-up of Catherine collapsed on the wet stones, looking up with tear-streaked panic.

Juliana rinses the heavy mud from her hands in a cold rainwater puddle and rises to her feet, holding her head high.

units.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
units.text: This is where you live now?
Medium shot of Gerald standing beside Aristocratic Woman, sneering disdainfully.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: A fitting home for a woman who threw away everything for a penniless soldier.
Medium close-up of Juliana, defiant and unflinching despite her soiled dress and damp hair.

units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Close-up of Alexander turning toward her, his scarred face stoic and intense.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: For what?
Close-up of Juliana looking up at him with deep emotional vulnerability, her eyes shimmering with tears.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: For standing between me and those men.
Close-up of Alexander, his piercing blue-grey eyes fixed upon her with absolute conviction.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I would do it again.
Close-up of Juliana, her lips parting as her voice wavers with emotion.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Even if there were ten of them?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: As long as I draw breath...
Tracking shot following Alexander as he strides across the muddy garden and approaches Juliana.
Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, gently taking her trembling, bandaged hands into his large, weathered palms.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: ...no one will hurt you again.
Close-up on Juliana's tear-filled face, overwhelmed by his fierce devotion.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You cannot promise that.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's intense, protective gaze locking onto hers.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: I just did.
Close-up of their joined hands, his rugged, scarred fingers wrapping securely around her bandaged fingers.
Alexander squeezes Juliana's hands reassuringly as she rests her fingertips against his skin. The scene fades to black.
Medium shot in the warm, flickering firelight of the stone cottage. Juliana kneels on the stone floor beside a washbasin of water while Alexander sits quietly in a chair beside the blazing hearth.

units.text: Close-up on Juliana's face, teeth clenched in desperate defiance.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: I have every right to stand here.
Tight close-up of the Noble Matriarch leaning in with vicious delight.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: Not anymore.
Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch gesturing expansively to the filled cathedral nave behind her.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: Your father has chosen his family...
Close-up profile of the Noble Matriarch's piercing eyes glaring directly at Juliana.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: ...and it isn't you.
The Noble Matriarch turns sharply toward the back of the chapel and barks an order.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: Guards! Remove her!
Medium shot as two royal guards in red uniforms and bearskin caps step in behind Juliana and seize her arms.
The guards forcefully grab Juliana by both shoulders and drag her backwards.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Let me go!
Close-up of Juliana's hand frantically grabbing the wooden rim of a pew, knuckles white with strain.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Please! Someone!
The guards tear her grip away from the pew.
Muffled scuffle, rustle of heavy silk and frantic gasps echoing off cathedral stone.
High wide shot down the vaulted cathedral aisle showing the entire congregation watching in stunned silence as the guards drag Juliana.
Wide eye-level shot looking down the petal-strewn marble aisle. A tall, rugged man in a worn dark trench coat—The Bearded Stranger—emerges into the center of the nave.
The Bearded Stranger steps deliberately into the aisle, his heavy boots echoing.
Close-up on the Noble Matriarch freezing in utter shock and outrage.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: Take your hands off her.
Medium tracking shot front-on as The Bearded Stranger marches down the flower-strewn aisle with resolute purpose.
Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch stepping forward on the altar steps, furiously pointing a finger at him.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!
High wide shot of the magnificent vaulted hall as The Bearded Stranger walks steadily forward, dwarfing the aisle.
Medium shot on the lead royal guard squaring his shoulders, barring the stranger's advance while Juliana stands behind him.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I think I like that.
Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, slightly surprised by her reaction.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: You are not disappointed?
Medium close-up of Juliana meeting his gaze honestly.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I am.
Over-the-shoulder shot behind Juliana as the Mysterious Bearded Man listens intently.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: But not because of you.
Medium shot as Juliana grabs a rag from the rustic wooden table and begins briskly scrubbing the damp surface.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: If this is our home, I want it clean.
Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man stepping forward to intervene gently.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: You don't have to do that tonight.
Close-up on Juliana's hands vigorously scrubbing grime from the wooden tabletop.
Close-up of Juliana's face, her voice catching with raw, suppressed emotion as she scrubs.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: There.

units.text: It is not much.
Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the stone floor before the blazing hearth, wrapping her dark cloak around her shoulders.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It is enough for tonight.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Gerald? What are you doing here?
Wide two-shot across the puddle-strewn ground between Gerald and Juliana against the misty landscape.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: I came for something that belongs to me.
Close-up of Clarissa peering from the carriage window in her violet silk gown, a venomous, triumphant smile curling her lips.
Close-up of Juliana, her anger flaring as she gestures sharply.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You have already taken enough from me. Leave!
Medium close-up of Gerald pointing an accusatory finger, his composure snapping into hostile anger.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!
Close-up of Juliana recoiling in utter disbelief.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: What? When?
Close-up of Gerald narrowing his eyes vindictively.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: The last time I came here.

units.text: We have lost everything.

units.text: Close-up on Father Thomas listening impassively.
Medium wide two-shot across the candlelit table, Catherine leaning slightly forward.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Today went better than either of us planned for. The whole court watched you humiliate her.
Medium close-up on Father Thomas as he turns his head slightly, scanning the dusty shadowed recesses of the abandoned room.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: Fitting choice, this room. A place the family forgot for a conversation they mustn't remember.
Close-up on Catherine, her lips curling into an amused, knowing smile.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You always did have a taste for symbolism.
Medium shot of Father Thomas, a subtle smirk breaking through his austere demeanor.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: And you always did have a taste for using me. It's why we suit each other.
Close-up on Catherine, her expression turning razor-sharp and commanding.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Then make certain the council remembers that for the full ten days, not just the first hour.
Side profile close-up on Father Thomas, his brow furrowing with impatient resolve.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: What is it you actually need from me, Catherine? Say it plainly, for once.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: First, the hearing stays unresolved as long as possible. Every extension, every delay, every excuse to reconvene.
Frontal close-up of Catherine raising two fingers in the candlelight, her eyes burning with ruthless intent.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Second, I want to know what the council knows before it decides anything. Every argument, every witness, every whisper against her.
Close-up on Father Thomas absorbing the audacity of her demand.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: You want eyes inside the council chamber itself?
Close-up low angle on Catherine, tilting her chin up in defiant pride.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I want eyes and ears everywhere that decides my future.
Full two-shot of Catherine and Father Thomas facing off across the small table in the cavernous hallway.
Father Thomas clasps his hands behind his back, turning slightly away to ponder the gravity of her words.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Is that so unreasonable coming from a woman the church itself just humiliated back into relevance?

units.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
units.text: Juliana's ruin will be a lesson. And we will be there to watch.

Rhythmic water drips splashing onto stagnant dungeon puddles and a low, mournful ambient drone.

units.speaker: JULIANA

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: They cannot take who I am!

units.text: Do you think she'll actually be executed?

units.speaker: LADY CLARISSA

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Fear.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You have been so proud of that brave little face...

units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.speaker: CATHERINE

Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Burn it.
Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.
Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: What?
Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Burn the ledger. Burn every page.
Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You may destroy the book...
Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: ...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me.
Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You think a few herbs make you better than me?
Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No. Your cruelty does that for me.
High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.
Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You still think you are better?!
Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I know what I am.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: A disgraced woman?

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me.
Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You are lying!
Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable.
Medium profile on Juliana looking up at Gerald, holding the entire hall spellbound.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: You have shown them exactly what your word is worth.

units.text: Close-up profile of Catherine, turning with a slight, knowing smirk.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Good. That's what I pay her for.
Medium two-shot as Catherine steps forward and sets the heavy candleholder onto a small round table draped in grey cloth between them.
Catherine sets down the brass candleholder, the flame flickering across their faces.
Tight close-up on Father Thomas's face, the candlelight dancing in his calculating eyes.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: No shadows tonight, Catherine. Just us and an empty wing.
Close-up on Catherine, her blonde ringlets peeking from beneath her velvet hood as she smiles faintly.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You didn't need them the first time, either. I just prefer my secrets thorough.
Medium close-up of Father Thomas, glancing down momentarily before fixing his piercing gaze back on her.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: A priest and a disgraced bride meeting before dawn in her bedchamber. I'd say thoroughness served us both rather well.
Close-up of Catherine's face hardening into a stern, focused expression.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: It will keep serving us as long as neither of us gets careless. No one in this house so much as suspects your face belongs to that morning. Let's keep it that way.
Close-up on Father Thomas listening impassively.
Medium wide two-shot across the candlelit table, Catherine leaning slightly forward.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Today went better than either of us planned for. The whole court watched you humiliate her.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?
Medium two-shot tracking closer as Catherine steps closer toward him.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Then make certain he doesn't find out. You're careful. I've seen how careful.
Tight close-up on Father Thomas's intense, brooding face.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Careful men who help me also get remembered.
Split focus close-up between Father Thomas's intense gaze and Catherine leaning in close, whispering with lethal conviction.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: A grateful Duchess collects debts differently than a desperate one.

units.text: Some of the pages are ruined. Careful.

Medium close-up of Juliana tenderly opening the cover and turning the brittle parchment pages.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Mother spent years writing this.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Yarrow.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Good for wounds. Fever, too.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: How do you know that?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Soldiers learn quickly which plants keep a man alive.

units.text: Juliana curls her fingers back, pulling away from the foul sustenance in defiance.
Tight close-up of Juliana's dirty, tear-stained face. Her eyes squeeze shut as tears stream down her cheeks from overwhelming physical agony and hunger.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: They think hunger will make me surrender.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's blue eyes snapping open, blazing with unyielding defiance.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: They think fear will make me beg.
Full shot of Juliana using her bare hands against the slimy stone floor to drag herself upright to her knees, chains rattling loudly.
The harsh scrape and clatter of heavy iron chains dragging across wet stone.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I will not!
Low-angle shot looking up at Juliana as she thrusts her chin high toward the iron ceiling grate, bathed in cold shafts of light.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: They can take my name. They can take my home.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: They cannot take who I am!

units.text: Close-up two-shot as Alexander tenderly cradles Juliana's cheek in his gloved hand.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You chose me when you believed I was nobody.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I chose you because you were kind.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You chose me when I had nothing.
Medium shot framed between them as Alexander holds her face with both hands, the crowd watching in stunned silence.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I chose you because you had honor.
Tight close-up on Alexander looking deep into Juliana's blue eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And I chose you because you saw the man before the title.

Alexander and Juliana close their eyes, breathing together with their foreheads pressed gently against one another.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I loved you before I ever knew who you were.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: And I loved you before I ever dared to tell you.
Medium shot as Alexander turns back toward the altar, where Catherine stands in her disheveled wedding gown.
Catherine takes a desperate step forward, clutching her skirts and weeping.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Alexander...
Medium shot as Alexander steps right up to Catherine, towering over her with righteous fury.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife.

units.text: Close-up of Catherine lowering her teacup, her icy blue eyes narrowing in calculated concern.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Her shadow still hangs over this house.
Tight close-up of Rupert's face as a sinister grin spreads across his features.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: They call it a wasting of the lungs.
Close-up side profile of Catherine bringing the teacup to her lips, savoring his words with chilling detachment.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: How tragic. The slow, quiet decline.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: How much longer can the frail thing survive?
Medium profile of Rupert looking out the window, hands clasped behind him.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort.
Close-up of Catherine turning her head toward the window, her lips curled in venomous disgust.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Good. The village is already whispering about her.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: They disgust me.
Medium two-shot. Rupert stands over Catherine seated at the polished table, placing a gloved hand possessively near her shoulder.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots.

units.text: Medium tracking shot front-on as The Bearded Stranger marches down the flower-strewn aisle with resolute purpose.
Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch stepping forward on the altar steps, furiously pointing a finger at him.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!
High wide shot of the magnificent vaulted hall as The Bearded Stranger walks steadily forward, dwarfing the aisle.
Medium shot on the lead royal guard squaring his shoulders, barring the stranger's advance while Juliana stands behind him.

units.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
units.text: Stand aside, stranger!
Medium close-up profile on The Bearded Stranger, eyes burning with quiet, lethal resolve.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: I said...
Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's intense, scarred face.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: ...let her go.
Medium action shot as the guard charges toward The Bearded Stranger.
The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed guard instantly to the floor.
A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.
Medium close-up of Gerald turning frantically to the remaining guards and congregation, panicking.

units.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
units.text: What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!
Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger standing unmoved over the fallen guard, turning his gaze toward Juliana.
Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger stepping up to Lady Juliana, who gazes up at him in stunned breathlessness.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: Are you hurt?
Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes her head gently, overwhelmed with wonder.
Juliana softly shakes her head 'no', her wide blue eyes locked onto him.
Close-up profile of The Bearded Stranger casting a sharp, menacing glance toward the other guard.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: Good. Then don't touch her again.
Medium close-up on the Noble Matriarch shrieking in exasperation from the altar steps.

units.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
units.text: You cannot interfere in a family matter!
Close-up of Juliana's elderly father looking down, gripping his hands nervously with profound guilt.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: I can...
Medium shot of guests in the pews whispering and reacting in hushed shock.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: ...when your family is dragging a defenseless woman from a church.
Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger and Lady Juliana framed against the illuminated stained-glass rose window.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: You shouldn't have to beg anybody...
Close-up on Juliana looking up into his eyes, moved to the core.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: ...to remember your worth.
Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's rugged, bearded face looking down at her with tender reverence.
Close-up on Juliana, her lips parting in quiet astonishment.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Why are you doing this?
Close-up on The Bearded Stranger, completely unfazed.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: Because I want to.
Close-up on Juliana's father wringing his gold ring, eyes heavy with regret.
Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger slipping his hand into his coat pocket.
Close-up of Juliana watching him with rapt, trembling anticipation.
Extreme close-up of The Bearded Stranger's rugged fingers holding up a simple, polished silver band.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: You came here to become a wife.
Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger extending the ring toward Juliana.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: They took that from you.
Over-the-shoulder medium shot past The Bearded Stranger onto Gerald standing petrified and humiliated in the aisle.
Medium close-up on The Bearded Stranger presenting the ring directly to Juliana.

units.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
units.text: I am offering it back.
Close-up on Juliana glancing down at the ring, breathless and overwhelmed.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: You leave as no daughter of mine.
Low-angle shot tracking Lord Ashcroft's polished black boots as he slowly descends the stone steps toward them.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: Your dowry is revoked.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: Your inheritance is revoked.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes wide with shock and heartbreak as she holds the ledger close against her chest.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: From this moment, you are dead to the Ashcroft family.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You truly mean it? You are my father!
Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, observing Lord Ashcroft with an unblinking, quietly threatening stare.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: And you have chosen to become a stranger.
Profile medium two-shot of Juliana and Lord Ashcroft standing face-to-face against the backdrop of the towering gothic facade.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No, Father. You chose that long before today.
Medium close-up of Lady Ashcroft, resplendent in navy velvet and jewels, stepping forward with a smirk of malicious authority.

units.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
units.text: Enough sentiment.

units.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
units.text: And the ledger...
Medium shot as Lady Ashcroft approaches Juliana menacingly.

units.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
units.text: ...that belongs to this family.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It belonged to my mother! It is all I have left of her.
Close-up of Lady Ashcroft laying a jeweled hand firmly on the bound book.

units.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
units.text: Then you should have guarded it better.
Close-up on the ledger as Lady Ashcroft violently wrenches it out of Juliana's grip.
Lady Ashcroft snatches the heavy book away and flings it disdainfully into the rain-soaked courtyard.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Barbara, don't!
A heavy wet slap as the leather-bound book crashes into the puddle-slicked stone pavement.
Medium shot of Clarissa and Gerald standing together on the cathedral steps. Clarissa clasps a gloved hand to her mouth in mock shock before bursting into gleeful laughter.

units.speaker: CLARISSA
units.text: Even your mother's precious legacy has been cast into the dirt!

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: Perhaps that is where it belongs.
Close-up of Juliana looking down at the ground, tears streaming down her pale cheeks.

units.text: They walk forward toward the cottage emerging from the dark woods.
Medium close-up on Juliana's face, wide-eyed with realization.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: That is it?
Medium close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: Yes.
Upward shot of rain pelting through the thick treetops.
Sudden distant rumble of thunder echoing across the forest.
Medium shot as Juliana hikes her skirt and begins walking briskly toward the cottage door.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: At least no one there will be waiting to humiliate me.
Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man watching her march ahead, his expression solemn and deeply reflective.
The heavy wooden cottage door creaks open. Juliana steps across the threshold into the dark, barren room.
Juliana picks up a straw broom and sweeps the stone floor in front of the stone hearth.
Wide shot of Juliana sweeping dust toward the large stone fireplace.
The Mysterious Bearded Man carries a heavy wooden log across the room and places it onto the iron grate in the hearth.
Tracking shot following the Mysterious Bearded Man as he sets the firewood into the stone fireplace.
He strikes flint and steel together over dry kindling, igniting bright sparks that catch into a flickering flame.
Extreme close-up on hands striking flint, sparks showering onto the twigs and catching fire.
Medium close-up of vibrant orange flames rapidly spreading across the dry logs, crackling warmly.
Crisp crackling and snapping of dry wood catching fire in the hearth.
Medium shot of Juliana standing by the table, broom resting against her hip, bathed in the amber firelight.
The Mysterious Bearded Man stands up from the hearth, dusting his hands on his coat.
Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising before the blazing fireplace.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: There.
Close-up of Juliana looking at him with radiant gratitude and a gentle smile.
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gesturing faintly to the modest room.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: It is not much.
Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the stone floor before the blazing hearth, wrapping her dark cloak around her shoulders.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It is enough for tonight.
Wide shot framing the roaring hearth fire between them as the Mysterious Bearded Man crouches down beside her on the stone floor.
Close-up of Juliana pulling her cloak tighter, her face glowing warmly in the firelight.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I lost my home today.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: My family.
Close-up of the glowing embers and dancing flames inside the fireplace.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Everything I thought my life would be.
Close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred, work-worn hands resting quietly on his knees.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking down into the flames, a peaceful serenity washing over her features.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: And yet...

Medium shot of Catherine standing beside the altar, watching Juliana's entrance with gloating satisfaction.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: There she is.
Medium tracking shot of Juliana marching between the stern constables down the central aisle toward the altar.
Medium shot of a seated aristocratic couple in the pews, whispering and sneering behind an ivory lace fan.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Look at her.

units.speaker: NOBLEMAN
units.text: She actually came back to the chapel.
Close-up of the noblewoman giggling with hand over mouth, glancing spitefully at the disgraced bride.

units.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
units.text: Not as a bride this time.
Medium shot of two senior aristocrats in the carved choir stalls, resting on their canes and nodding in smug agreement.
Close profile of Juliana as she halts in the center aisle, lifting her chin proudly to face the sneering onlookers.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around.
High-angle wide shot showing Juliana flanked by guards in the center of the lavishly decorated nave, dwarfed by the grand cathedral.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: This is the world you thought you belonged to.
Low-angle medium shot of Catherine gesturing broadly from the altar steps, looking down upon Juliana like an empress.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And now they can all see what you truly are.

units.text: Medium close-up of Father Thomas, glancing down momentarily before fixing his piercing gaze back on her.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: A priest and a disgraced bride meeting before dawn in her bedchamber. I'd say thoroughness served us both rather well.
Close-up of Catherine's face hardening into a stern, focused expression.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: It will keep serving us as long as neither of us gets careless. No one in this house so much as suspects your face belongs to that morning. Let's keep it that way.
Close-up on Father Thomas listening impassively.
Medium wide two-shot across the candlelit table, Catherine leaning slightly forward.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Today went better than either of us planned for. The whole court watched you humiliate her.
Medium close-up on Father Thomas as he turns his head slightly, scanning the dusty shadowed recesses of the abandoned room.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: Fitting choice, this room. A place the family forgot for a conversation they mustn't remember.
Close-up on Catherine, her lips curling into an amused, knowing smile.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You always did have a taste for symbolism.
Medium shot of Father Thomas, a subtle smirk breaking through his austere demeanor.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: And you always did have a taste for using me. It's why we suit each other.
Close-up on Catherine, her expression turning razor-sharp and commanding.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Then make certain the council remembers that for the full ten days, not just the first hour.
Side profile close-up on Father Thomas, his brow furrowing with impatient resolve.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: What is it you actually need from me, Catherine? Say it plainly, for once.

units.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
units.text: You are disowned!
Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft bowing his head deeply over his cane in shame.
Close-up of Juliana. Tears brim in her eyes at the formal rejection, but she does not break.
Medium two-shot as the Mysterious Bearded Man turns gently to Juliana, reaching his hand out once more.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: Come, Lady Juliana.
Close-up of Juliana placing her hand securely into his, gripping his scarred hand.
Wide tracking shot behind Juliana and the warrior as they begin walking down the central aisle toward the chapel doors.
Medium three-shot of Gerald, Clarissa, and Lady Ashcroft watching in stunned silence and disbelief.
Clarissa gapes in shock while Lady Ashcroft exhales in exasperation.
Wide shot from the back of the chapel as the massive oak doors swing wide open, revealing bright daylight and the courtyard outside.
Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walk hand-in-hand through the towering doors into the sunlight together, turning their backs on the ruined wedding as the screen fades out.

Heavy oak doors creaking open, followed by a triumphant musical swell fading out into silence.

--- SCRIPT END ---
Close-up on Lady Juliana's hands clutching an ancient, brass-bound leather ledger against the skirt of her white wedding gown as she walks.
Juliana grips the heirloom ledger tightly against her waist, her posture resolute despite the tension.
Wide shot tracking Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man descending the grand stone steps of the cathedral courtyard. Behind them, Lord Ashcroft emerges from the vaulted doorway leaning on his cane.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: Miss Ashcroft.
Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man pause on the stone steps, turning slightly back toward Lord Ashcroft.
Close-up of Lord Ashcroft, his weathered face rigid with aristocratic pride and disgust.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: You will not leave this church carrying the Ashcroft name.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at her father. Her hand rises to touch the amethyst heirloom pendant resting at her throat.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: The vows are spoken, Father. I am his wife now.
Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft standing rigid outside the chapel archway, unforgiving and unyielding.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: Then leave as his wife.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: You leave as no daughter of mine.
Low-angle shot tracking Lord Ashcroft's polished black boots as he slowly descends the stone steps toward them.

units.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
units.text: Your dowry is revoked.

units.text: Tracking shot as Alexander lunges forward without hesitation, rushing past the Constable straight to Juliana.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana.
Close-up on Alexander's rugged hands tenderly grasping Juliana's bloodied, lacerated hands, turning them over with immense care.
Alexander gently turns her palms up, his thumbs trembling as he inspects the deep, bleeding gashes gouged into her skin.
Close-up on Alexander's agonized, furious expression as he stares at her wounds.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: What have they done to you?
Close-up on Juliana's pale, tear-streaked face looking back into his eyes with tender relief.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Nothing they didn't promise.
Medium profile two-shot of Alexander and Juliana gazing into each other's eyes amidst the cold mist.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Take me home.

Alexander lifts Juliana bridal-style, wrapping his strong arms protectively around her as she rests against his shoulder.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: You should never have had to bleed for me.
