units.text: What happened?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Fire.
Over-the-shoulder shot past Alexander toward the blazing threshold of the main room, beams collapsing across the doorway.
Medium close-up of Alexander wrapping a heavy coat tightly around Juliana's shoulders.
Alexander clutches Juliana against his chest with one strong arm, shielding her face from the sparks.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Stay close to me.
Reverse shot from behind them facing the burning door frame as wall-high flames roar, completely sealing their exit.
Juliana recoils from the heat, clutching Alexander's coat tightly.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: We cannot get through!

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Then we go another way.
Tracking shot as Alexander turns, grabbing Juliana's hand, and pulls her quickly through the burning corridors.
Loud wooden groaning and thunderous crash of burning rafters falling behind them.
Medium tracking shot focusing on Juliana's wide, soot-streaked eyes as they navigate through falling embers.
Close-up of the antique, leather-bound herbal ledger resting on a burning wooden table, the edges of its pages beginning to curl and singe in the heat.
Juliana spots the book and halts abruptly, pointing back toward the burning desk.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: The ledger!
Alexander firmly grips her arm, pulling her back toward safety.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Leave it!

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No! No!
Low-angle shot pointing up at the ceiling beams overhead, engulfed in roaring fire and splitting down the center.
Alexander points upward with urgency, pulling her under his arm.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana, the ceiling is coming down!
Juliana wrests her hand from his grasp and charges straight toward the burning desk.
Wide shot of the room as a massive burning crossbeam collapses into the floorboards with a fiery explosion.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Juliana!

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It's my mother's!
Juliana snatches the scorched leather ledger from the burning table, pulling it tightly against her chest with both bandaged hands.
Close-up of the ceiling rafter splitting violently apart above her.
Close-up of Juliana looking up in sheer terror, firelight dancing across her tearful face.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander!

units.text: Wide tracking shot down a dark, derelict hallway lined with dust-sheet draped furniture and peeling wallpaper. At the far end, a door creaks open, revealing a cloaked figure stepping in.
Hinges creaking softly followed by the muffled thud of a heavy wooden door clicking shut.
Father Thomas, clad in a hooded dark mantle over priestly black robes, secures the door behind him and steps into the shadows of the abandoned corridor.
Medium shot on Catherine, draped in a dark hooded cloak over a lavish crimson bodice, holding a brass candlestick aloft.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You took your time.
Over-the-shoulder shot past Father Thomas's cloaked back looking toward Catherine illuminated in warm candlelight.
Medium close-up of Father Thomas under his black hood, his stern face framed by the clerical collar and silver crucifix resting on his chest.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: Agnes is thorough. She made me wait for a groom to finish his rounds before she'd let me past the stables.
Close-up profile of Catherine, turning with a slight, knowing smirk.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Good. That's what I pay her for.
Medium two-shot as Catherine steps forward and sets the heavy candleholder onto a small round table draped in grey cloth between them.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened.
Close-up of Prudence weeping, clutching her hands to her chest in agony.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!
Close-up of Lady Juliana, her brow furrowing with concern.

units.speaker: LADY JULIANA
units.text: Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?
Close-up of Prudence, her face twisted in bitter anguish as she gestures back toward the rain-soaked outdoors.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!
Wide shot of Lady Juliana and Prudence facing each other inside the wooden barn, dust motes drifting in the pale light.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!
Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.

units.text: Ten days for a decree to be undone.
Slight push-in on Catherine as she clenches her fist against her chest, her eyes blazing with malice.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And doors can be closed from the other side.
Medium shot over Catherine's shoulder seated before her vanity mirror as the chamber door eases open and Agnes enters quietly.
Agnes, dressed in a grey maid's dress and white apron, steps inside with cautious hesitation and clasps her hands.

units.speaker: AGNES
units.text: You sent for me, my lady?

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Lock it.
Close-up on Agnes's hands turning the ornate iron key in the wooden door's brass lock.
Heavy metallic click of an iron key latching into a deadbolt.
Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.
Two-shot profile of Catherine towering over Agnes in the candlelight.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Good. Let them remember it.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now.
Over-the-shoulder close-up on Agnes, her brow furrowed in anxious alarm.

units.speaker: AGNES
units.text: My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county.
Close-up on Catherine, a smug, venomous smile spreading across her painted lips.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house.
Medium tracking shot following Catherine as she releases Agnes and stalks across the room toward the window sill.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Father Thomas did his part beautifully today.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes.
Medium close-up of Agnes glancing nervously over her shoulder.

units.speaker: AGNES
units.text: If someone sees him come to you...
Close-up on Catherine spinning around from the window, her jaw set in terrifying firmness.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Then no one sees him.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: That is precisely your job tonight.
Medium shot as Catherine picks up a heavy velvet coin purse and places it firmly into Agnes's awaiting open palms.
Dull clinking of heavy gold coins inside a leather pouch.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Send for the priest. Tonight.

units.speaker: BALD THUG

units.speaker: JULIANA

units.speaker: JULIANA

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: This was our home.
Close-up of the blackened, heat-damaged leather ledger held in Juliana's linen-bandaged hands.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: My mother's book almost burned with it.
Juliana tenderly lifts a scorched corner of parchment, revealing the surviving botanical drawing of medicinal herbs inside.
Medium shot of Alexander looking down at Juliana with quiet, stoic concern.
Medium shot of three villagers approaching through the burnt clearing: an elder villager carrying folded wool blankets, followed by a man and woman holding loaves of baked bread.

units.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
units.text: My lady. You cannot stay here.
Close-up of Juliana's tearful, soot-stained face as she listens.

units.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
units.text: There is an old barn near the village. It is empty.
The elder villager steps closer, resting a gentle, reassuring hand on Juliana's shoulder.

units.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
units.text: Take it.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: We cannot ask the village to feed us.

units.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
units.text: You saved my son's life.
Close-up of the elder villager's rough, weathered hands offering a fresh loaf of artisan bread wrapped in cloth against the smoking timber ruins.

units.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
units.text: You saved mine, too.
Close-up of Juliana, tears spilling down her cheeks as she smiles through her grief.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Thank you.
Alexander steps forward and accepts the thick folded blankets and a wooden bucket from the villager.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: We will not forget this kindness.

units.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
units.text: Neither will the village.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking back one last time at the devastated doorway of her ruined sanctuary, hugging the ledger tightly.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Goodbye, Blackwood.
Juliana turns her back on the ruins. Wide tracking shot from behind as Alexander and Juliana walk side by side down the stone path, leaving the smoldering ash behind as the scene fades into black.
Medium shot tracking Alexander from behind as he stands waiting beside a moss-covered ancient tree trunk in the dense, fog-laden forest.
A bald, scarred man dressed in a dark coat emerges from between the trees, immediately coming to a halt and bowing with clasped hands in formal deference.

units.speaker: INFORMANT
units.text: Your Grace.
Medium close-up of Alexander turning toward his operative, his eyes dark with calculating authority.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Tell me what is happening in Ashburg.

units.text: Medium close-up tilting down on JULIANA kneeling in the straw beside a rustic wooden crate, sorting sprigs of dried lavender and sage into a woven basket. Her hands are bound in linen bandages from the recent fire.
The barn door opens, revealing daylight outside. SEAMUS, an older weathered villager in a waistcoat, carries a wooden bucket inside, his expression etched with deep sorrow and concern.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Let me take that basket, Lady Juliana.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft.
Seamus reaches down to take the handle of the basket from her.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at Seamus, her smudged face fierce with unyielding determination as she holds firmly onto the basket.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I do not yield to a cold draft.
Close-up of Seamus, his face agonizingly strained with grief for her lost status.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: You are a viscount's daughter!

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Sleeping on straw, sorting weeds!

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Let the village tend to itself for once!
Medium close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unwavering moral strength.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: The chapel is gone, Seamus. I am the only healer these people have left.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I keep the basket.
Medium two-shot of Juliana and Seamus standing facing each other in the barn, the lantern casting a warm amber glow between them.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: They have reduced you to a peasant.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: They have reduced me to myself.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: And I am not finished.

Sharp porcelain chime of teacup meeting saucer.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Let the peasants rot in their barns.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Let them pray to their weeds.

units.speaker: PRUDENCE
units.text: This is Ashburton Manor. The housekeeper watches everyone. Lady Catherine watches everyone, and Lord Rupert...

units.text: Prudence.

units.text: Who is this?

units.text: This is not simply old age.

units.speaker: LORD

units.speaker: LORD

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: I never said she was a witch!

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: You do not need to.

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: I have already written the story for you.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: She saved my brother...

units.speaker: LORD
units.text: And now... you will save your brother.

units.speaker: MAID
units.text: I am sorry, Lady Juliana...

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: A noblewoman reduced to a beggar's wife!

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: Choose your next words carefully.

units.text: You saved mine, too.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Thank you.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: The proof is in his coat, Juliana. A valuable pocket watch doesn't just walk into a beggar's pocket.

Juliana lifts the hem of her white satin wedding gown to keep it out of the pooling mud, shivering under her dark hooded cloak.
Close-up on Juliana's wet hand clutching her muddy dress.
Heavy rain pouring through dense tree canopies with steady footfalls on wet earth.
Upward shot through the dripping, silhouetted branches into the stormy night sky.
Medium two-shot framing Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man as they pause in the misty woods.
Juliana turns back toward him, water glistening on her face and hair.
Close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man, his dark hair soaked and rain running down the scars on his cheek.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: I know this is not the life you came from.
Close-up on Juliana looking up into the rain, exhaling a soft breath of resignation.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No.
Juliana looks upward into the canopy, gathering herself with a faint nod.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It isn't.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I suppose the day was already ruined.
Extreme close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's piercing eyes, touched by her lack of bitterness.
Wide establishing shot through tree branches showing a secluded, rustic stone cottage nestled among the misty trees.
They walk forward toward the cottage emerging from the dark woods.
Medium close-up on Juliana's face, wide-eyed with realization.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: That is it?
Medium close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: Yes.
Upward shot of rain pelting through the thick treetops.
Sudden distant rumble of thunder echoing across the forest.
Medium shot as Juliana hikes her skirt and begins walking briskly toward the cottage door.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: At least no one there will be waiting to humiliate me.

The heavy wooden cottage door creaks open. Juliana steps across the threshold into the dark, barren room.
Door hinges groaning open followed by the hollow thump of footsteps on wet wood floorboards.
Close-up overhead shot of a wooden bucket catching raindrops dripping steadily from a leak in the ceiling.
Rhythmic water drips plinking into the metal-rimmed wooden bucket.

Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man standing in the dim light by the door.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: I am sorry.
Medium shot of Juliana gazing around the rustic interior, taking in the sparse surroundings.
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man looking at her with somber honesty.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Sitting here with him, I don't feel afraid.

units.speaker: JULIANA

units.speaker: ALEXANDER

units.text: Gerald steps down from the carriage behind her, looking immaculate in a high-collared navy frock coat, white waistcoat, and dark cravat.
Aristocratic Woman smirks cruelly as she surveys the humble stone cottage.
Juliana rinses the heavy mud from her hands in a cold rainwater puddle and rises to her feet, holding her head high.

units.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
units.text: This is where you live now?
Medium shot of Gerald standing beside Aristocratic Woman, sneering disdainfully.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: A fitting home for a woman who threw away everything for a penniless soldier.
Medium close-up of Juliana, defiant and unflinching despite her soiled dress and damp hair.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You came all this way just to insult my home?
Close-up of Aristocratic Woman erupting into high-pitched, malicious laughter beneath her parasol.

units.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
units.text: Home? Look at your hands, Juliana.
Close-up of Juliana's mud-stained palms held open against her apron.

units.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
units.text: You look like a servant.
Close-up of Gerald's smug expression watching Juliana.
Medium close-up of Juliana lifting her chin with unwavering dignity.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I work with my hands. There is no shame in that.
Close-up on Gerald's tightening jaw.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: You were born a lady.
Close-up on Juliana's clear blue eyes, shining with unbroken pride.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: And I remain one.
Wide shot framing Juliana facing off against Gerald and Aristocratic Woman in the bleak courtyard.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: You chose that scarred beggar over a life of comfort.
Two-shot profile of Juliana looking straight into Gerald's eyes without flinching.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I chose a man who stood beside me when you walked away.
Intense close-up of Juliana dismissing him with utter contempt.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You have no authority here. Leave.
Close-up of Gerald lunging forward, aggressively pointing his finger into Juliana's face.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: And your husband?
Wide shot down a dark, fog-drenched forest path. A towering, shadowed figure walks steadily forward through the mist.

units.speaker: GERALD

The Scarred Bearded Man marches purposefully toward the cottage, carrying a heavy bundle of chopped firewood bound tightly with hemp cord.
Medium tracking shot pushing in on the Scarred Bearded Man's stern, rugged face as he approaches the gate.
Low shot of the Scarred Bearded Man bending down and dropping the bundle of logs by the stone wall.
A dull, heavy thud of timber striking the mud.
Medium full shot as the Scarred Bearded Man straightens to his full imposing height and steps directly toward Gerald.
Two-shot framing the Scarred Bearded Man towering menacingly over Gerald, staring down at him with unyielding intensity.
Gerald freezes, his arrogant bravado instantly vanishing as cold dread overtakes his face.
Low-angle close-up of Gerald looking up in sheer terror, his adam's apple bobbing nervously.

units.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
units.text: Gerald, don't let him frighten you.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: What are you staring at?
Gerald rapidly turns on his heel toward the carriage, unwilling to face another second of the silent glare.

units.speaker: GERALD
units.text: We are leaving.
Medium shot of Aristocratic Woman, shocked and indignant as Gerald flees past her.

units.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
units.text: Leaving? Gerald!
Aristocratic Woman scrambles back into the carriage, hiking up her gown in a fluster before slamming the door shut.
Carriage door slamming shut.
Wide shot of the carriage rapidly jolting forward and disappearing down the misty road away from the cottage.

units.text: Medium profile shot of Juliana sitting at a wooden table beside the glowing fireplace, reading an old herbal medicine book.
Juliana quietly studies the botanical illustrations by firelight, a bundle of fresh dried herbs resting on the table.
A heavy wooden door suddenly creaks and bangs open in the quiet cottage.
Juliana jerks her head up from the book, startled by the sudden intrusion.
Medium wide shot framing the doorway as Alexander stands framed in the dark threshold, panting heavily, his hand pressed against his blood-soaked chest.
Medium close-up of Juliana rising swiftly from her chair, shock and terror flashing across her face.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Alexander!
Close-up of Alexander struggling to breathe, clutching his bloodied coat over his chest.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: It is nothing.
Medium shot of Juliana hurriedly stepping toward him across the stone floor.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: There is blood running down your arm.
Medium profile two-shot as Alexander stands rigid while Juliana confronts him.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: A cut from the tenant fields.
Wide shot of the hearth room as Juliana firmly points toward a wooden armchair beside the fire.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Sit down.
Close-up of Juliana's determined, unyielding expression.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Now.
Medium shot of Alexander reluctantly lowering his heavy frame onto the chair in front of the fire.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: We cannot ask the village to feed us.

units.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
units.text: You saved my son's life.
Close-up of the elder villager's rough, weathered hands offering a fresh loaf of artisan bread wrapped in cloth against the smoking timber ruins.

units.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
units.text: You saved mine, too.
Close-up of Juliana, tears spilling down her cheeks as she smiles through her grief.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Thank you.
Alexander steps forward and accepts the thick folded blankets and a wooden bucket from the villager.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: We will not forget this kindness.

units.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
units.text: Neither will the village.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking back one last time at the devastated doorway of her ruined sanctuary, hugging the ledger tightly.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Goodbye, Blackwood.
Juliana turns her back on the ruins. Wide tracking shot from behind as Alexander and Juliana walk side by side down the stone path, leaving the smoldering ash behind as the scene fades into black.

units.text: Medium shot tracking slightly as Catherine stands beside a tall mullioned stone window, silhouetted against the moonlight over the distant castle spires.
Catherine, adorned in an ornate dark burgundy gown with braided golden hair, gazes out the dark window before turning slowly with a cold, venomous smirk.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter where it belongs.
Close-up on Catherine's profile and jewelry as she speaks with calculating contempt.
Catherine glides across the chamber past a roaring stone hearth, picking up an orange from a silver platter on the table.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Ten days. He gave himself ten days to fix it.
Medium close-up frontal shot of Catherine turning directly toward the viewer, her expression tightening into ruthless determination.

units.text: Medium shot of Juliana, her pride flaring through her sadness.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: If this is pity, take back your ring.
Tight close-up on Juliana's face, a tear clinging to her cheek.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I will not become anyone's charity.
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her gaze directly.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: It is not pity, Lady Juliana.
Intense tight close-up on his piercing blue-green eyes and facial scars.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: It is a vow.
Close-up of Juliana, completely disarmed by the gravity of his promise.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I don't know this man.
Medium shot of Lady Ashcroft, Clarissa, and Lord Ashcroft seated coldly in the family pew.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I don't know what waits beyond these doors.
Side profile close-up of Juliana looking toward her estranged family, then turning back.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: But he looked at me when everyone else turned away.
Medium shot of Juliana facing down at him, a faint, tender smile breaking across her lips.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: No.
Juliana looks upward into the canopy, gathering herself with a faint nod.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It isn't.
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, gazing down at her with quiet remorse.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: You should not have had to walk through this rain tonight.
Close-up on Juliana's bodice and mother's pendant as she gathers her cloak closer.
Close-up of Juliana's face, offering a wistful, comforting smile.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I suppose the day was already ruined.

They walk forward toward the cottage emerging from the dark woods.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: That is it?

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: Yes.

units.text: I could trim them for you.
Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hand firmly but gently catching Juliana's wrist in midair.
Medium two-shot profile of Alexander holding her wrist, his piercing gaze locked onto hers.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Not yet.
Close-up of Juliana looking into his eyes, her brow lightly furrowed in bemused question.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Not yet?
Close-up of Alexander, still maintaining his gentle hold on her arm.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Let them grow.
Close-up of Juliana smiling with playful warmth.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You prefer looking like a forest hermit?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: It has advantages.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Very well.

Close-up of Juliana grinning with sparkling eyes.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: But one day, I am trimming that beard.

Extreme close-up on Juliana's glistening eyes and trembling lips, firelight reflecting softly across her face.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: But I didn't lose you.
Close-up on Alexander's scarred, weathered fingers wrapping the cloth tightly yet gently around her lacerations.
Close-up on Alexander looking up at her with profound remorse and affection.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You have taken my place today.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: You always did have a taste for symbolism.
Medium shot of Father Thomas, a subtle smirk breaking through his austere demeanor.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
units.text: And you always did have a taste for using me. It's why we suit each other.
Close-up on Catherine, her expression turning razor-sharp and commanding.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Then make certain the council remembers that for the full ten days, not just the first hour.
Side profile close-up on Father Thomas, his brow furrowing with impatient resolve.

units.speaker: FATHER THOMAS

units.text: Low-angle shot on Alexander and Juliana turning in alarm toward the rear of the cathedral.
Medium shot of the High Priest striding down the aisle, holding up an official royal parchment bearing red wax seals.
The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union.
Close-up on the High Priest unfolding the document, reading aloud to the congregation.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register.
Medium shot of Alexander shielding Juliana behind him as the Crown officer approaches with drawn sword.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: Before the Crown, you are not Duchess of Ashburton.
Close-up of the High Priest scowling directly at Juliana with unyielding authority.

units.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
units.text: You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife.
Close-up two-shot of Juliana gasping in terror, clutching Alexander's hand tightly as Alexander glares at the Priest.

Medium close-up of Rupert standing nervously beside ornate double doors, wearing black gloves and an embroidered dark coat, glancing up with anxiety.

units.text: You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there.

units.text: The heavy wooden cottage door creaks open. Juliana steps across the threshold into the dark, barren room.
Door hinges groaning open followed by the hollow thump of footsteps on wet wood floorboards.
Close-up overhead shot of a wooden bucket catching raindrops dripping steadily from a leak in the ceiling.
Rhythmic water drips plinking into the metal-rimmed wooden bucket.
Medium wide shot past the drip bucket as the Mysterious Bearded Man closes the door behind them.
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man standing in the dim light by the door.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: I am sorry.
Medium shot of Juliana gazing around the rustic interior, taking in the sparse surroundings.
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man looking at her with somber honesty.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: You came from comfort.

units.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
units.text: This is all I can give you now.
Medium shot of Juliana undoing the ribbon tie of her black cloak and letting it slide off her shoulders.
Juliana removes her dark cloak, revealing her damp white bridal dress underneath.
Close-up of Juliana's hand pressing against the cold, condensation-fogged windowpane.
Side profile shot of Juliana looking out the rain-streaked window into the quiet forest.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It is quiet.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Very quiet.

Medium shot of the Dowager Duchess looking intently at Juliana from her pillows, studying her bearing.

units.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
units.text: Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?
Close-up of Juliana, her chin lifting with dignified sorrow and quiet defiance.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
units.text: Everything must go perfectly.
Rupert smooths the lapels of his coat, checking his posture as he waits for the bride.
Medium shot up on the stone balcony overlooking the nave, where an elder conspirator nobleman in black gloves stands gripping a cane.
High-angle wide shot looking down from the balcony across the entire cathedral filled with guests, candles lining the central aisle, and royal guards standing at attention.
Medium shot on the balcony as a Royal Guard in red uniform and tall bearskin hat steps up and bows respectfully to the elder nobleman.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: All entrances are covered?

units.text: Every one, my Lord.

units.text: Good.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: And its witch will be dead.

units.text: Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to.
Wide atmospheric shot of the shadowy barn loft. Moonlight filters through vertical wooden slats, illuminating Juliana seated on a pile of straw beside a warm, glowing kerosene lantern.
Over-the-shoulder close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands tracing the detailed botanical drawing on the charred page of her mother's herbal.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: We have lost everything.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I don't know what we will do tomorrow.

units.text: Medium two-shot. Rupert stands over Catherine seated at the polished table, placing a gloved hand possessively near her shoulder.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots.

units.speaker: RUPERT
units.text: They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown.

Medium close-up tilting down on JULIANA kneeling in the straw beside a rustic wooden crate, sorting sprigs of dried lavender and sage into a woven basket. Her hands are bound in linen bandages from the recent fire.
The barn door opens, revealing daylight outside. SEAMUS, an older weathered villager in a waistcoat, carries a wooden bucket inside, his expression etched with deep sorrow and concern.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Let me take that basket, Lady Juliana.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft.
Seamus reaches down to take the handle of the basket from her.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at Seamus, her smudged face fierce with unyielding determination as she holds firmly onto the basket.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I do not yield to a cold draft.
Close-up of Seamus, his face agonizingly strained with grief for her lost status.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: You are a viscount's daughter!

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Let me take that basket, Lady Juliana.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft.

Close-up of Juliana looking up at Seamus, her smudged face fierce with unyielding determination as she holds firmly onto the basket.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I do not yield to a cold draft.
Close-up of Seamus, his face agonizingly strained with grief for her lost status.

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: You are a viscount's daughter!

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Sleeping on straw, sorting weeds!

units.speaker: SEAMUS
units.text: Let the village tend to itself for once!
Medium close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unwavering moral strength.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I could trim them for you.
Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hand firmly but gently catching Juliana's wrist in midair.
Medium two-shot profile of Alexander holding her wrist, his piercing gaze locked onto hers.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Not yet.
Close-up of Juliana looking into his eyes, her brow lightly furrowed in bemused question.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Not yet?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Let them grow.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You prefer looking like a forest hermit?

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: It has advantages.

units.text: Very well.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: But one day, I am trimming that beard.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: We'll see.
Medium two-shot of both sitting back down at the table together, Alexander turning a brittle page of the herb book.
Close-up insert of Alexander's weathered finger pointing directly at a delicate botanical illustration of a flowering stem.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: That one grows near the northern stream. Crushed leaves ease swelling.
Wide side-profile two-shot of Juliana and Alexander seated across from each other at the rustic table, the stone fireplace roaring warmly behind them.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: My mother wrote the same thing.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: And the scars... were they from the war?
Close-up of Alexander looking downward, memories clouding his eyes.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: Some were.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes filled with gentle understanding.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: It must have been terrible.

units.speaker: ALEXANDER
units.text: It was.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I thought losing wealth meant losing everything.

Extreme close-up of Juliana's radiant face illuminated by firelight, a peaceful, contented smile spreading across her lips as she looks at him until the shot gently fades out.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: Perhaps I was wrong.

units.text: She stands beneath God's watch and still gets exactly what she deserves.
Lord and Lady Harrington slide gracefully into the polished wooden pew, smoothing their garments.
Medium profile shot of the couple seated in the pew, looking toward the grand altar.

units.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
units.text: We have an excellent view.

units.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
units.text: Of the wedding?

units.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
units.text: And everything that comes after it.

units.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN

units.text: All entrances are covered?

units.text: Every one, my Lord.

units.text: Good.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess.

units.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
units.text: And its witch will be dead.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: I chose a man who stood beside me when you walked away.

units.speaker: JULIANA
units.text: You have no authority here. Leave.

units.speaker: GERALD

units.text: Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.
Two-shot profile of Catherine towering over Agnes in the candlelight.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Good. Let them remember it.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now.
Over-the-shoulder close-up on Agnes, her brow furrowed in anxious alarm.

units.speaker: AGNES
units.text: My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county.
Close-up on Catherine, a smug, venomous smile spreading across her painted lips.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house.
Medium tracking shot following Catherine as she releases Agnes and stalks across the room toward the window sill.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Father Thomas did his part beautifully today.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes.
Medium close-up of Agnes glancing nervously over her shoulder.

units.speaker: AGNES
units.text: If someone sees him come to you...
Close-up on Catherine spinning around from the window, her jaw set in terrifying firmness.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Then no one sees him.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: That is precisely your job tonight.
Medium shot as Catherine picks up a heavy velvet coin purse and places it firmly into Agnes's awaiting open palms.
Dull clinking of heavy gold coins inside a leather pouch.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: Send for the priest. Tonight.

units.speaker: CATHERINE
units.text: And make sure no one sees him arrive.
Wide shot of Agnes curtsying swiftly, stashing the pouch into her apron, and hurrying out through the heavy wooden door into the darkness.

Exterior shot looking through the dark diamond-paned window frame at Catherine standing motionless in the warm candlelight, staring outward into the night with cold, unyielding ambition as the scene fades to black.
